jobs.title: Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
jobs.description:
Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America - Swatch Group

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
We are seeking an experienced, retail Store Manager to provide leadership in our store. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and delivering excellent customer service.
Profile
• Achieve goals through execution of our productivity program, team-member coaching and outstanding client service.
• Ensure a consistent and respectable store experience for our customers.
• Be able to think strategically and efficiently while running the store as per company standards.
• Possess the ability to prioritize, plan, delegate, and adapt to business needs at various times.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Ensure proper staffing of the store through recruitment and retention.
• Create and foster a nourishing environment for the team to strive and succeed.
• Develop and guide a large team of employees.
• Professional requirements
• 3-5 years of retail Store Management experience required for all candidates, specialty retail preferred
• Passion for the delivering the culture of the SWATCH Brand
• Excellent organizational, communication and computer skills.
• Ability to lead and sustain an efficiently operating and cohesive store.
• Team-oriented
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount
• Internal transfer and growth potential
• $500 Employee Referral Bonuses

descriptionByLocale.it:
Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America - Swatch Group

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
L'azienda
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e conferisce loro la propria scintilla di creatività. Così, Swatch è considerato una tela su cui sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile taglio bordo, impostazione tendenza look e accenti tecnologia amichevole hanno tutti aggiunto allo stupore di possedere un Swatch.
Descrizione del lavoro
Stiamo cercando un esperto, Retail Store Manager per fornire la leadership nel nostro negozio. Il candidato ideale deve essere un Retail Manager esperto con una forte attenzione alla guida delle vendite e alla fornitura di un servizio clienti eccellente.
Profilo
• Raggiungere gli obiettivi attraverso l'esecuzione del nostro programma di produttività, team-member coaching e servizio client eccezionale.
• Assicurare un'esperienza di negozio coerente e rispettabile per i nostri clienti.
• Essere in grado di pensare in modo strategico ed efficiente durante l'esecuzione del negozio secondo gli standard aziendali.
• Possedere la capacità di priorità, pianificare, delegare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in vari momenti.
• Massimizzare le tecniche di inventario, controllo dei contanti e prevenzione delle perdite.
• Assicurare il corretto personale del negozio attraverso il reclutamento e la ritenzione.
• Creare e promuovere un ambiente nutriente per il team di lottare e avere successo.
• Sviluppare e guidare una grande squadra di dipendenti.
• Requisiti professionali
• 3-5 anni di esperienza di gestione del negozio al dettaglio richiesto per tutti i candidati, specialità al dettaglio preferito
• Passione per la consegna della cultura del marchio SWATCH
• Eccellente capacità organizzative, comunicative e informatiche.
• Capacità di condurre e sostenere un negozio efficiente e coeso.
• Team-oriented
• Programma Vantaggi
• Il Gruppo Swatch è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che promuove la diversità e si impegna per la sostenibilità ambientale e siamo lieti di offrire un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi che comprende:
• Eccellente assicurazione per la salute, l'odontoiatria e la visione (leggibile il 1° del mese successivo a 30 giorni; generoso contributo del datore di lavoro)
• Partecipazione immediata al 401(k) e al 100% del datore di lavoro investito dopo un anno
• Assicurazione sulla vita retribuita e invalidità a lungo termine
• 18 giorni PTO all'anno, 23 PTO dopo 5 anni
• 7 giorni all'anno prolungato tempo a pagamento per congedo medico, parentale e militare
• Paga di vacanza
• Conto di spesa flessibile volontario, Disabilità a breve termine, Assicurazione infortuni / ospedaliera
• Sconto del prodotto dei dipendenti
• Possibilità di trasferimento interno e di crescita
• $500 Bonus di riferimento del dipendente
• Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/

jobs.description:
Sales Consultant - Swatch Group

Sales Consultant
• The company
• About Blancpain
Founded in 1735, Blancpain is the world’s oldest watchmaking brand, embodying nearly three centuries of uninterrupted expertise. Blancpain is synonymous with timeless elegance, innovation, and uncompromising craftsmanship. Discover the aesthetic and technological know-how for which Blancpain has been renowned since its creation. Generations of devoted artisans have refined their skills, overcoming challenges with passion and perseverance, to elevate their art to the peak of perfection. From the legendary Fifty Fathoms to extraordinary complications, every Blancpain creation reflects precision, artistry, and exclusivity, preserving the heritage of Swiss watchmaking while continually redefining its future.
Job description
About The Role
The primary responsibility of the Sales Consultant is to deliver exceptional experiences for all boutique visitors, fostering long-term relationships and meeting sales targets. Working together with boutique colleagues, the Boutique Manager and the Blancpain management team, the Sales Consultant ensures that every client receives the premium service befitting a Blancpain timepiece.
What You'll Be Doing
• Client Engagement & Sales
• Greet every client warmly, acknowledging their presence promptly upon entering the boutique.
• Understand client preferences through attentive listening and thoughtful conversation.
• Share the unique stories behind our timepieces, highlighting features, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Meet and exceed individual sales goals while contributing to overall boutique performance.
• Take pride in presenting the right product for each client, offering recommendations that are both relevant and inspiring.
• Customer/Client Relationship Management (CRM)
• Cultivate long-term relationships with clients by maintaining regular, thoughtful follow-ups and exclusive invitations to events or launches.
• Manage and grow an active client book through CRM tools and clienteling best practices.
• Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when serving high-profile and international clientele.
• Brand & Product Knowledge
• Maintain deep product knowledge across collections and novelties, including movements, materials, and craftsmanship.
• Stay updated on brand history, key milestones, and current campaigns to support brand storytelling.
• Participate in regular product and service training.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
• Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
• Uphold company procedures and policies related to operation, customer service, security and compliance.
• Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces.
• Monitor competitors’ marketing activities and provide regular market intelligence to the Management.
• Work closely with your team to create a supportive, positive environment where everyone feels valued and motivated to achieve shared success.
• Profile
• Minimum 3 years of sales experience in luxury, premium retail, or lifestyle brands.
• Passionate about client service and delivering exceptional experiences.
• Professional, well-groomed, and confident in engaging with diverse clientele.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.

Mansioni
- L'azienda
- Su Blancpain
Fondata nel 1735, Blancpain è il marchio orologiero più antico del mondo, che racchiude quasi tre secoli di esperienza ininterrotta. Blancpain è sinonimo di eleganza senza tempo, innovazione e artigianato senza compromessi. Scopri il know-how estetico e tecnologico per il quale Blancpain è rinomata fin dalla sua creazione. Generazioni di devoti artigiani hanno affinato le loro competenze, superando le sfide con passione e perseveranza, per elevare la loro arte al culmine della perfezione. Dalla leggendaria Fifty Fathoms a complicazioni straordinarie, ogni creazione Blancpain riflette precisione, arte ed esclusività, preservando il patrimonio dell'orologeria svizzera e ridefinindo continuamente il suo futuro.
- Descrizione del lavoro
- Su The Role
La responsabilità primaria del Vendite Consultant è quella di offrire esperienze eccezionali per tutti i visitatori della boutique, promuovendo relazioni a lungo termine e incontri obiettivi di vendita. Lavorando insieme a colleghi di boutique, il Boutique Manager e il team di gestione Blancpain, il Sales Consultant assicura che ogni cliente riceva il servizio premium con un orologio Blancpain.

Descrizione
- Cosa farai?
• Impegno clienti e vendite
- Salutate tutti i clienti calorosamente, riconoscendo la loro presenza prontamente all'ingresso nella boutique.
- Comprendere le preferenze dei clienti attraverso un ascolto attento e una conversazione premurosa.
- Condividi le storie uniche dietro i nostri orologi, evidenziando le caratteristiche, l'artigianato e il patrimonio del marchio.
- Soddisfare e superare i singoli obiettivi di vendita, contribuendo alle prestazioni boutique globali.
- Siate orgogliosi di presentare il prodotto giusto per ogni cliente, offrendo raccomandazioni che sono sia rilevanti e stimolanti.
• Gestione delle relazioni cliente/cliente (CRM)
- Coltivare relazioni a lungo termine con i clienti mantenendo regolari, premuroso follow-up e inviti esclusivi a eventi o lanci.
- Gestire e crescere un libro client attivo attraverso strumenti CRM e la clientela best practice.
- Dimostrare discrezione e professionalità al servizio della clientela internazionale e di alto profilo.
• Conoscenza del prodotto
- Mantenere una profonda conoscenza del prodotto tra collezioni e novità, tra cui movimenti, materiali e artigianalità.
- Resta aggiornato sulla storia del marchio, le pietre miliari e le campagne attuali per supportare la narrazione del marchio.
- Partecipare alla formazione di prodotti e servizi regolari.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
- Partecipa attivamente alla corretta manutenzione della boutique: display del prodotto, set-up di oggetti, ecc.
- Mantenere le procedure e le politiche aziendali relative al funzionamento, al servizio clienti, alla sicurezza e alla conformità.
- Seguire la sicurezza e la corretta manutenzione dei segnatempo.
- Monitorare le attività di marketing dei concorrenti e fornire una regolare intelligenza di mercato alla Direzione.
- Lavorare a stretto contatto con il vostro team per creare un ambiente favorevole e positivo in cui tutti si sentono apprezzati e motivati per raggiungere il successo condiviso.

- Profilo
- Minimo 3 anni di esperienza di vendita nei marchi di lusso, premium retail o lifestyle.
- Appassionato sul servizio clienti e offrendo esperienze eccezionali.
- Professionale, ben curato, e fiducioso di impegnarsi con una clientela diversificata.

Mansion
- Die Firma
- Über Blancpain
Blancpain wurde 1735 gegründet und ist die weltweit älteste Uhrenmarke, die fast drei Jahrhunderte ununterbrochenes Know-how verkörpert. Blancpain ist Synonym für zeitlose Eleganz, Innovation und kompromisslose Handwerkskunst. Entdecken Sie das ästhetische und technologische Know-how, für das Blancpain seit seiner Gründung bekannt ist. Generationen von engagierten Handwerkern haben ihre Fähigkeiten verfeinert, Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und Ausdauer zu überwinden, ihre Kunst auf den Höhepunkt der Perfektion zu erhöhen. Von den legendären fünfzig Fathoms bis hin zu außergewöhnlichen Komplikationen spiegelt jede Blancpain Kreation Präzision, Künstlerei und Exklusivität wider, die das Erbe der Schweizer Uhrmacherei bewahrt und ihre Zukunft kontinuierlich neu definiert.
- Jobbeschreibung
- Über die Rolle
Die primäre Verantwortung des Sales Consultants besteht darin, außergewöhnliche Erfahrungen für alle Boutique-Besucher zu liefern, langfristige Beziehungen zu pflegen und Vertriebsziele zu erreichen. Gemeinsam mit Boutique-Kollegen, dem Boutique Manager und dem Blancpain-Management-Team sorgt der Sales Consultant dafür, dass jeder Kunde den Premium-Service erhält, der einem Blancpain-Zeitmesser entspricht.

Beschreibung
- Was du tust
• Kundenbindung und Vertrieb
- Grüße jeden Klienten herzlich und erkenne ihre Anwesenheit sofort beim Eintritt in die Boutique.
- Verstehen Sie Kundenvorlieben durch aufmerksames Zuhören und durchdachtes Gespräch.
- Teilen Sie die einzigartigen Geschichten hinter unseren Zeitmessern, Highlights, Handwerk und Markenerbe.
- Treffen und übertreffen einzelne Verkaufsziele und tragen zu einer Gesamt-Boutique-Performance bei.
- Stolz auf die Präsentation des richtigen Produkts für jeden Kunden, bietet Empfehlungen, die sowohl relevant als auch inspirierend sind.
• Customer/Client Relationship Management (CRM)
- Kultivieren Sie langfristige Beziehungen mit Kunden durch regelmäßige, nachdenkliche Follow-ups und exklusive Einladungen zu Veranstaltungen oder Starts.
- Verwalten und wachsen Sie ein aktives Client-Buch durch CRM-Tools und kundenspezifische Best Practices.
- Demonstrieren Sie Diskretion und Professionalität beim Servieren von hochkarätigen und internationalen Kunden.
• Marken- und Produktwissen
- Erhalten Sie tiefes Produktwissen über Sammlungen und Neuheiten, einschließlich Bewegungen, Materialien und Handwerk.
- Bleiben Sie auf der Markengeschichte, wichtigen Meilensteinen und aktuellen Kampagnen, um Markengeschichte zu unterstützen.
- Erwarten Sie regelmäßiges Produkt- und Servicetraining.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
- Nehmen Sie aktiv an der richtigen Wartung der Boutique teil: Produktdisplays, Props Set-up, etc.
- Unternehmen Verfahren und Richtlinien im Zusammenhang mit Betrieb, Kundenservice, Sicherheit und Compliance.
- Folgen Sie der Sicherheit und ordnungsgemäßen Wartung von Aktenuhren.
- Überwachen Sie die Marketingaktivitäten der Wettbewerber und liefern Sie dem Management regelmäßig Marktinformationen.
- Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Team zusammen, um ein unterstützendes, positives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder schätzen und motiviert fühlt, um gemeinsamen Erfolg zu erzielen.

Voraussetzungen
- Profil
- Mindestens 3 Jahre Verkaufserfahrung in Luxus-, Premium- oder Lifestyle-Marken.
- Leidenschaftlich über Kundenservice und außergewöhnliche Erfahrungen.
- Professional, gut gepflegt und zuversichtlich, mit vielfältigen Kunden.
- Starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
- Leidenschaft für Luxus-Uhren, Handwerk und Markenerbe.

jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Keyholder/Watch Technician - San Antonio (La Cantera) - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Keyholder/Watch Technician - San Antonio (La Cantera)
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
Ideal candidate will have luxury retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder or supervisory background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeanor that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our prestigious timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
This role is expected to possibly transition in to a boutique technician position, which will provide technical services to all timepieces and accessories. Dexterity and technical aptitude are highly desirable. As a technician in training Omega offers courses where you will delve into the world of timepiece mechanics and repair. Watchmaking is a highly desirable skill for this position.
Profile
• Perform opening and/ or closing Boutique procedures
• Will liaise with Store Manager and Assistant Manager and demonstrate leadership capabilities in their absence and while on the sales floor with entire team.
• Demonstrate a deep knowledge of all of our unique and impeccable range of products and their distinctive characteristics
• Cultivate enduring relationships with clients by providing memorable experiences which enlighten and provide insights into the ancestry of OMEGA
• Utilize our expansive training techniques to engage, inform and retain a gratified and loyal client base.
• Professional requirements
• Minimum 3 years of Luxury retail Sales/Keyholder experience, preferably in the timepiece or fine jewelry field.
• Watchmakers are highly desired.
• Demonstrates leadership qualities in as much as representing the Manager’s vision at all times and ensures that policies and procedures are upheld at all times.
• impressive selling capabilities and notable customer service skills
• Elevated ability to communicate effectively both written and orally
• Robust adaptability to learn the technical aspects of our company collection of timepieces
• Ability and willingness to train others in various areas of the business
• Talented negotiation prowess
• Passion for the art of selling
• Must be able to work flexible schedule throughout the week
• MS Office experience is highly desirable

• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)

• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years

• Holiday pay

descriptionByLocale.fr: OMEGA Montres de luxe - Keyholder/Watch Technician - San Antonio (La Cantera) - Swatch Group OMEGA Montres de luxe - Keyholder/Watch Technician - San Antonio (La Cantera) La société OMEGA est une société du Swatch Group, le leader mondial de l'horlogerie. Depuis 1848, la marque est synonyme d'excellence, d'innovation, de design et de précision. Grâce à son esprit de pionnier, OMEGA a été la première montre portée sur la lune et a connu de nombreuses autres réalisations et explorations dans l'océan et dans l'espace. Ses montres femmes ont été parmi les plus admirées et les plus ingénieuses dans l'industrie et, plus récemment, la réputation d'OMEGA a été renforcée par ses réalisations dans l'horlogerie antimagnétique et ses montres certifiées Master Chronometer, l'industrie est le plus haut niveau de précision et de performance. Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Galleria (Houston, TX) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Galleria (Houston, TX)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components. Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
The Swatch brand embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Ideal candidate will have retail sales experience, as well as Keyholder background. This position must possess exceptional customer service skills and a demeaner that embodies a great sense of approachability. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team
Profile
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Handle multi-tasking with ease
• Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
• Compensation: Base Pay plus commission
Professional requirements
• 2 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
• Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
• Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
• Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to plan, set and achieve goals
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills

The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer the following benefits to our part-time positions:
• Excellent health insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)

• Internal transfer and growth potential

• About Omega
Founded in 1848, OMEGA is a watch brand renowned for its excellence, innovation, and precision. Its women’s timepieces are celebrated for their elegance and creativity, while advancements in anti-magnetic technology and Master Chronometer certification continue to set new standards for performance and accuracy. As the Official Timekeeper of the Olympic Games since 1932, OMEGA is also a trusted name in world sports including golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh, and sailing. Beyond its achievements in timekeeping, OMEGA supports global initiatives through partnerships with Orbis International and the GoodPlanet Foundation, and its distinguished ambassadors include George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, and many more.

• Client Engagement & Sales

Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. jobs.description:
Retail Controller - Swatch Group

Retail Controller
Bedrijfsintroductie
Als onderdeel van het wereldwijde concern Swatch Group is The Swatch Group Netherlands de verkooporganisatie van de gerenommeerde Zwitserse horlogemerken zoals Swatch, Omega, Longines, Tissot, Hamilton, Certina, Rado en Balmain binnen Nederland.
Vanuit het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven leveren wij aan zelfstandige juweliers en grootwinkelbedrijven. Daarnaast heeft The Swatch Group Netherlands een groeiend aantal eigen verkooppunten, zoals Swatch Stores, een Tissot boutique in Amsterdam en een Hour Passion winkel in de Designer Outlet in Roermond.
• Voor het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een:
• Retail Controller (fulltime)
• Functie
Dol op cijfers? En zie je het als een sport om processen en transacties kloppend te maken én te houden? Als retail controller ben je verantwoordelijk voor álles wat met de financiële kant van de eigen winkels van The Swatch Group te maken heeft. Van controlling, administratie en voorraad tot audits en winkelopeningen. Jij draagt een volledige p&l- en balans-verantwoordelijkheid. Zin om jouw stempel te drukken op een internationale organisatie vol topmerken zoals Swatch, Omega en Tissot? Bouw samen mee aan ons succes!
Hoe ziet deze functie eruit?
Binnen deze functie ben jij hét financiële aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met retail te maken heeft. Of het nu gaat om de dagelijkse transacties in de winkels of de rapportages richting het Zwitserse hoofdkantoor: jij houdt het overzicht en de inhoud scherp. Brutomarges, kostenstructuren, CapEx-uitgaven en salesreconciliaties – alles komt voorbij.
De betrouwbaarheid van cijfers? Die staat natuurlijk voorop. Daarom controleer je bankafstemmingen en bewaak je de aansluiting tussen het POS-systeem en het ERP-systeem (SAP). Periodiek lever je scherpe inzichten aan het management, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Bij elke nieuwe winkelopening schuif je ook aan als vaste kracht binnen het operationele projectteam. Je beoordeelt prijsstellingen, werkt businesscases uit en houdt budgetten strak in de gaten. Inventory controlling? Volledig jouw terrein.
Maar daar blijft het niet bij. Regelmatig ben je onderweg. Om winkels te bezoeken voor audits op locatie. Hier toets je de naleving van interne procedures. En je telt de voorraad om juistheid en volledigheid te garanderen. Door jouw werk draait de retailorganisatie financieel als een Zwitsers uurwerk.
Profiel
• Wat neem je mee?
• Afgeronde wo-opleiding in bedrijfseconomie. Met minimaal drie tot vijf jaar ervaring in een control rol.
• Ervaring met SAP of SAP BW, Office 365 en Excel.
• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk. Communicatief ben je sterk.
• Analytisch ben je sterk en je weet complexe financiële data te vertalen naar heldere en bruikbare inzichten voor het management.
• Proactief, ondernemend, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
• Aanbod
Deze functie geeft ruimte én verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent dé retail controller van de Nederlandse organisatie en krijgt een zelfstandige rol binnen een internationale context. Met directe betrokkenheid bij alles wat in de winkels gebeurt, ben je verzekerd van impact. Je werkt in het hart van de organisatie: het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven. Geen shared service center, maar korte lijnen en een team waar initiatief gewaardeerd wordt.
• Rechtstreeks in dienst bij The Swatch Group in Eindhoven.
• Jaarcontract (uitzicht op vast).
• 40 uur per week (32 is bespreekbaar).
• € 4.000,- tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand.
• 26 vakantiedagen per jaar.
• Mogelijkheid tot collectieve zorgverzekering.
• Ruimte voor professionele groei en ontwikkeling.
• Thuiswerken op structurele basis is niet mogelijk

descriptionByLocale.de: Retail Controller - Swatch Group Retail Controller Bedrijfsintroductie Als Angebot des weltweiten Konzerns Swatch Group handelt es sich um die Swatch Group Netherlands, eine Handelsorganisation für die Zusammenarbeit mit Schweizer Uhrenmarken für Swatch, Omega, Longines, Tissot, Hamilton, Certina, Rado und Balmain in den Niederlanden. Die Hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven wird von selbständigen Juwelieren und großen Winkelgeschäften genutzt. Daarnaast hat The Swatch Group Netherlands zu einem großen Teil mit eigenen Kunden verbunden, darunter Swatch Stores, eine Tissot-Boutique in Amsterdam und einen Hour Passion-Shop im Designer Outlet in Roermond. • Für die Geschäftsstelle in Eindhoven bieten wir Ihnen direkt die Möglichkeit, nach einem zu suchen: • Einzelhandelscontroller (Vollzeit) • Funktion Nebenjobs? Ist das ein Sport, bei dem Prozesse und Transaktionen zum Scheitern verurteilt sind? Als Einzelhandelskontrolleur war ich für alles verantwortlich, was die Finanzabteilung aus den eigenen Winkeln der The Swatch Group zu bieten hatte. Von Controlling, Verwaltung und Beratung bis hin zu Audits und Geschäftseröffnungen. Ich ziehe einen vollständigen Betrag und eine Rechnung mit voller Haftung aus. Hatte Ihr Stempel auf eine internationale Organisation gestoßen, um Swatch, Omega und Tissot zu erwähnen? Vielen Dank für unseren Erfolg! Wie funktioniert diese Funktion? Innerhalb dieser Funktion benötige ich eine finanzielle Unterstützung für alles, was mit dem Einzelhandel zu tun hat. Es besteht keine Gefahr, dass die täglichen Transaktionen in den Winkeln der Beziehungen mit dem Schweizer Büro abgeschlossen werden: Sie müssen den Überblick behalten und Ihr Unternehmen scheren. Bruttogewinne, Kostenstrukturen, CapEx-Gebühren und Vertriebsabstimmungen – alles kommt zum Vorschein. Die Betrouwbaarheid von Cijfers? Der staatliche Naturschutz. Um Ihre Bankgeschäfte zu kontrollieren und darauf zu achten, dass Sie das POS-System und das ERP-System (SAP) nutzen. Von Zeit zu Zeit werde ich dem Management, sei es vor Ort oder auf internationaler Ebene, Aufmerksamkeit schenken. Bis zu einem gewissen Grad war ich auch in der Lage, innerhalb des operativen Projektteams große Anstrengungen zu unternehmen. Ich benötige einen Vorzug, Businesscases werden aus einem Budgetrahmen von weniger als einem Jahr erstellt. Bestandskontrolle? Vollständiges Spiel auf dem Land. Aber das ist nicht der Fall. Regelmäßig ben je onderweg. Wir empfehlen Ihnen, vor Ort Audits durchzuführen. Hier finden Sie Informationen zu internen Verfahren. Ich habe Ihnen gesagt, dass Sie Recht und Vollständigkeit gewährleisten müssen. Sie werden von Einzelhandels- und Finanzorganisationen als einziges Unternehmen beauftragt. Profil • Was nimmst du mir? • Afgeronde wo-opleiding in bedrijfseconomie. Es dauerte mindestens drei Jahre, bis eine Kontrollrolle eingehalten wurde. • Ervaring traf SAP oder SAP BW, Office 365 und Excel. • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk. Die Kommunikation ist schrecklich. • Analytisch benötigen Sie umfangreiche und komplexe Finanzdaten, um sie für das Management zu verwalten und zu nutzen. • Proaktiv, unterstützend, neu und strukturiert. • Diese Funktion ist nicht mehr gültig. jobs.description:
Boutique Manager - Swatch Group

Boutique Manager
• The company
• About Omega
Founded in 1848, OMEGA is a watch brand renowned for its excellence, innovation, and precision. Guided by a pioneering spirit, OMEGA has explored the depths of the ocean and the vastness of space, becoming the first watch worn on the moon. Its women’s timepieces are celebrated for their elegance and creativity, while advancements in anti-magnetic technology and Master Chronometer certification continue to set new standards for performance and accuracy. As the Official Timekeeper of the Olympic Games since 1932, OMEGA is also a trusted name in world sports including golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh, and sailing. Beyond its achievements in timekeeping, OMEGA supports global initiatives through partnerships with Orbis International and the GoodPlanet Foundation, and its distinguished ambassadors include George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, and many more.
Job description
About The Role
The Boutique Manager is responsible for driving the sustained growth and overall performance of the boutique, with full accountability for its daily operations, team leadership, and business results. Acting with an entrepreneurial mindset, the Boutique Manager identifies new business opportunities, maximize sales, and elevate the client experience. This role demands strong managerial, interpersonal, and technical skills to lead a high-performing team, build long-term client relationships, and consistently achieve key performance objectives in alignment with brand standards.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership
Provide clear leadership to the Boutique team by effectively communicating objectives, individual responsibilities, expected outcomes, brand standards, and operational procedures. Assign tasks accordingly, monitor progress, and ensure ongoing communication.
Coach each team member to achieve both individual and collective goals through regular team meetings, OJT, performance appraisals, proactive identification of training needs, task delegation, and consistent feedback.
• Oversee staff appearance and conduct to ensure compliant with company policies and boutique standards, including uniform, grooming, language, and overall presentation.
• Sales and Business Development
• Exceed boutique targets in accordance with brand’s retail strategy while ensuring full compliance.
• Attract and convert target prospects into boutique clients. Design and implement tailored programs to acquire high-potential customers and effectively manage the client lifecycle.
• Foster lasting relationships and cultivate loyalty with clients as a member of the Omega family by delivering exceptional service.
Identify growth opportunities and propose clienteling strategies through effective use of the CRM system. Collect, update, and manage client information, and oversee the clienteling activities performed by Sales Consultants.
Boutique Operations
• Ensure the boutique is well-maintained, including cleanliness, visually appealing displays, and adherence to Visual Merchandising (VM) guidelines.
• Comply with Group and Brand procedures as outlined in the Retail Manual. Identify operational challenges and propose effective solutions.
• Safeguard the security and proper maintenance of the timepiece stock.
• Administration & Reporting
• Manage and prepare the monthly duty roster, monitor attendance.
• Oversee and verify overtime (OT) submissions, ensuring accuracy, proper justification, and timely submission for payroll processing.
• Coordinate and participate in regular and ad-hoc stock takes, ensure accurate inventory reconciliation, and submit reports within deadlines.
• Consolidate and submit sales and operational reports, tracking key performance metrics and highlighting variances or issues to management.
• Maintain accurate records of staff attendance, leave, and operational documents such as petty cash, courier logs, and maintenance reports, ensuring administrative compliance with company policies.
• Ensure timely reporting, document submission, and effective communication of updates or policy changes to the boutique team.
• Profile
• Minimum 7 years of experience in luxury retail, with at least 2 years in a managerial role.
• Proven track record in achieving and exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment.
• Strong business acumen, analytical skills, and results-oriented mindset.
• Strong understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and ultra-high-net-worth customer behaviour.
• Collaborative approach with the ability to foster teamwork and a "can-do" attitude.
• Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning and staying updated on industry trends.
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills in English (additional language is a plus).
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Comfortable using Excel, Word, and SAP for operational and reporting tasks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Boutique Manager - Swatch Group

Manager di Boutique
• L'azienda
• Su Omega
Fondata nel 1848, OMEGA è un marchio di orologi famoso per la sua eccellenza, innovazione e precisione. Guidato da uno spirito pionieristico, OMEGA ha esplorato le profondità dell'oceano e la vastità dello spazio, diventando il primo orologio indossato sulla luna. I suoi orologi da donna sono celebrati per la loro eleganza e creatività, mentre i progressi nella tecnologia antimagnetica e la certificazione Master Chronometer continuano a fissare nuovi standard per prestazioni e precisione. Come Timekeeper ufficiale dei Giochi Olimpici dal 1932, OMEGA è anche un nome di fiducia negli sport mondiali tra cui golf, nuoto, atletica, bobsleigh e vela. Oltre ai suoi successi nel timekeeping, OMEGA sostiene iniziative globali attraverso partnership con Orbis International e la Fondazione GoodPlanet, e i suoi distinti ambasciatori includono George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, e molti altri.
Descrizione del lavoro
Informazioni su The Role
Il Boutique Manager è responsabile di guidare la crescita sostenuta e le prestazioni globali della boutique, con piena responsabilità per le sue operazioni quotidiane, la leadership del team e i risultati aziendali. Agendo con una mentalità imprenditoriale, il Boutique Manager identifica nuove opportunità di business, massimizzare le vendite e aumentare l'esperienza del cliente. Questo ruolo richiede forti competenze manageriali, interpersonali e tecniche per guidare un team di alto livello, costruire relazioni cliente a lungo termine, e raggiungere costantemente obiettivi di prestazioni chiave in allineamento con gli standard del marchio.
Cosa farai
Leadership del team
Fornire una chiara leadership al team Boutique comunicando efficacemente obiettivi, responsabilità individuali, risultati attesi, standard di marca e procedure operative. Assegnare i compiti di conseguenza, monitorare i progressi e garantire la comunicazione in corso.
Allena ogni membro del team per raggiungere obiettivi sia individuali che collettivi attraverso riunioni di squadra regolari, GUT, valutazioni delle prestazioni, identificazione proattiva delle esigenze di formazione, delegazione del compito e feedback coerente.
• Superare l'aspetto e la condotta del personale per garantire la conformità con le politiche aziendali e gli standard di boutique, tra cui uniformi, cura, lingua e presentazione generale.
• Vendite e sviluppo aziendale
• Obiettivi esclusivi della boutique in conformità alla strategia di vendita al dettaglio del marchio, garantendo al contempo la piena conformità.
• Attrarre e convertire le prospettive di destinazione in clienti boutique. Progettare e implementare programmi su misura per acquisire clienti altamente potenziali e gestire efficacemente il ciclo di vita del cliente.
• Promuovere relazioni durature e coltivare la lealtà con i clienti come membro della famiglia Omega offrendo un servizio eccezionale.
Identificare le opportunità di crescita e proporre strategie di clientela attraverso un uso efficace del sistema CRM. Raccogliere, aggiornare e gestire le informazioni dei clienti e supervisionare le attività di clientela svolte da Sales Consultants.
Operazioni di Boutique
• Assicurarsi che la boutique sia ben tenuta, tra cui pulizia, display visivamente accattivanti, e l'adesione a Visual Merchandising (VM) linee guida.
• Complimenti alle procedure di Gruppo e Marchio come indicato nel Manuale al dettaglio. Identificare le sfide operative e proporre soluzioni efficaci.
• Salvaguardare la sicurezza e la corretta manutenzione dello stock di orologi.
• Amministrazione e Reporting
• Gestire e preparare il roster dei dazi mensili, monitorare la presenza.
• Controllare e verificare le richieste straordinarie (OT), garantire l'accuratezza, la corretta giustificazione e la tempestiva presentazione per l'elaborazione del libro paga.
• Coordinare e partecipare a azioni regolari e ad-hoc, garantire una accurata riconciliazione dell'inventario e presentare relazioni entro le scadenze.
• Consolidare e presentare rapporti di vendita e operativi, tracciare metriche di performance chiave e evidenziare variazioni o problemi alla gestione.
• Mantenere registri accurati della presenza del personale, del congedo e dei documenti operativi come contanti, registri dei corrieri e rapporti di manutenzione, garantendo il rispetto amministrativo delle politiche aziendali.
• Assicurare report tempestivi, presentazione dei documenti e una comunicazione efficace di aggiornamenti o modifiche politiche al team boutique.
• Profilo
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nella vendita al dettaglio di lusso, con almeno 2 anni in un ruolo manageriale.
• Provato record di traccia nel raggiungimento e superamento degli obiettivi di vendita in un ambiente competitivo.
• Forte acume aziendale, competenze analitiche e mentalità orientata ai risultati.
• Forte comprensione della mentalità dei consumatori di lusso e del comportamento dei clienti ultra-alta rete.
• approccio collaborativo con la capacità di favorire il lavoro di squadra e un atteggiamento "can-do".
• Curiosità intellettuale e passione per l'apprendimento e per rimanere aggiornati sulle tendenze del settore.
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e presentazione in inglese (lingua aggiuntiva è un plus).
• Passione per orologi di lusso, artigianalità e patrimonio di marca.
• Confortevole utilizzo di Excel, Word e SAP per le attività operative e di reporting.

Teamleiter

Ses garde-temps féminins sont célébrés pour leur élégance et leur créativité, tandis que les progrès de la technologie antimagnétique et de la certification Master Chronometer continuent de fixer de nouveaux standards de performance et de précision. En tant que chronométreur officiel des Jeux Olympiques depuis 1932, OMEGA est également un nom de confiance dans les sports mondiaux, y compris le golf, la natation, l'athlétisme, le bobsleigh et la voile. Au-delà de ses réalisations en chronologie, OMEGA soutient des initiatives mondiales par le biais de partenariats avec Orbis International et la Fondation GoodPlanet, et ses ambassadeurs distingués sont George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford et bien d'autres. Description de l'emploi À propos du rôle Le directeur de la boutique est responsable de la croissance soutenue et de la performance globale de la boutique, avec la pleine responsabilité de ses opérations quotidiennes, de son leadership d'équipe et de ses résultats opérationnels. Agissant avec un esprit d'entreprise, le directeur de Boutique identifie de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires, maximise les ventes et améliore l'expérience client. Ce rôle exige de solides compétences en gestion, en relations interpersonnelles et techniques pour diriger une équipe hautement performante, établir des relations avec les clients à long terme et atteindre systématiquement des objectifs de rendement clés en conformité avec les normes de marque. Ce que vous ferez Leadership de l'équipe Fournir un leadership clair à l'équipe Boutique en communiquant efficacement les objectifs, les responsabilités individuelles, les résultats attendus, les normes de marque et les procédures opérationnelles. Assigner les tâches en conséquence, suivre les progrès et assurer la communication continue. Encadrer chaque membre de l'équipe afin d'atteindre des objectifs individuels et collectifs au moyen de réunions régulières d'équipes, d'évaluations du rendement, d'identification proactive des besoins de formation, de délégation de tâches et de rétroaction cohérente. • Surveiller l'apparence et la conduite du personnel afin de s'assurer qu'il est conforme aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux normes de boutique, y compris l'uniforme, le toilettage, la langue et la présentation générale. • Ventes et développement des entreprises • Objectifs de boutique dépassés conformément à la stratégie de vente de la marque tout en assurant la pleine conformité. • Attirer et convertir les perspectives cibles en clients de boutique. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des programmes sur mesure pour acquérir des clients à haut potentiel et gérer efficacement le cycle de vie des clients. • Favoriser des relations durables et cultiver la loyauté avec les clients en tant que membre de la famille Omega en fournissant un service exceptionnel. Identifier les possibilités de croissance et proposer des stratégies de clientéling en utilisant efficacement le système de CRM. Recueillir, mettre à jour et gérer l'information sur les clients et superviser les activités de clientéling effectuées par les conseillers en ventes. Opérations de la boutique • S'assurer que la boutique est bien entretenue, y compris la propreté, les affichages visuellement attrayants et le respect des lignes directrices sur la marchandisation visuelle (VM). • Se conformer aux procédures de groupe et de marque décrites dans le manuel de vente au détail. Identifier les défis opérationnels et proposer des solutions efficaces. • Préservez la sécurité et l'entretien du stock de montres. • Administration et rapports • Gérer et préparer la liste mensuelle des tâches, surveiller la présence. • Surveiller et vérifier les demandes d'heures supplémentaires, en veillant à l'exactitude, à la justification appropriée et à la présentation en temps voulu pour le traitement des états de paie. • Coordonner et participer à des collectes de données régulières et ponctuelles, assurer le rapprochement exact des inventaires et soumettre des rapports dans les délais. • Consolider et soumettre des rapports sur les ventes et les opérations, suivre les principales mesures de performance et mettre en évidence les écarts ou les problèmes à la direction. • Tenir des registres exacts des présences du personnel, des congés et des documents opérationnels tels que la petite caisse, les registres de messagerie et les rapports d'entretien, en veillant au respect administratif des politiques de l'entreprise. • Veiller à ce que les rapports, la présentation de documents et la communication efficace des mises à jour ou des changements de politiques soient présentés en temps opportun à l'équipe de la boutique. • Profil • Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans le commerce de détail de luxe, avec au moins 2 ans dans un rôle de gestion. • Expérience éprouvée en matière d'atteinte et de dépassement des objectifs de vente dans un environnement concurrentiel. • Un bon sens des affaires, des compétences analytiques et un état d'esprit axé sur les résultats. • Une bonne compréhension de l'état d'esprit des consommateurs de luxe et du comportement des clients ultra-hauts de gamme. • Une approche collaborative avec la capacité de favoriser le travail d'équipe et une attitude « candide ». • La curiosité intellectuelle et la passion pour l'apprentissage et la mise à jour des tendances de l'industrie. • Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et présentation en anglais (la langue supplémentaire est un plus). • Passion pour les montres de luxe, l'artisanat et le patrimoine de la marque. • Confortable en utilisant Excel, Word et SAP pour les jobs.title: Sales Consultant
jobs.description:
Sales Consultant - Swatch Group

Sales Consultant
• The company
• About Longines
• Longines, the prestigious Swiss watchmaker renowned for its timeless elegance, heritage, and performance, is seeking a passionate Sales Consultant to join its distinguished team.
In this role, you’ll be the welcoming face of Longines, helping customers find the perfect timepiece while delivering warm, attentive service. From greeting clients to assisting them with their final selection, you’ll create meaningful moments that reflect Longines’ rich history and enduring values.
Job description
• What You'll Be Doing
• Client Engagement & Sales
• Greet every client warmly, acknowledging their presence promptly upon entering the boutique.
• Understand client preferences through attentive listening and thoughtful conversation.
• Share the unique stories behind our timepieces, highlighting features, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.
• Meet and exceed individual sales goals while contributing to overall boutique performance.
• Take pride in presenting the right product for each client, offering recommendations that are both relevant and inspiring.
• Client Relationship Management (CRM)
• Cultivate long-term relationships with clients by maintaining regular, thoughtful follow-ups and exclusive invitations to events or launches.
• Manage and grow an active client book through CRM tools and clienteling best practices.
• Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when serving high-profile and international clientele.
• Brand & Product Knowledge
• Maintain deep product knowledge across collections and novelties, including movements, materials, and craftsmanship.
• Stay updated on brand history, key milestones, and current campaigns to support brand storytelling.
• Boutique Operations & Teamwork
• Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
• Uphold company procedures and policies related to operation, customer service, security and compliance.
• Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces.
• Monitor competitors’ marketing activities and provide regular market intelligence to the Management.
• Work closely with your team to create a supportive, positive environment
• Profile
• Minimum 2 years of sales experience in luxury, premium retail, or lifestyle brands.
• Passionate about client service and delivering exceptional experiences.
• Professional, well-groomed, and confident in engaging with diverse clientele.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Passion for luxury watches, craftsmanship, and brand heritage.

Consulente commerciale
• L'azienda
• Informazioni su Longines
• Longines, il prestigioso orologiaio svizzero famoso per la sua eleganza senza tempo, il suo patrimonio e le sue prestazioni, sta cercando un consulente di vendite appassionato per unirsi al suo team distinto.
In questo ruolo, sarete il volto accogliente di Longines, aiutando i clienti a trovare il segnatempo perfetto durante la consegna di un servizio caldo e attento. Dai clienti di saluto per assisterli con la loro selezione finale, creerete momenti significativi che riflettono la ricca storia di Longines e valori duraturi.
Descrizione del lavoro
• Cosa farai
• Impegno clienti e vendite
• Salutate tutti i clienti calorosamente, riconoscendo la loro presenza prontamente all'ingresso della boutique.
• Comprendere le preferenze dei clienti attraverso un ascolto attento e una conversazione premurosa.
• Condividi le storie uniche dietro i nostri orologi, evidenziando le caratteristiche, l'artigianato e il patrimonio del marchio.

• Siate orgogliosi di presentare il prodotto giusto per ogni cliente, offrendo raccomandazioni che sono sia rilevanti e stimolanti.
• Gestione delle relazioni cliente (CRM)
• Coltivare relazioni a lungo termine con i clienti mantenendo regolari, premurosi follow-up e inviti esclusivi a eventi o lanci.
• Gestire e crescere un libro client attivo attraverso strumenti CRM e la clientela best practice.
• Dimostrare discrezione e professionalità al servizio della clientela internazionale e di alto profilo.
• Conoscenza del prodotto
• Mantenere una profonda conoscenza del prodotto tra collezioni e novità, tra cui movimenti, materiali e artigianalità.
• Resta aggiornato sulla storia del marchio, le pietre miliari e le campagne attuali per supportare la narrazione del marchio.

• Partecipa attivamente alla corretta manutenzione della boutique: display del prodotto, set-up di oggetti, ecc.
• Mantenere le procedure e le politiche aziendali relative al funzionamento, al servizio clienti, alla sicurezza e alla conformità.
• Seguire la sicurezza e la corretta manutenzione dei segnatempo.
• Monitorare le attività di marketing dei concorrenti e fornire una regolare intelligenza di mercato alla Direzione.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il vostro team per creare un ambiente favorevole e positivo

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza di vendita nei marchi di lusso, premium retail o lifestyle.

• Langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden durch regelmäßige, nachdenkliche Follow-ups und exklusive Einladungen zu Events oder Starts.
• Verwalten und wachsen Sie ein aktives Client-Buch durch CRM-Tools und kundenspezifische Best Practices.
• Demonstrieren Sie Diskretion und Professionalität beim Servieren von hochkarätigen und internationalen Kunden.
• Marken- und Produktwissen
• Erhalten Sie fundiertes Produktwissen über Sammlungen und Neuheiten, einschließlich Bewegungen, Materialien und Handwerk.
• Bleiben Sie auf der Markengeschichte, wichtigen Meilensteinen und aktuellen Kampagnen, um Markengeschichte zu unterstützen.

• Nehmen Sie aktiv an der richtigen Wartung der Boutique teil: Produktdisplays, Props Set-up, etc.
• Unternehmen Verfahren und Richtlinien im Zusammenhang mit Betrieb, Kundenservice, Sicherheit und Compliance aufrechtzuerhalten.
• Folgen Sie der Sicherheit und ordnungsgemäßen Wartung von Aktenuhren.
• Überwachen Sie die Marketingaktivitäten der Wettbewerber und liefern Sie dem Management regelmäßige Marktinformationen.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Team zusammen, um eine unterstützende, positive Umgebung zu schaffen

jobs.description:
Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Cortina - Swatch Group

Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Cortina
The company
Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo steso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti.
Job description
Per uno dei nostri Corporate Store Swatch sito nell'area di Cortina, ricerchiamo uno/a ASSISTANT STORE MANAGER con pregressa esperienza in mansione analoga. L’Assistant Store Manager, garantirà il supporto allo Store Manager nel guidare e coordinare lo staff e le attività del negozio. Inoltre contribuirà alla massimizzazione del potenziale commerciale in linea con la strategia aziendale. Sarà il portavoce dei valori e della cultura SWATCH.
Profile
In particolare, le principali responsabilità saranno:
• Seguire il cliente in tutta la sua esperienza di vendita con l'obiettivo di fornire un eccellente servizio al cliente, indagando sulle opportunità, sviluppando soluzioni e fornendo un esempio attivo e costante allo staff nella risoluzione di simili sfide future.
• Garantire il servizio di assistenza tecnica post-vendita sul prodotto e la corretta applicazione della garanzia.
• Raggiungere e/o superare gli obiettivi di vendita.
• KPI quantitativi e qualitativi del negozio.
• Collaborare proattivamente con lo Store Manager per garantire che il negozio disponga di risorse adeguate al raggiungimento e al superamento degli obiettivi di performance.
• Supervisionare e garantire una formazione costante al team secondo le linee guida stabilite dallo Store Manager.
• Redigere l'agenda delle attività quotidiane, inclusa la pianificazione oraria dello staff.
• Gestire la sicurezza legata alle attività di cassa: procedure di pagamento, tax-free, processi di apertura e chiusura della cassa utilizzando i programmi dedicati, procedura depositi bancari.
• Garantire il mantenimento degli eccellenti standard di visual merchandising, rispettando le linee guida assegnate.
• Analizzare proattivamente le esigenze di inventario e di stock per garantire il corretto assortimento dei prodotti.
• Collaborare trasversalmente con i principali dipartimenti per garantire l’efficienza dell’utilizzo degli spazi del negozio e del loro mantenimento a livelli di eccellenza.
• Garantire l'analisi e il controllo dei prodotti in magazzino, e reportistica.
• Garantire il rispetto dei processi amministrativi e contabili.
• In accordo con lo Store Manager, garantire l'eccellenza delle attività in store con un costante focus sul cliente.
• Favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e coinvolgente e di ispirazione.
• Sguardo curioso e aperto alla scoperta costante di nuovi possibili talenti esterni da far entrare nel team.
Professional requirements
Ci piacerebbe incontrare candidati con i seguenti requisiti:
• Esperienza pregressa in ruolo analogo in aziende retail strutturate che operano attraverso un livello elevato di servizio e di consulenza al cliente.
• Ottime capacità di comunicazione.
• Capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione.
• Orientamento ai risultati e ottima capacità di analisi.
• Conoscenza approfondita della customer experience applicata al settore retail.
• Solida esperienza nel lavoro e nel raggiungimento di KPI e obiettivi di vendita.
• Capacità di stabilire le priorità, di lavorare con dinamismo e flessibilità e di comunicare in modo efficace
• Gestione della complessità e di operare in un ambiente multi-tasking.
• Ottimo utilizzo del feedback volto alla crescita e al miglioramento delle competenze delle risorse del team.
• Proattività, problem solving, capacità di lavorare in gruppo con spirito proattivo e positivo, grande attenzione ai dettagli.
• Iniziativa, dinamismo ed entusiasmo.
• Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese sia parlato che scritto.
• Conoscenza avanzata di MS Office, in particolare di Excel.

jobs.description:
Swatch Assistant Store Manager - Cherry Creek (Denver) - Swatch Group

Swatch Assistant Store Manager - Cherry Creek (Denver)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
We are seeking an experienced, retail Store Manager to provide leadership in our Swatch Store. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales, and delivering customer service skills.
Profile
Profile:
Drives sales and supports sales objectives
Performs daily activities of operating a specialty retail store
Work together with the Store Manager to direct a cohesive and high-functioning team
Sets the standard of a superior level of customer service and sales volume
Maintains visual merchandising standards
Develops and motivates staff; leads by example
Protects the security of cash, inventory, and other company assets according to guidelines and directives
Brings positive recognition to the SWATCH brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude and professionalism
Professional requirements
Professional 
• Requirements:
All candidates should have at least 3-5 years of experience in an Assistant Manager position, specialty retail preferred
Team-oriented
Creative approach to problem solving
Ability to think and react in a high-energy, fast-paced environment
Sense of responsibility and accountability
Proactive attitude
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1stof the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
Internal transfer and growth potential
$500 Employee Referral Bonuses
For more information, please see: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/
Hourly Rate: $25.00 - $28.00/Hr. plus commission
Job location
3000 1st Avenue
80206 Denver (Colorado)
United States
Company address
The Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc.
800 Waterford Way
Suite 1000
Miami, FL 33126

jobs.description:
Retail Sales Associate - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Associate
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Sales Associate at Hamilton, you will deliver exceptional customer service in line with brand standards while driving sales, supporting merchandising efforts, and protecting company assets. In this role, you will contribute to client outreach initiatives, help build brand awareness, and assist with the day-to-day operations of the boutique. You will also collaborate closely with the management team to achieve customer service excellence and meet sales objectives.
Responsibilities
• Provide a unique and special experience to all clients
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Maintain and grow existing clients; keep records of milestones and client’s tastes and goals for future purchases
• Assist in sales process as per established store protocols
• Communicate customer requests to management.
• Assist in the submission of daily reports and sales reconciliation reports
• Assist in processing and replenishing merchandise and monitoring counter stock.
• Develop existing client base and reach new prospects through networking and outreach
• Actively participate in merchandising projects, ie: daily stock maintenance, display changeovers, product transfers, etc…
• Provide superior after-sale service to all clients
• Provide the highest level of client service through personalized contact in product maintenance
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Team-oriented
• Actively support securing company assets through effective Loss Prevention in compliance with company policies and procedures
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Actively maintain the store appearance including keeping merchandise neatly organized and attractively displayed.
• All other duties assigned by Management
• Requirements
• Must have High School Diploma and/or equivalent
• Must possess a strong luxury retail jewelry and time piece experience
• All applicants should have 3-5 years of experience in a sales position, specialty luxury retail preferred
• Driven to deliver superior service by exceeding customer expectations
• Able to work well as a team player in a very fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to achieve sales goals and be goal oriented
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Must be able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
• The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
• Clientele building skills
• Must be able to demonstrate basic computer literacy
• Flexible to retail working hours including availability on weekends and holidays.
• Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
• Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
• Bilingual is a plus
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 3.5 weeks of PTO per year, 1 Month PTO after 5 years
• Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance

Vendita al dettaglio Associate - Swatch Group

Vendita al dettaglio
La Società
Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie.
Descrizione del lavoro
In qualità di Sales Associate di Hamilton, fornirete un servizio clienti eccezionale in linea con gli standard del marchio durante la guida delle vendite, sostenendo gli sforzi di merchandising e la protezione dei beni aziendali. In questo ruolo, contribuirete alle iniziative di outreach del cliente, contribuire a costruire la consapevolezza del marchio, e assistere con le operazioni quotidiane della boutique. Potrai anche collaborare a stretto contatto con il team di gestione per raggiungere l'eccellenza del servizio clienti e soddisfare gli obiettivi di vendita.
responsabilità
• Fornire un'esperienza unica e speciale a tutti i clienti
• Raggiungi e supera i tuoi obiettivi di vendita
• Mantenere e crescere clienti esistenti; tenere record di pietre miliari e gusti e obiettivi del cliente per gli acquisti futuri
• Assistere nel processo di vendita secondo i protocolli commerciali stabiliti
• Comunicare le richieste dei clienti alla gestione.
• Assistere nella presentazione delle relazioni quotidiane e dei rapporti di riconciliazione delle vendite
• Assistere nella lavorazione e ricostituire la merce e il banco di monitoraggio.
• Sviluppare la base client esistente e raggiungere nuove prospettive attraverso la rete e l'accesso
• Partecipa attivamente a progetti di merchandising, vale a dire: manutenzione giornaliera delle scorte, cambio di visualizzazione, trasferimenti di prodotti, ecc...
• Fornire un servizio post-vendita superiore a tutti i clienti
• Fornire il più alto livello di servizio client attraverso il contatto personalizzato nella manutenzione del prodotto
• Utilizzare la conoscenza e la selezione dei prodotti per fornire un servizio eccezionale e costruire relazioni con i clienti
• Team-oriented
• Supporto attivo per la protezione dei beni aziendali attraverso una efficace prevenzione dei perdite nel rispetto delle politiche e delle procedure aziendali
• Salutare i clienti in modo tempestivo, professionale e competente
• Mantenere attivamente l'aspetto del negozio, tra cui mantenere la merce ordinatamente organizzata e visualizzata in modo attraente.
• Tutte le altre funzioni assegnate dalla Direzione
• Requisiti
• Deve avere diploma di scuola superiore e/o equivalente
• Deve possedere un forte lusso vendita al dettaglio gioielli e l'esperienza di tempo pezzo
• Tutti i candidati dovrebbero avere 3-5 anni di esperienza in una posizione di vendita, specialità lusso retail preferito
• Guidati a fornire un servizio superiore superando le aspettative dei clienti
• In grado di lavorare bene come un giocatore di squadra in un ambiente molto veloce ed energico
• In grado di raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita ed essere orientato all'obiettivo
• Eccellente capacità verbali e interpersonali
• Essere un auto-avviamento e utilizzare il buon giudizio in tutte le situazioni

descriptionByLocale.de:
Retail Sales Associate - Swatch Group

Vertriebsmitarbeiter
Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Job Description
Als Sales Associate bei Hamilton bieten Sie einen außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice im Einklang mit Markenstandards, während Sie den Vertrieb, die Unterstützung von Merchandising-Bemühungen und den Schutz von Unternehmensvermögen vorantreiben. In dieser Rolle werden Sie zu Client-Outreach-Initiativen beitragen, helfen, das Markenbewusstsein aufzubauen und bei den täglichen Operationen der Boutique zu unterstützen. Sie werden auch eng mit dem Management-Team zusammenarbeiten, um Kundendienst Exzellenz zu erreichen und Vertriebsziele zu erreichen.
Aufgaben
• Bieten Sie allen Kunden ein einzigartiges und besonderes Erlebnis
• Erreichen Sie Ihre Verkaufsziele
• Bewahren und wachsen bestehende Kunden; halten Sie Aufzeichnungen über Meilensteine und Kundenwünsche und Ziele für zukünftige Einkäufe
• Assist im Verkaufsprozess nach etablierten Store-Protokollen
• Kommunikation von Kundenwünschen an das Management.
• Assist bei der Vorlage von Tagesberichten und Verkaufsabgleichsberichten
• Assist bei der Verarbeitung und Auffüllung von Waren und der Überwachung von Zählerständen.
• Entwickeln Sie bestehende Client-Basis und erreichen Sie neue Perspektiven durch Netzwerk und Outreach
• Nehmen Sie aktiv an Merchandising-Projekten teil, d.h.: tägliche Lagerhaltung, Displaywechsel, Produkttransfers usw....
• Stellen Sie allen Kunden einen überlegenen After-Sales-Service zur Verfügung
• Bereitstellung des höchsten Kundendiensts durch personalisierten Kontakt in der Produktwartung
• Verwenden Sie Produktwissen und Auswahl, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
• Teamorientiert
• Aktive Unterstützung bei der Sicherung von Unternehmensvermögen durch effektive Loss Prevention in Übereinstimmung mit den Unternehmenspolitiken und -verfahren
• Grüße Kunden in einer zeitnahen, professionellen und personablen Weise
• Aktiv halten Sie das Erscheinungsbild des Ladens, einschließlich der sauber organisierten und attraktiv angezeigten Waren zu halten.
• Alle anderen Aufgaben, die von Management zugewiesen werden
• Anforderungen
• Muss Hochschuldiplom und/oder gleichwertig sein
• Muss einen starken Luxus-Einzelhandel Schmuck und Zeitstück Erfahrung besitzen
• Alle Bewerber sollten 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Verkaufsposition, Spezial Luxus-Einzelhandel bevorzugt haben
• Überlegener Service durch Überschreitung der Kundenerwartungen
• Able, um auch einen Teamplayer in einer sehr schnellen, energetischen Umgebung zu arbeiten
• Able, um Verkaufsziele zu erreichen und zielorientiert zu sein
• Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
• Sei ein Selbststarter und nutze ein gutes Urteil in allen Situationen
• Muss in der Lage sein, sowohl als Teamplayer in einer schnellen, energetischen Umgebung zu arbeiten
• Muss in der Lage sein, das Niveau der Professionalität zu erhalten; freundlicher Demeanor;
• Die Fähigkeit, mit allen Ebenen des internen Managements und des Personals gut zu arbeiten
• Klientelbaufähigkeiten
• Muss in der Lage sein, grundlegende Computerkompetenz
• Flexibel für den Einzelhandel, einschließlich der Verfügbarkeit an Wochenenden und Feiertagen.
• Fähigkeit zum Multi-Task und zur Bewältigung der sich ändernden Prioritäten
• Kann gut mit minimaler Aufsicht arbeiten; Selbststarter
• Zweisprachig ist ein Plus
• Vorteile Programm
• Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet ist.
• Ausgezeichnete Kranken-, Zahn- und Sehversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag)
• Unmittelbare Teilnahme an der 401(k) und 100 % veraltetem Arbeitgeber nach einem Jahr (maximal 4% Arbeitgeber mit 5% Arbeitnehmerbeitrag)
• Unternehmen bezahlte Lebensversicherung und langfristige Behinderung
• 3,5 Wochen PTO pro Jahr, 1 Monat PTO nach 5 Jahren
• Spezielle Eimer kranker Zeit pro Jahr verlängerte bezahlte Zeit für medizinische, Eltern- und Militärurlaub
