Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Store Manager with Longines, you are responsible for driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientelling skills. You will manage, mentor, and develop a highly specialized sales team to the Company brand standard. You will own your brand at the store level. You will help to ensure all promotions, product training, and floor presentations are effectively in place to execute what will happen to drive sales today as well as for future growth. You will the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
• Responsibilities:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service,
• events, collaborating and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Experience in selling timepieces is a big plus.
• Ensure of proper staffing of the store thru recruitment and retention.
• Train and lead employees to successful selling and customer service.
• Responsible for achievement of annual sales goals
• Oversee assigning of monthly sales goals to associates
• Conduct regular management meetings to review performance, operations, and employee relations issues, and to discuss strategy with management team
• Review status of sales associates' clientele development, including review of client books
• Conduct orientation, train, coach, and manage all employees in execution of daily tasks and to maximize sales including completion of all reviews and performance assessment procedures.
• Collaborate with HR to oversee recruitment and hiring of store staff.
• Coordinate and actively participate in in-store activities, which include seasonal events, trunk shows, contests, and all involved tasks.
• Adhere to and oversee compliance of established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of
• Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, sales and record-keeping procedures, and overall maintenance of the store.
• Ensure that proper channels of communication exist between the store and Corporate Office.
• Help solve problems that affect the store's service, efficiency, and productivity.
• All other duties assigned by Management
• Requirements
• Must have a High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
• Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Business or equivalent preferred
• Must have 3-5+ years’ retail store experience; leadership experience with sales and luxury merchandise a plus
• Strong multi-dimensional leadership ability, enjoy working in a culturally diverse environment
• Able to make sound decisions with relevant facts at hand and drive for results
• Good problem solving skills
• Must be able understand and analyze financial details of retail business
• Ability to provide outstanding customer service in line with Brand expectations
• Excellent selling and customer service skills
• Work independently and on weekends and outside of regular office hours
• Fluency in English and other languages as required by location
• Must have excellent oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal skills.
• Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint)
• Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality
• Must be able to adhere to deadlines and response to inquiries within a require time frame
• Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
• The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
• Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
• Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
• Ability to deal with conflict and able to influence across functional lines
• Bilingual is a plus.
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Store Manager to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 5 - 7 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a work day. Requires to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to work an average of 40 hours per week. Finger dexterity is necessary.

• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 days of PTO per year

Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Store Manager - Austin (TX)
La Società
Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie.
Descrizione del lavoro
Come Store Manager con Longines, sei responsabile della guida delle vendite, della fornitura di un servizio clienti raffinato e della dimostrazione di forti competenze di clientela. Potrai gestire, mentore e sviluppare un team di vendita altamente specializzato allo standard del marchio aziendale. Possiederai il tuo marchio a livello negozio. Si contribuirà a garantire tutte le promozioni, formazione del prodotto e presentazioni del pavimento sono effettivamente in atto per eseguire ciò che accadrà per guidare le vendite oggi e per la crescita futura. Sarete il marchio, dentro e fuori la boutique.
Profilo
• Responsabilità:
• Capacità di costruire ricavi, gestire operazioni di back-office e supervisionare i professionisti della vendita.
• Sviluppare le strategie e i piani per raggiungere i risultati delle vendite attraverso la clientela, il servizio clienti superiore,
• eventi, collaborazioni e azioni generatrici di traffico.
• Assicurare un'esperienza di negozio coerente e di qualità per i clienti.
• Pensare strategicamente e guidare il business agli standard aziendali.
• Priorizzare, pianificare, delegare, amministrare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali.
• Massimizzare le tecniche di inventario, controllo dei contanti e prevenzione delle perdite.
• L'esperienza nella vendita di orologi è un grande vantaggio.
• Assicurare un corretto personale del negozio di reclutamento e di ritenzione.
• Formare e portare i dipendenti alla vendita di successo e al servizio clienti.
• Responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita annuali
• Superare l'assegnazione degli obiettivi di vendita mensili agli associati
• Condurre riunioni di gestione regolari per rivedere le prestazioni, le operazioni e le relazioni con i dipendenti, e discutere la strategia con il team di gestione
• Stato di revisione dello sviluppo della clientela dei partner commerciali, inclusa la revisione dei libri dei clienti
• Condurre l'orientamento, il treno, l'allenatore e gestire tutti i dipendenti nell'esecuzione dei compiti quotidiani e massimizzare le vendite, compreso il completamento di tutte le recensioni e le procedure di valutazione delle prestazioni.
• Collaborare con le risorse umane per supervisionare il reclutamento e l'assunzione del personale del negozio.
• Coordinare e partecipare attivamente alle attività di deposito, che includono eventi stagionali, spettacoli di tronchi, concorsi e tutte le attività coinvolte.
• Adeguarsi e supervisionare la conformità delle politiche e degli standard aziendali consolidati, come il mantenimento della sicurezza
• Fondi aziendali e proprietà, pratiche del personale, procedure di sicurezza, vendite e registrazione, e la manutenzione complessiva del negozio.
• Assicurarsi che esistano canali di comunicazione appropriati tra il negozio e l'Ufficio aziendale.
• Aiuta a risolvere i problemi che influiscono sul servizio, sull'efficienza e sulla produttività del negozio.
• Tutte le altre funzioni assegnate dalla Direzione
• Requisiti
• Deve avere un diploma di scuola superiore, GED o equivalente
• Laurea in Management, Business o equivalente preferito
• Deve avere esperienza di negozio al dettaglio di 3-5 anni; esperienza di leadership con vendite e merce di lusso un plus
• Forte capacità di leadership multidimensionale, godere di lavorare in un ambiente culturalmente vario
• In grado di prendere decisioni sonore con fatti pertinenti a portata di mano e guidare per i risultati
• Buone capacità di problem solving
• Deve essere in grado di comprendere e analizzare i dettagli finanziari del commercio al dettaglio
• Capacità di fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale in linea con le aspettative del marchio
• Eccellente capacità di vendita e servizio clienti
• Lavorare in modo indipendente e nei fine settimana e al di fuori delle ore di ufficio regolari
• Fluency in inglese e in altre lingue come richiesto dalla posizione
• Deve avere eccellenti capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta; forti capacità interpersonali.
• Deve essere competente in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint)
• Deve essere organizzato, accurato, accurato e in grado di monitorare il lavoro per la qualità
• Deve essere in grado di rispettare le scadenze e la risposta alle richieste entro un periodo di tempo necessario
• Deve essere in grado di sostenere il livello di professionalità;
• La capacità di lavorare bene con tutti i livelli di gestione interna e personale
• Capacità di multi-task e gestire priorità mutevoli
• In grado di lavorare bene con una supervisione minima; autostarter
• Capacità di affrontare i conflitti e in grado di influenzare le linee funzionali
• bilingue è un plus.
Questa è principalmente una posizione attiva, che richiede al Manager Store di avere la capacità di sopportare circa 5 – 8 ore al giorno di solito 5 - 7 giorni alla settimana. Durante i periodi di vendita di picco (ad esempio Holiday, Back-to-School), lavorerà per lunghi periodi durante una giornata lavorativa. Richiede per scalare o salire/descendere scale per immagazzinare e/o acquisire merce in vendita. Richiesto per sollevare oggetti di peso 5 – 25 lbs regolarmente senza assistenza. In determinate circostanze, i pesi possono essere più alti. Richiesto di lavorare una media di 40 ore alla settimana. La destrezza del cervo è necessaria.

• Fähigkeit, Einnahmen zu errichten, Backoffice-Operationen zu verwalten und den Verkauf von Fachleuten zu überwachen.

• Veranstaltungen, gemeinsame und verkehrserzeugende Aktionen.

entreprises. • Maximiser les techniques d'inventaire, de contrôle de la trésorerie et de prévention des pertes. • L'expérience dans la vente de montres est un grand plus. • Assurer un personnel adéquat du magasin grâce au recrutement et au maintien en poste. • Former et conduire les employés à la vente réussie et au service à la clientèle. • Responsable de la réalisation des objectifs annuels des ventes • Superviser l'attribution des objectifs mensuels des ventes aux associés • Organiser des réunions de gestion régulières pour examiner les questions de performance, d'exploitation et de relations avec les employés, et discuter de la stratégie avec l'équipe de gestion • Examiner l'état du développement de la clientèle des associés commerciaux, y compris l'examen des livres des clients • Mener des activités d'orientation, de formation, d'encadrement et de gestion de tous les employés dans l'exécution des tâches quotidiennes et pour maximiser les ventes, y compris l'achèvement de tous les examens et les procédures d'évaluation des performances. • Collaborer avec les RH pour superviser le recrutement et l'embauche du personnel des magasins. • Coordonner et participer activement aux activités en magasin, y compris les événements saisonniers, les foires, les concours et toutes les tâches concernées. • Respecter et surveiller le respect des politiques et normes établies de la Société, telles que la conservation des fonds et des biens de la Société, les pratiques en matière de personnel, les procédures de sécurité, de vente et de tenue des registres, et l'entretien général du magasin. • Veiller à ce qu'il existe des voies de communication appropriées entre le magasin et le bureau de l'entreprise. • Aider à résoudre les problèmes qui affectent le service, l'efficacité et la productivité du magasin. • Toutes les autres fonctions assignées par la direction • Exigences • Doit avoir un diplôme d'études secondaires, un diplôme d'études secondaires ou un diplôme équivalent • Baccalauréat Diplôme en gestion, entreprise ou équivalent préféré • Doit avoir 3-5+ ans d'expérience en magasin de détail; expérience de leadership avec des ventes et des marchandises de luxe a plus • Forte capacité de leadership multidimensionnel, profiter de travailler dans un environnement culturellement diversifié • Capable de prendre des décisions éclairées avec des faits pertinents à portée de main et d'obtenir des résultats • Bonnes compétences en résolution de problèmes • Doit être capable de comprendre et d'analyser les détails financiers du commerce de détail • Capacité de fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en fonction des attentes de la marque • Excellentes compétences en vente et en service à la clientèle • Travail indépendant et le week-end et en dehors des heures de bureau régulières • Fluence en anglais et dans d'autres langues selon le lieu • Doit avoir d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite; compétences interpersonnelles fortes. • Doivent être compétents en Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint) • Doivent être organisés, précis, approfondis et capables de surveiller le travail pour assurer la qualité • Doivent être en mesure de respecter les délais et de répondre aux demandes dans les délais requis • Doivent être en mesure de maintenir le niveau de professionnalisme; comportement amical; • La capacité de bien travailler avec tous les niveaux de la gestion interne et du personnel • Capacité de multitâcher et de gérer l'évolution des priorités • Capacité de bien travailler avec une supervision minimale; auto-démarrage • Capacité de gérer les conflits et de pouvoir influencer les différentes lignes fonctionnelles • Bilingue est un plus. jobs.description:
Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As an Assistant Store Manager with Longines, the position will responsible for assisting in directing the efforts of, and is responsible for, the results of the store and sales associates. This includes but is not limited to: accomplishing and exceeding store wide sales targets, providing support to Store Manager, assist in training; coaching of retail staff, retaining and building client relationships, as well as actively seek new client relationships. This person must be energetic and enthusiastic, be willing to engage customers with a sales-minded attitude, and display pride in our stores through strong work ethics, organizational skills and cleanliness. You will the brand, inside and outside the boutique.
Profile
Duties and 
• Responsibilities
Performs daily activities of operating boutique as per company standards inclusive of maximizing inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Assist with the implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clienteling, superior customer service, events, partnering, and traffic generating actions.
Deliver sells results as per company goals.
Delegate and assign tasks to the sales team.
Assist in the development sales incentives and rewards within the store.
Ensures a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
Brings positive recognition to the brand through effective communication, enthusiastic attitude, professionalism and in-depth brand knowledge.
Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
Train and lead employees to successful selling and customer service.
Partner with the Store Manager to ensure that proper channels of communication exist between the store and Corporate Office.
Help solve problems that affect the store's service, efficiency, and productivity.
Partnering with Store Manager on the responsibilities of the achievement of annual sales goals
Collaborate with the Store Manager on the coordination of the in-store activities, which include seasonal events, trunk shows, contests, and all involved tasks.
Adhere to and oversee compliance of established Company policies and standards, such as safekeeping of Company funds and property, personnel practices, security, sales and record-keeping procedures, and overall maintenance of the store.
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education and Experience 
• Requirements
Must have a High School Diploma, GED or equivalent
Bachelor’s Degree in Management, Business or equivalent preferred
Must have 3-5+ years’ retail store experience; leadership experience with sales and merchandise a plus
Good problem solving skills
Ability to provide outstanding customer service in line with Brand expectations
Excellent selling and customer service skills
Work independently and on weekends and outside of regular office hours
Fluency in English and other languages as required by location
Must have excellent oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal skills.
Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint)
Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality
Must be able to adhere to deadlines and response to inquiries within a require time frame
Must be able to sustain level of professionalism; friendly demeanor;
The ability to work well with all levels of internal management and staff
Ability to multi-task and handle changing priorities
Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter
Ability to deal with conflict and able to influence across functional lines
Physical 
• Requirements
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Assistant Store Manager to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 3 – 5 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a 1 – 12 hour day. May be required to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to work an average of 48 hours per week. operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX)
La Società
Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie.
Descrizione del lavoro
In qualità di Assistant Store Manager con Longines, la posizione sarà responsabile per aiutare a dirigere gli sforzi di, ed è responsabile, i risultati dei partner commerciali e commerciali. Ciò include, ma non è limitato a: raggiungere e superare obiettivi di vendita ampi, fornire supporto a Store Manager, assistere nella formazione; coaching del personale di vendita al dettaglio, mantenere e costruire relazioni con i clienti, così come attivamente cercare nuove relazioni con i clienti. Questa persona deve essere energica ed entusiasta, essere disposti a coinvolgere i clienti con un atteggiamento di vendita-minded, e mostrare l'orgoglio nei nostri negozi attraverso una forte etica del lavoro, capacità organizzative e pulizia. Sarete il marchio, dentro e fuori la boutique.
Profilo
Doveri e
• Responsabilità
Esegui le attività quotidiane della boutique operativa secondo gli standard aziendali inclusi nel massimizzare l'inventario, il controllo dei contanti e le tecniche di prevenzione delle perdite.
Assistere con l'implementazione delle strategie e dei piani per raggiungere i risultati delle vendite attraverso la clientela, il servizio clienti superiore, gli eventi, la collaborazione e le azioni generatrici del traffico.
Fornire vende i risultati secondo gli obiettivi aziendali.
Delegare e assegnare compiti al team di vendita.
Assistere nello sviluppo incentivi e premi di vendita all'interno del negozio.
Garantisce una costante esperienza di negozio di qualità per i clienti.
Porta un riconoscimento positivo al marchio attraverso una comunicazione efficace, un atteggiamento entusiasta, una professionalità e una conoscenza approfondita del marchio.
Priorizzare, pianificare, delegare, amministrare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali.
Massimizzare l'inventario, il controllo dei contanti e le tecniche di prevenzione della perdita.
Formare e portare i dipendenti alla vendita di successo e al servizio clienti.

Luxury Assistant Store Manager - Austin (TX)
Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Job Description
Als Assistant Store Manager bei Longines wird die Position dafür verantwortlich sein, die Bemühungen der Geschäfts- und Vertriebsmitarbeiter zu leiten und dafür verantwortlich zu sein. Dies umfasst, ist jedoch nicht beschränkt auf: Erledigung und Überschreitung von umfangreichen Verkaufszielen, Unterstützung für Store Manager, Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung; Coaching von Retail-Mitarbeitern, Halten und Aufbau von Kundenbeziehungen, sowie aktive Suche nach neuen Kundenbeziehungen. Diese Person muss energisch und enthusiastisch sein, bereit sein, Kunden mit einer verkaufsgefährdeten Einstellung zu beschäftigen und Stolz in unseren Läden durch starke Arbeitsethik, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Sauberkeit zu zeigen. Sie werden die Marke, innen und außerhalb der Boutique.

Zölle und
• Aufgaben

Deliver verkauft Ergebnisse nach Unternehmenszielen.
Aufgaben des Vertriebsteams übertragen und zuweisen.
Assist in der Entwicklung Verkäufe Anreize und Belohnungen im Geschäft.
Vergewissert sich für Kunden ein gleichbleibendes Qualitäts-Shop-Erlebnis.
Bringt positive Anerkennung für die Marke durch effektive Kommunikation, enthusiastische Einstellung, Professionalität und fundiertes Markenwissen.
Priorisieren, planen, delegieren, administrieren und sich an die Geschäftsbedürfnisse anpassen.
Maximieren Sie Inventar-, Cash-Control- und Verlustvorbeugungstechniken.
Trainieren und führen Mitarbeiter zu einem erfolgreichen Verkauf und Kundendienst.
Partner mit dem Store Manager, um sicherzustellen, dass die richtigen Kommunikationskanäle zwischen dem Store und dem Corporate Office bestehen.

Partnerschaft mit Store Manager über die Verantwortung für die Erreichung von Jahresabschlüssen

Chef de magasin adjoint de luxe - Austin (TX)
La société
Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.
Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. En tant que directeur adjoint du magasin chez Longines, le poste sera chargé d'aider à diriger les efforts et les résultats du magasin et des associés commerciaux. Cette personne doit être énergique et enthousiaste, être disposée à engager les clients avec une attitude d'esprit de vente, et faire preuve de fierté dans nos magasins grâce à une éthique de travail forte, des compétences organisationnelles et la propreté. Vous serez la marque, à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de la boutique.

Maximiser les techniques d'inventaire, de contrôle de la trésorerie et de prévention des pertes.

Luxury Retail Keyholder - Austin (TX) - Swatch Group

Luxury Retail Keyholder - Austin (TX)
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. As a Retail Keyholder with Longines, you will responsible for demonstrating outstanding customer service and leadership on the selling floor. You will help build and implement client outreach initiatives, build brand awareness, and assist in daily operations of the store. You will support and assist the management team in achieving all customer service and sales goals initiatives. You will also assist management in leading the team of associates to ensure operational tasks and procedures are successful as well as opening and closing routines are completed, all while keeping the customer at the forefront. You will represent and demonstrate the brand, inside and outside the boutique.

Reach & exceed your sales goals
Develop potential clients through both client outreach and networking efforts
Maintain and grow existing clients; keep records of milestones and client’s tastes and goals for future purchases

Develop existing client base and reach new prospects through networking and outreach
Provide superior after-sale service to all clients

Team-oriented

Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
All other duties assigned by Management

Must possess a strong luxury retail jewelry and time piece experience

Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. In certain circumstances, weights may be higher. Required to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

jobs.description:
Sales Assistant - part time 20 ore - Modena - contratto temporaneo - Swatch Group

Sales Assistant - part time 20 ore - Modena - contratto temporaneo
The company
Swatch Group è leader mondiale nella produzione e commercializzazione di orologi finiti, sinonimo di prodotti di lusso o di consumo al tempo stesso durevoli, emozionali e di alta qualità. La presenza del Gruppo a livello mondiale è rafforzata dalla costante apertura di nuovi punti vendita Corporate, punti vendita che riflettono i valori delle singole marche distribuite e ne esaltano le caratteristiche. The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. è la filiale italiana della multinazionale svizzera The Swatch Group Ltd, vanta dipendenti impiegati sia presso la sede di Milano in attività marketing, sales e di servizi sia nei Corporate Stores e Boutique siti sul territorio nazionale nei centri città, nei centri commerciali, presso gli aeroporti.
Job description
DINAMICITA’, SFIDA, INNOVAZIONE, PASSIONE, sono parole nelle quali ti riconosci? Allora siamo noi il tuo futuro lavorativo! The Swatch Group (Italia) S.p.A. ricerca nuovi talenti da inserire nei nostri negozi Corporate a marchio SWATCH di Modena come venditori part time 20 ore, con contratto temporaneo. In qualità di sales assistant garantirai un’esperienza di vendita eccellente ai nostri clienti, dal punto di vista della cura e realizzazione dei desideri. Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. Parteciperai all’organizzazione del negozio assicurandoti che il punto vendita, il back office e lo stock siano sempre in ordine. Inoltre garantirai la corretta presentazione dell'immagine dei brand SWATCH e FLIK FLAK.
Profile
- Hai esperienza nel Retail (vendita/gestione resi/ordini etc..)
- Hai orientamento commerciale
- Sei dinamico e flessibile
- Sei disponibile a lavorare su turni avvicendati
- Hai buone doti relazionali e buone capacità comunicative
- Hai una buona capacità di identificare gli interlocutori ed adattare la comunicazione e l’interazione con essi a seconda delle situazioni (ad es. gestione obiezioni e conflitti)
- Sei un problem solver di natura
Professional requirements
Hai dimestichezza con il PC ed il pacchettoOffice e gli applicativi di comunicazione. Conosci i principali strumenti informatici ed hai un’elevata predisposizione all’uso della tecnologia. Per qualcuno l’orologio misura “solo” il tempo, per noi scandisce in ogni minuto la nostra vera passione! Unisciti a NOI! Vini a far parte del nostro Team!
Languages
Hai un’ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, la conoscenza di altre lingue sarà considerata un plus.
Contact

Job location
Via Emilia 141/143
41121 Modena (Emilia Romagna)

jobs.title: Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall)
jobs.description:
Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall) - Swatch Group

Sales Associate (Conestoga Mall)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Associate, you will report to the Store Manager and be responsible for achieving sales targets. You will act as a Swatch Brand Ambassador while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
Starting base pay of $18.05 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Deliver exceptional customer service by assisting customers and resolving issues with a positive attitude. Achieve and exceed sales targets though outstanding product knowledge.
• Operations: Support daily operations, including processing sales and returns, inventory management, and adhering to operation policies and procedures.
• Visual Merchandising: Assist in maintaining store’s visual standards by following visual merchandising guidelines. Assists in maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the store.
• Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards.
• Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS
Employment Status:
Part-Time: 10 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 10 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 1 year of retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Experience working with POS systems.
• Job location
• 550 King St N
• N2L 5W6 Toronto MV B (Ontario)
• Canada
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
• 555, Richmond Street West
• Suite 1105
• CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario

jobs.title: PR & Events Manager
jobs.description:
PR & Events Manager - Swatch Group

PR & Events Manager
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Public Relations & Events Manager with Rado, U.S. & Caribbean, the position will be responsible for developing and implementing the brand’s PR and media strategy, building its reputation, image and ensuring effective media coverage along with events execution. As a PR & Events Manager, you will draft or oversee the creation of media releases and content on various media channels, forge relationships with journalists and key influencers and manage the response to time- sensitive and critical situations. The PR & Events Manager will be responsible for day-to-day media relations activities for the Brand.
Profile
Primary Duties and 
• Responsibilities
Grow brand awareness and market share through strategic product PR campaigns
Works collaboratively with Marketing Manager to align PR strategy with business/marketing communications objectives and to support overall marketing plans.
Manage yearly planning and implementation of product PR campaigns under guidance from the global marketing communications team and in close collaboration with local marketing management (MM).
Develop public relations strategies for current and existing products, launches, and promotions
Generate new ideas and opportunities to ensure brands’ success
Develop and produce high-quality, informative, and interesting press releases, press kits, and related materials if not provided by HQ
Act as project lead for PR initiatives from concept development through execution.
Create presentations, reports, and information for multiple communication channels
Responsible for U.S. media relations, manage contacts, and facilitate networking for SG Corporate and brand executive.
Ensure proactive contact with the different media through regular interaction.
Manage and send watches as needed for photoshoots, PR placements, etc.
Analyzes the quantitative and qualitative outputs of PR programs and placements to maximize effectiveness and ROI.
Create and manage PR budget including the deadlines, objectives and schedule and invoicing process
Events
Plan and execute all local and national events for the Rado Brand in the US with retail partners, national branding events, PR events and sponsorships
Manage overall event responsibilities including location scouting and selection, all planning, run-of-show creation and management, creative theme development, travel management, security coordination, on-site permits and logistics
Implement planning timelines to coordinate pre-event proposals, approvals and logistics, set-up, on-site team schedule, and overall run of events
Pre-event preparation and approvals and post-event recaps and analysis preparation
Develop weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual media activity reports
Consistently brainstorm and collaborate with team for new ideas and strategies
Develop and maintain good relationships with media and industry leaders
Oversee the event budget, including budget planning, monitoring, and SAP administrative processes
Create presentations, articles, reports, and information for web sites, blogs, and social media accounts
Domestic and International travel required
All other duties assigned by Management
Requirements
Education & Experience Requirement
Must have 7 or more years of related PR experience (consumer luxury products, media, agency, corporate environment)
Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Advertising, Journalism, Marketing or Business
Must have knowledge and experience of traditional and new / social / digital media PR tactics.
Excellent communication and writing skills are essential
Event Planning experience
Strong media contacts and relations with a record of success in securing national and top-tier media placements
Ability to foster relationships and maintain connections
Must thrive in a fast-paced, fluid environment and be able to prioritize multiple responsibilities, projects
Able to work weekends as needed; Travel up to 35%
Physical 
• Requirements:
This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Public Relations & Events Manager to have the ability to move about the office occasionally, operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.
Additional Skill 
• Requirements:
Able to organize and execute events
Savvy in social media
Able to identify and work closely with bloggers and influencers.
Must be a confident communicator and presenter
Ability to work in high-stress environments, often for long hours
Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;
Must possess strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills with multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced corporate environment;
Arrive early and work late if necessary
Understand and follow posted work rules and procedures
Accept constructive feedback
Must be a team player
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Public Relations & Events Manager. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year, 1 Month PTO after 5 years
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

descriptionByLocale.fr: PR & Events Manager - Swatch Group PR & Events Manager La société Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, mouvements de montres et composants. Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de vente au détail multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important des technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe indispensables à l'horlogerie et à d'autres industries. En tant que gestionnaire des relations publiques et des événements, vous rédigerez ou superviserez la création de communiqués de presse et de contenus sur divers canaux médiatiques, établirez des relations avec les journalistes et les principaux influenceurs et gérerez la réponse aux situations critiques et sensibles au temps. Le gestionnaire PR & Events sera responsable des activités quotidiennes de relations avec les médias pour la marque. Profil Fonctions principales et responsabilités Accroître la sensibilisation à la marque et la part de marché grâce à des campagnes stratégiques de relations publiques Travaille en collaboration avec le directeur du marketing afin d'harmoniser la stratégie de relations publiques avec les objectifs de communication commerciale et commerciale et de soutenir les plans de marketing globaux. Gérer la planification et la mise en œuvre annuelles des campagnes de relations publiques sous la direction de l'équipe de communication marketing mondial et en étroite collaboration avec la gestion marketing locale (MM). Élaborer des stratégies de relations publiques pour les produits, les lancements et les promotions actuels et existants Générer de nouvelles idées et des occasions d'assurer la réussite des marques Élaborer et produire des communiqués de presse, des dossiers de presse et des documents connexes de haute qualité, informatifs et intéressants, s'il n'est pas fourni par la Loi sur l'AC comme chef de projet pour les initiatives de relations publiques, de l'élaboration de concepts à l'exécution. Créer des présentations, des rapports et de l'information pour de multiples canaux de communication Responsable des relations avec les médias américains, gérer les contacts et faciliter le réseautage pour SG Corporate et les dirigeants de marque. Assurer un contact proactif avec les différents médias grâce à une interaction régulière. Gérer et envoyer les montres au besoin pour les séances photo, les placements PR, etc. Analyser les extrants quantitatifs et qualitatifs des programmes de relations publiques et des placements pour maximiser l'efficacité et le rendement. jobs.description:
Credit Representative - Swatch Group

Credit Representative
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Credit Representative with the Swatch Group, you will support both accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including collections, customer account management, invoice processing, vendor payments, reconciliations, and credit-related administrative activities. You will collaborate with internal teams, brands, and retailers to ensure financial accuracy, timely processing, and strong customer service.
Profile
Primary Duties and 
• Responsibilities
Review customer orders on hold daily and release within authorized limits or obtain required approvals.
Perform daily collection activities for assigned customer accounts, including past due and upcoming balances.
Obtain payment remittance details for unapplied payments within 48 hours whenever possible.
Complete monthly customer accounts receivable reconciliations and document action plans for resolution.
Maintain accounts receivable and deduction levels within established company guidelines.
Partner with brands and retailers to address credit-related needs and support account resolution.
Minimize bad debt exposure through proactive account management and collection efforts.
Research and resolve customer chargebacks and deductions within established timelines.
Process customer credit card payments and provide receipts to the appropriate internal contact.
Prepare and distribute customer statements and other requested account information in a timely manner.
Maintain accurate and current customer master data and submit updates as needed.
Document collection efforts and retain customer records in accordance with internal control requirements.
Prepare customer account offsets and required adjustments prior to month-end close
Additional 
• Responsibilities
Provide support for special projects, reporting, and other assignments as directed by the Credit Manager or senior management.
Maintain confidentiality of financial, customer, and company information.
Collaborate with team members to ensure deadlines, service expectations, and compliance standards are met.
Support process improvement efforts within AR and credit operations.
Work additional hours as needed to meet business demands and critical deadlines.
Requirements
Education and Experience 
• Requirements
Associate degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of two years of experience in finance, credit, accounts receivable, collections, chargebacks, or reconciliations required.
Experience working in a high-volume transactional environment preferred.
Physical 
• Requirements:
Must be able to operate a computer and other standard office equipment.
Must be able to communicate effectively, including speaking and hearing.
Ability to bend, stoop, reach, and perform repetitive hand and finger movements.
Must be able to lift, move, and carry up to 25 pounds on an occasional basis.
Additional Skill 
• Requirements:
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Experience using SAP or similar ERP/accounting systems preferred.
Working knowledge of accounts receivable, collections, reconciliations, and basic credit processes, including order review, release and order management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Professional demeanor with strong interpersonal and customer service skills.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
Self-motivated, dependable, and adaptable to changing priorities.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Credit Representative. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time with or without notice.
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
For more information please see https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/

Omega Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Chicago - Swatch Group

Omega Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Chicago
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
Omega Brookfield Place Boutique looking for an ideal candidate that has relevant luxury retail sales experience and possess exceptional customer service skills. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our prestigious timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team.

descriptionByLocale.de: Omega Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Chicago - Swatch Group Omega Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Chicago Das Unternehmen OMEGA ist ein Unternehmen der Swatch Group, dem weltweit führenden Uhrenhersteller. Der Wahlbewerber sollte eine bewährte Erfolgsbilanz mit früheren Luxusunternehmen haben. Candidate sollte auch die Fähigkeit haben, die Verkaufsziele zu erfüllen oder zu überschreiten und einen starken Wunsch zu besitzen, über unsere angesehenen Uhren zu lernen und zu einem wesentlichen Mitglied unseres Teams zu werden. • Erweitern Sie ein tiefes Wissen über alle unsere einzigartigen und unpassbaren Produktpaletten und deren Besonderheiten • Erweitern Sie dauerhafte Beziehungen mit Kunden durch die Bereitstellung von unvergesslichen Erfahrungen, die • Erleuchtung und Fähigkeit, Einblicke in die Vorfahren von OMEGA • Nutzen Sie unsere umfangreichen Schulungstechniken, um sich zu engagieren, zu informieren und zu halten • Benefits-Programm • Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet ist. • Ausgezeichnete Kranken-, Zahn- und Sehversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag) • Sofortige Teilnahme an der 401(k) und 100 % des Arbeitgebers nach einem Jahr (maximal 4% Arbeitgeber mit 5% Arbeitnehmerbeitrag) • Unternehmen bezahlte Lebensversicherung und Langzeitarbeitslosigkeit • 18 PTO-Tage pro Jahr, 23 PTO nach 5 Jahren • 7 Tage pro Jahr ausgezahlte Zeit

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Aventura Mall - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Aventura Mall
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job Description:
At Swatch we provide our Retail Key holders with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.
Profile
Job 
• Profile:
Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
Reach & exceed your sales goals
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
Handle multi-tasking with ease
Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
Professional requirements
Professional 
• Requirements:
3-5 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
Able to plan, set and achieve goals
Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer the following benefits to our part-time positions:
Excellent health insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Employee product discount
TransitChek Program - Save money on commuting to work and/or parking with pre-tax dollars
Internal transfer and growth potential
Compensation: Base Pay plus Commission

Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. A Swatch forniamo ai nostri portachiavi al dettaglio la formazione e il supporto che pone le basi per una carriera professionale con slancio reale. Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Roosevelt Field (NY)

Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti.
Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nel mondo dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia, e li dona la propria scintilla di creatività. In grado di lavorare bene come un giocatore di squadra in un ambiente veloce e energico
In grado di pianificare, impostare e raggiungere gli obiettivi
Eccellente capacità verbali e interpersonali

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Intl. Plaza & Bay Street (Tampa)
Das Unternehmen
Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.
Swatch Group vereint unter anderem die folgenden Uhrenmarken unter seinem Dach: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch und Flik Flak. Die Gruppe verfügt über ein starkes Vertriebs- und Multi-Marken-Einzelhandelsnetz mit zwei anspruchsvollen Boutiquen unter dem Namen Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Player in fortschrittlichen nanomechanischen, nanoelektronischen und Bluetooth-Technologien, die für die Uhrmacherei und andere Branchen unerlässlich sind.
Jobbeschreibung
Swatch umfasst die Werte, die in der Welt der Kunst, des Designs, der Mode und der Technologie koexistieren, und verleiht ihnen einen eigenen Funken von Kreativität. So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Cutting Edge-Stil, Trend-Setting-Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen einer Swatch hinzugefügt.
Job Beschreibung:
Bei Swatch bieten wir unseren Retail Key-Haltern die Ausbildung und Unterstützung, die den Grundstein für eine berufliche Karriere mit echtem Momentum legt. Als Mitglied des Retail Sales Teams werden Sie auf Verkaufstechniken und Kundendienstfähigkeiten sowie technische Schulungen zu all unseren Uhren und Dienstleistungen trainiert. Darüber hinaus ist Ihre Basis-Plus-Bezahlstruktur so konzipiert, dass der Himmel die Grenze für motivierte und kompetente Einzelhandelsverkäufer ist.
Profil
Stellen
• Profil:
Grüße Kunden auf zeitnahe, professionelle und personable Weise
Verwenden Sie Produktwissen und Auswahl, um außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten und Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen
Erreichen Sie Ihre Verkaufsziele
Sei ein Selbststarter und nutze gutes Urteil in allen Situationen
Multitasking mit Leichtigkeit handhaben
Durchführung von Merchandising-Aufgaben; Bestandsauffüllung, visuelle Anzeige und Aktualisierung der Organisation und Sauberkeit der Speicherumgebung
Professionelle Anforderungen
Beruf
• Anforderungen:
3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Key-Halter- oder Lead-Vertriebsposition
Angetrieben, um Ihren Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten
Kunden in die Kultur der Marke SWATCH einbinden
In der Lage zu arbeiten, sowie ein Teamplayer in einer schnellen, energetischen Umgebung
Fähigkeit, Ziele zu planen, zu setzen und zu erreichen
Ausgezeichnete verbale und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
Vorteile Programm
Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet, und wir freuen uns, unseren Teilzeitstellen folgende Vorteile zu bieten:
Ausgezeichnete Krankenversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag)
Mitarbeiter Produktrabatt
TransitChek Programm - Sparen Sie Geld auf Kommutierung zu arbeiten und/oder Parkplatz mit Vorsteuer-Dollar
Internes Transfer- und Wachstumspotenzial
Vergütung: Basisentgelt plus Kommission

La société
Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.
Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de distribution multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important dans les technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe essentielles à l'horlogerie et à d'autres industries.
Description du poste
Swatch embrasse les valeurs qui coexistent dans le monde de l'art, du design, de la mode et de la technologie, et leur prête sa propre étincelle de créativité. Ainsi, Swatch est considéré comme une toile sur laquelle une myriade d'expressions ont été appliquées. Le style de pointe, les looks de réglage des tendances et les accents favorables à la technologie ont tous ajouté à l'étonnement de posséder un Swatch.
Description du travail :
Chez Swatch, nous fournissons à nos détenteurs de clés de vente au détail la formation et le soutien qui jettent les bases d'une carrière professionnelle dynamique. En tant que membre de l'équipe de vente au détail, vous serez entraîné sur les techniques de vente et les compétences de service à la clientèle ainsi que la formation technique sur toutes nos montres et services. De plus, votre structure de paye de base plus commission est conçue de manière à ce que le ciel soit la limite pour les professionnels de vente au détail motivés et compétents.
Profil
Emploi
• Profil:
Saluez les clients de façon opportune, professionnelle et personnelle
Utiliser les connaissances et la sélection des produits pour fournir un service exceptionnel et établir des relations avec la clientèle
Atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs commerciaux
Soyez un autodémarrant et utilisez le bon jugement dans toutes les situations
Poignée multi-tâches avec facilité
Effectuer des tâches de merchandising; réapprovisionnement des stocks, affichage visuel et entretien de l'organisation et de la propreté de l'environnement de magasin
Exigences professionnelles
Professionnel
• Exigences:
3-5 ans d'expérience dans une position clé ou de vente en tête
Conduit pour offrir un service supérieur à vos clients
Faites participer vos clients à la culture de la marque SWATCH
Capable de bien travailler en tant que joueur d'équipe dans un environnement rapide et énergique
Capacité de planifier, de fixer et d'atteindre des objectifs
Excellentes compétences verbales et interpersonnelles
Programme de prestations
Le Swatch Group est un employeur à égalité de chances qui promeut la diversité et s'engage pour la durabilité environnementale et nous sommes heureux d'offrir les avantages suivants à nos postes à temps partiel :
Excellente assurance maladie (les employés et les personnes à charge sont admissibles au 1er du mois suivant 30 jours; généreuse contribution de l'employeur)

Transfert interne et potentiel de croissance
Rémunération: salaire de base plus la Commission

jobs.description:
Field Operation Manager - Swatch Group

Field Operation Manager
The company
Launched in 1983, Swatch is one of the world’s most iconic Swiss watchmakers, celebrated for its creativity, bold design, and provocative spirit. Constantly innovating, Swatch surprises with new models, special editions, and vibrant collaborations. The brand thrives in sports, art, and culture, offering watches as unique canvases of self-expression. With dynamic retail spaces worldwide, Swatch ambassadors bring energy, storytelling, and passion to life.
• Join us and be part of a brand that champions innovation, individuality, and joy!
• Job description
• What You'll Be Doing
• Sales & Business Performance
• Provide regular, hands-on coaching to store teams to improve sales productivity and achieve sales target.
• Analyze sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement action plans to drive improvements.
• Customer Experience & Brand Standards
• Ensure stores consistently deliver the Swatch customer experience.
• Monitor and address customer service issues, implementing improvements where necessary.
• Uphold brand presentation standards, particularly in store environment and visual merchandising.
• People Development &; Leadership
• Lead, coach, and develop store managers and assistant managers to strengthen leadership capabilities.
• Identify training needs and work with Swatch Trainer and/or HR to implement effective training programs.
• Drive succession planning and talent pipeline development for future store leaders.
• Foster a strong performance-driven culture aligned with Swatch’s values.
• Operational Excellence & Compliance
• Ensure all stores consistently follow retail SOPs, visual merchandising standards, and stock control procedures.
• Conduct routine store visit and audits, identify issues, and follow up on corrective actions.
• Support smooth execution of new launches, campaigns, and store-level initiatives.
• Store Support
• Act as the go-to person for Store Managers offering support in operations, staffing, and service-related challenges.
• Step in to support store operations during peak periods or temporary vacancies, if needed.
• Reporting
• Gather business intelligence from various sources, and the respective comments / complaints for analysis and reporting.
• Prepare and submit reports as required by the Brand HQ, Management and departments on time.
• Strategic Projects & Expansion
• Support new store openings, relocations, or refurbishments, ensuring smooth execution.
• Participate in strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
• Provide market insights to support business planning and expansion in Malaysia.
• Profile
• Diploma or Degree in Business, Retail, or related field.
• Minimum 7 years’ experience in retail operations, with at least 3 years in a multi-store management role.
• Proven track record in driving sales performance and operational excellence.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop teams.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Commercially driven with strong analytical and business acumen.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with high adaptability.
• Willingness to travel frequently across Malaysia.

Field Operation Manager - Swatch Group

Gestione delle operazioni di campo
L'azienda
Lanciato nel 1983, Swatch è uno dei più iconici orologiai svizzeri al mondo, celebrato per la sua creatività, design audace e spirito provocatorio. Sempre innovante, Swatch sorprende con nuovi modelli, edizioni speciali e collaborazioni vibranti. Il marchio prospera in sport, arte e cultura, offrendo orologi come tele uniche di auto-espressione. Con spazi di vendita al dettaglio dinamici in tutto il mondo, gli ambasciatori di Swatch portano energia, storytelling e passione alla vita.
• Unisciti a noi e fai parte di un brand che valorizza innovazione, individualità e gioia!
• Descrizione del lavoro
• Cosa farai
• Vendite e prestazioni aziendali
• Fornire allenamenti regolari e pratici per memorizzare i team per migliorare la produttività delle vendite e raggiungere il target di vendita.
• Analizzare i dati di vendita, identificare le lacune delle prestazioni e implementare piani di azione per migliorare.
• Esperienza clienti e standard di marca
• Assicurare ai negozi di offrire costantemente l'esperienza del cliente Swatch.
• Monitorare e affrontare i problemi del servizio clienti, implementando miglioramenti se necessario.
• Aggiornare gli standard di presentazione del marchio, in particolare nell'ambiente dei negozi e nella merchandising visiva.
• Sviluppo delle persone e leadership
• Leader, coach e sviluppare manager di negozi e assistenti per rafforzare le capacità di leadership.
• Identificare le esigenze di formazione e lavorare con Swatch Trainer e/o HR per implementare programmi di formazione efficaci.
• Guidare la pianificazione di successione e lo sviluppo di talenti pipeline per i futuri leader del negozio.
• Promuovere una forte cultura basata sulle prestazioni allineata ai valori di Swatch.
• Eccellenza operativa e conformità
• Assicurarsi che tutti i negozi seguono costantemente SOP al dettaglio, standard di merchandising visivo e procedure di controllo delle scorte.
• Condurre visite di routine negozio e audit, identificare i problemi e seguire le azioni correttive.
• Sostenere l'esecuzione liscia di nuovi lanci, campagne e iniziative a livello di negozio.
• Supporto Store
• Agire come persona di punta per i manager di Store che offrono supporto nelle operazioni, nel personale e nelle sfide relative ai servizi.
• Passo per sostenere le operazioni di negozio durante i periodi di punta o i posti vacanti temporanei, se necessario.
• Rapporti
• Raccogliere informazioni aziendali da varie fonti, e i rispettivi commenti / reclami per analisi e reporting.
• Preparare e presentare relazioni come richiesto dal Brand HQ, Gestione e dipartimenti in tempo.
• Progetti Strategici & Espansione
• Supporta nuove aperture, rilocalizzazioni o ristrutturazioni, garantendo un'esecuzione regolare.
• Partecipare a iniziative strategiche per migliorare l'efficienza operativa e l'esperienza del cliente.
• Fornire informazioni di mercato per supportare la pianificazione aziendale e l'espansione in Malesia.
• Profilo
• Diploma o laurea in Business, Retail o campo relativo.
• Esperienza minima di 7 anni nelle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, con almeno 3 anni in un ruolo di gestione multi-store.
• Provato track record nella guida delle prestazioni di vendita e l'eccellenza operativa.
• Forte capacità di leadership con la capacità di ispirare, allenare e sviluppare team.
• Eccellente problem solving, comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Commercialmente guidato con forte acume analitico e commerciale.

Feldbetriebsleiter - Swatch Group

Feldbetriebsleiter
Das Unternehmen
Swatch wurde 1983 ins Leben gerufen und ist einer der ikonischsten Schweizer Uhrenmacher der Welt, die für seine Kreativität, sein mutiges Design und seinen provokativen Geist gefeiert werden. Swatch überrascht ständig mit neuen Modellen, Sonderausgaben und pulsierenden Kollaborationen. Die Marke thrives in Sport, Kunst und Kultur, bietet Uhren als einzigartige Leinwand der Selbstausdruck. Mit dynamischen Einzelhandelsräumen weltweit bringen Swatch-Botschafter Energie, Geschichten und Leidenschaft zum Leben.
• Begleiten Sie uns und sind Sie Teil einer Marke, die Innovation, Individualität und Freude auf den Weg bringt!
• Jobbeschreibung
• Was Sie tun werden
• Vertrieb und Geschäftsentwicklung
• Bereiten Sie regelmäßige Hand-on-Coaching, um Teams zu speichern, um die Verkaufsproduktivität zu verbessern und Umsatzziel zu erreichen.
• Analysieren Sie Verkaufsdaten, identifizieren Sie Leistungslücken und implementieren Sie Aktionspläne, um Verbesserungen anzutreiben.
• Kundenerfahrung und Markenstandards
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Geschäfte die Kundenerfahrung von Swatch konsequent liefern.
• Überwachen und Adressieren von Kundendienstproblemen, ggf. Verbesserungen implementieren.
• Einhaltung von Markenpräsentationsstandards, insbesondere im Ladenumfeld und im visuellen Merchandising.
• People Development &; Leadership
• Lead-, Coach- und Entwickler von Managern und Assistenten, um die Führungsfähigkeiten zu stärken.
• Erkennen Sie Trainingsbedürfnisse und arbeiten Sie mit Swatch Trainer und/oder HR zusammen, um effektive Trainingsprogramme umzusetzen.
• Führen Sie die Nachfolgeplanung und die Entwicklung der Talentpipeline für zukünftige Filialführer aus.
• Foster eine starke, leistungsorientierte Kultur, die auf Swatchs Werte ausgerichtet ist.
• Operationelle Exzellenz und Compliance
• Vergewissern Sie sich, dass alle Läden den Einzelhandels-SOPs, den visuellen Merchandising-Standards und den Warenkontrollverfahren konsequent folgen.
• Führen Sie Routine-Shop-Besuch und Audits, identifizieren Probleme und folgen Sie auf Korrekturmaßnahmen.
• Unterstützung der reibungslosen Durchführung neuer Starts, Kampagnen und Initiativen auf Lagerebene.
• Support speichern
• Aktivieren Sie als Go-to-Person für Store Manager, die Unterstützung in Operationen, Personal und servicebezogenen Herausforderungen bieten.
• Treten Sie ein, um Speichervorgänge während der Spitzenzeiten oder temporären Stellen zu unterstützen, falls erforderlich.
• Berichterstattung
• Sammeln Sie Business Intelligence aus verschiedenen Quellen und die jeweiligen Kommentare / Beschwerden für Analyse und Berichterstattung.
• Erstellung und Vorlage von Berichten, die vom Brand HQ, Management und Abteilungen rechtzeitig benötigt werden.
• Strategische Projekte und Erweiterung
• Unterstützung neuer Lageröffnungen, Verlagerungen oder Sanierungen, die eine reibungslose Ausführung gewährleisten.
• Erwarten Sie strategische Initiativen zur Steigerung der betrieblichen Effizienz und der Kundenerfahrung.
• Markteinblicke zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsplanung und Expansion in Malaysia.
