jobs.description:
Sales & Business Development Manager - Swatch Group

Sales & Business Development Manager
The company
EM Microelectronic is a semiconductor manufacturer specialized in the design and production of ultra-low power, low voltage integrated circuits for battery-operated and field-powered applications in consumer, automotive and industrial areas. Part of the Swatch Group and active for almost 50 years, EM is headquartered in Switzerland, has affiliates in the U.S.A., Czech Republic and Thailand and employs approximately 700 people worldwide.
Job description
• Senior business development/sales professional with a strong technical background (BSEE), extensive semiconductor sales, account management and new business development experience.
• This role is based at our headquarters in Marin/Neuchâtel with no remote or hybrid work possibility.
• Proven track record of successfully selling direct to customers, and through reps & distribution channels.
• Your essential duties and responsibilities:
• Field sales and marketing activities for all of EM’s products and customers
• KPIs: sales revenue and design wins
• Develop sales strategies for the territory in alignment with company objectives to achieve growth & revenue targets
• Identify and develop new customers, market segments and opportunities
• Identify, qualify and manage sales channels, reps and distributors
• Engage with eco-system partners to bring to the market complete solutions focusing on EM chips
• Analyze and understand the competitive landscape and work together with the BUs to adjust the EM positioning, strategy, as well as future product development
• Provide support to customers from design phase through mass production
• Establish and maintain key customer relationships at all levels, including Engineering, Purchasing, Logistics, and Management
• Drive C-level interaction between EM and customers / eco-system partners
• Lead the commercial negotiations and drive the execution of development contracts with the different internal and external stakeholders (R&D, legal, quality and logistics)
• Travel as needed for customer engagement and business development
• Profile
• To be successful in this position you need to bring along following core competencies:
• Experience selling connectivity and RFID solutions – BLE, Wireless, RFID, NFC, IoT and Sensor applications
• Business development – green field opportunity identification, qualification and design in
• Good network within the territory, with particular focus on Germany
• Account penetration at all levels, including engineering, business management, and purchasing
• Identification of key stakeholders and relationship building
• Strong communication skills, ability to articulate EM’s value proposition in a crisp and concise manner, adapted to the target audience
• Excellent listener, good understanding of customer organizational dynamics, navigating through the customer platforms & systems to maximize sales & product fit
• Technical sales of proprietary & complex solutions at the architecture & concept stages
• Comfortable with C-level and Engineering level interactions
• Understanding of eco-system sales and engagement with relevant partners
• Autonomy and initiative, ability to operate remotely and interact effectively across the entire EM organization
• Professional requirements
• Minimum 10 years of experience in selling technology in the electronics/semiconductor space
• Background with ASICs, mixed signal IC’s, BLE, Sensors, NFC, RFID, and wireless is a must

Vendedor/a Puerto Banús. Temporal sustitución - Swatch Group

Vendedor/a Puerto Banús. Temporal sustitución
The company
Swatch Group es el fabricante número uno del mundo de relojes terminados. Con sus 16 marcas de relojes, el Grupo está presente en todos los segmentos de precio y también participa en la fabricación y venta de joyería, movimientos de relojes y componentes.
Job description
Desde Swatch Group España, necesitamos incorporar a nuestro punto de venta en Puerto Banús a un vendedor/a a jornada completa para cubrir una baja por enfermedad, asumiendo las siguientes funciones:
- Bienvenida y atención al cliente conforme a los protocolos de la Compañía
- Venta y asesoramiento de los productos ofertados en los puntos de venta
- Dominio y puesta en práctica de técnicas de venta
- Cuidado y mantenimiento de tienda
- Participación activa en el logro de objetivos de facturación
Profile
Buscamos un profesional con experiencia demostrada en atención al cliente y las siguientes competencias:
- Orientación al cliente y a las ventas
- Trabajo en equipo
- Flexibilidad
- Afinidad por el producto
Professional requirements
Imprescindible disponibilidad horaria. Trabajo a turnos.
Informática a nivel usuario
Languages
Inglés nivel conversación. Se valorará de manera positiva cualquier dominio de otro idioma más.

jobs.title: Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Green Hills (Nashville)
jobs.description:
Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Green Hills (Nashville) - Swatch Group

Swatch Part Time Keyholder - Green Hills (Nashville)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronics and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
At Swatch we provide our Retail Key holders with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.
Profile
• Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
• Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
• Reach & exceed your sales goals
• Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
• Handle multi-tasking with ease
• Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment
• Professional requirements
• 3-5 years of experience in a Key holder or lead sales position
• Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
• Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
• Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
• Able to plan, set and achieve goals
• Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount
• Internal transfer and growth potential
• $500 Employee Referral Bonuses
• Compensation: Base Pay plus Commission
• For more information, please see: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/
• Job location
• Abbott Martin Road, Suite 214
• 37215 Nashville TN (Tennessee)
• United States
• Company address

• 800 Waterford Way
• Suite 1000
• Miami, FL 33126

jobs.description:
Retail Controller - Swatch Group

Retail Controller
Bedrijfsintroductie
Als onderdeel van het wereldwijde concern Swatch Group is The Swatch Group Netherlands de verkooporganisatie van de gerenommeerde Zwitserse horlogemerken zoals Swatch, Omega, Longines, Tissot, Hamilton, Certina, Rado en Balmain binnen Nederland.
Vanuit het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven leveren wij aan zelfstandige juweliers en grootwinkelbedrijven. Daarnaast heeft The Swatch Group Netherlands een groeiend aantal eigen verkooppunten, zoals Swatch Stores, een Tissot boutique in Amsterdam en een Hour Passion winkel in de Designer Outlet in Roermond.
• Voor het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven zijn wij per direct op zoek naar een:
• Retail Controller (fulltime)
• Functie
Dol op cijfers? En zie je het als een sport om processen en transacties kloppend te maken én te houden? Als retail controller ben je verantwoordelijk voor álles wat met de financiële kant van de eigen winkels van The Swatch Group te maken heeft. Van controlling, administratie en voorraad tot audits en winkelopeningen. Jij draagt een volledige p&l- en balans-verantwoordelijkheid. Zin om jouw stempel te drukken op een internationale organisatie vol topmerken zoals Swatch, Omega en Tissot? Bouw samen mee aan ons succes!
Hoe ziet deze functie eruit?
Binnen deze functie ben jij hét financiële aanspreekpunt voor alles wat met retail te maken heeft. Of het nu gaat om de dagelijkse transacties in de winkels of de rapportages richting het Zwitserse hoofdkantoor: jij houdt het overzicht en de inhoud scherp. Brutomarges, kostenstructuren, CapEx-uitgaven en salesreconciliaties – alles komt voorbij.
De betrouwbaarheid van cijfers? Die staat natuurlijk voorop. Daarom controleer je bankafstemmingen en bewaak je de aansluiting tussen het POS-systeem en het ERP-systeem (SAP). Periodiek lever je scherpe inzichten aan het management, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Bij elke nieuwe winkelopening schuif je ook aan als vaste kracht binnen het operationele projectteam. Je beoordeelt prijsstellingen, werkt businesscases uit en houdt budgetten strak in de gaten. Inventory controlling? Volledig jouw terrein.
Maar daar blijft het niet bij. Regelmatig ben je onderweg. Om winkels te bezoeken voor audits op locatie. Hier toets je de naleving van interne procedures. En je telt de voorraad om juistheid en volledigheid te garanderen. Door jouw werk draait de retailorganisatie financieel als een Zwitsers uurwerk.
Profiel
• Wat neem je mee?
• Afgeronde wo-opleiding in bedrijfseconomie. Met minimaal drie tot vijf jaar ervaring in een control rol.
• Ervaring met SAP of SAP BW, Office 365 en Excel.
• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk. Communicatief ben je sterk.
• Analytisch ben je sterk en je weet complexe financiële data te vertalen naar heldere en bruikbare inzichten voor het management.
• Proactief, ondernemend, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
• Aanbod
Deze functie geeft ruimte én verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent dé retail controller van de Nederlandse organisatie en krijgt een zelfstandige rol binnen een internationale context. Met directe betrokkenheid bij alles wat in de winkels gebeurt, ben je verzekerd van impact. Je werkt in het hart van de organisatie: het hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven. Geen shared service center, maar korte lijnen en een team waar initiatief gewaardeerd wordt.
• Rechtstreeks in dienst bij The Swatch Group in Eindhoven.
• Jaarcontract (uitzicht op vast).
• 40 uur per week (32 is bespreekbaar).
• € 4.000,- tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand.
• 26 vakantiedagen per jaar.
• Mogelijkheid tot collectieve zorgverzekering.
• Ruimte voor professionele groei en ontwikkeling.
• Thuiswerken op structurele basis is niet mogelijk
• Job location

• Netherlands

jobs.title: Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week
jobs.description:
Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week - Swatch Group

Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 hours per week
The company
We are recruiting for a Part-Time 20-hour Sales Advisor for our White City Store!
The Swatch Group is an international group active in the manufacture
and sale of finished watches, jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group supplies nearly all components required for the watches sold
by its 17 watch and jewelry brands as well as by its two retail brands,
Tourbillon and Hour Passion. The Group’s production companies also supply
movements and components to third-party watchmakers. The Swatch
Group is also a key player in the manufacture and sale of electronic
systems used in watchmaking and other industries. With its watch brands, it
is also a leader in the field of sports event timing as official timekeeper and
data-handler of most of the Olympic Games of the last decades and major
international sports events. The Swatch Group has a unique emotional
culture. Beauty, sensuality, emotions in watches are as much part of it as
high-tech, quality and added value on the customer’s wrist. Both, emotional
poetry and innovation play an active part in the commitment to its
customers. The Swatch Group was founded in 1983, by Nicolas G. Hayek.
It grew out of the merger of two big Swiss watch groups, ASUAG and SSIH.
The Group has since shown steady growth in key financials, leading to
records. Today Swatch Group employs more than 33,500 people in over 50
countries.
Job description
Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a fast friendly service.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Swatch products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to guaranteed and after sales service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly sales targets.
• Oversee colleagues on the shop floor to ensure best practise is adhered to at all times, providing on the spot feedback when required
Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way
Reporting
• Accurate reporting of all administration and stock control.
• Collation of sales figures.
• Clearly articulate/communicate any issues the store has had in the absence of the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager
Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Delegate tasks to colleagues to ensure productivity during peak trade
Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Hold briefing sessions in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Manager.
• Confident to communicate at all levels, within the Store and with the wider Swatch Group teams
• Present and conduct yourself in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues, ensuring all communication is clear.
• Be familiar with international customer’s customs and culture.
Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training programmes.
• Confidently deliver product knowledge and train colleagues on upcoming collections
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
• To undertake duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
• As a member of the store management team be prepared to act up in a more senior capacity when the Store Manager and/or Assistant Manager are out of the business
• Assist the store management team to lead and inspire your colleagues.
• Ensure service standards and behaviours are in line with training and Swatch guidelines at all times
Profile
Essential
• Passionate to lead, motivate and engage a team
• Driven to improve conversion and ensure the store and team meet KPIs
• Enjoys developing team members, with the ability to provide constructive and positive feedback
• Passionate about providing the highest level of customer experience, leading by example for other team members
• Uses initiative to support the Store Manager and Assistant Manager in running the store and providing ideas for improvements
Preferred
• Previous experience in retail and/or fashion accessories
• Have experience dealing with international customers
• Ability to communicate in multiple languages
Previous Supervisory experience
Contact
Kevin Charles
Job location
Ariel Way Unit K2004A
W12 7GF London (England)
United Kingdom
Company address
The Swatch Group (UK) Limited
77 Marsh Wall
12th Floor
London E14 9SH

descriptionByLocale.it: Swatch White City 20 ore settimanali - Swatch Group Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 ore settimanali L'azienda Stiamo reclutando per un consulente di vendite part-time di 20 ore per il nostro White City Store! Il Gruppo Swatch è un gruppo internazionale attivo nella produzione e vendita di orologi, gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti finiti. Swatch Group fornisce quasi tutti i componenti necessari per gli orologi venduti dai suoi 17 marchi di orologi e gioielli, nonché dai suoi due marchi di vendita al dettaglio, Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Le aziende di produzione del Gruppo forniscono anche movimenti e componenti a orologiai di terze parti. Il Gruppo Swatch è anche un protagonista nella produzione e nella vendita di sistemi elettronici utilizzati nell'orologeria e in altre industrie. Con i suoi marchi di orologi, è anche leader nel campo dei tempi degli eventi sportivi come timekeeper ufficiale e data-handler della maggior parte dei Giochi Olimpici degli ultimi decenni e importanti eventi sportivi internazionali. Il Gruppo Swatch ha una cultura emotiva unica. Bellezza, sensualità, emozioni negli orologi sono tanto parte di esso come high-tech, qualità e valore aggiunto sul polso del cliente. Entrambi, la poesia emotiva e l'innovazione svolgono un ruolo attivo nell'impegno per i suoi clienti. Il Gruppo Swatch è stato fondato nel 1983 da Nicolas G. Hayek. È cresciuto dalla fusione di due grandi gruppi di orologi svizzeri, ASUAG e SSIH. Da allora il Gruppo ha mostrato una crescita costante dei principali finanziamenti, portando a record. Oggi Swatch Group impiega oltre 33.500 persone in oltre 50 paesi. Descrizione del lavoro Vendite • Greet e servire tutti i clienti che forniscono un servizio veloce amichevole. • Assicurare la familiarità con la gamma di prodotti, passato e presente, in modo che i clienti possano essere forniti con tanto dettaglio quanto necessario. • Assicurare una buona conoscenza di tutte le funzioni di orologi e altri prodotti Swatch. • Fornire informazioni affidabili ai clienti in tutte le questioni relative al servizio garantito e dopo le vendite. • Aiuta a visualizzare la merce come indicato. • Contribuire al negozio raggiungendo i suoi obiettivi di vendita mensili. • Controllare i colleghi sul pavimento del negozio per garantire la migliore pratica è aderente in ogni momento, fornendo sul feedback del posto quando richiesto Sicurezza • Assist nel controllo del restringimento da un'azione attenta sul pavimento del negozio, la movimentazione delle merci, la prevenzione degli incidenti e l'attenta operazione del fino. • Mantenere/costruire una consapevolezza generale dei prodotti e dei punti caldi di sicurezza. • Seguire la politica aziendale e le procedure per l'apertura/chiusura del negozio. • Tutte le transazioni da gestire in modo responsabile e sicuro Reporting • Reporting accurato di tutta l'amministrazione e il controllo delle scorte. • Collazione delle cifre di vendita. • Evidentemente articolare/comunicare qualsiasi problema che il negozio ha avuto in assenza di Store Manager e/o Assistant Manager Care of the Store • Assicurarsi che il negozio sia mantenuto pulito e presente in ogni momento. • Delegare i compiti ai colleghi per garantire la produttività durante il picco di scambio Comunicazione • Adeguarsi alle politiche e alle normative aziendali. • Partecipa a sessioni di briefing come diretto dal tuo direttore di linea. • Tenere sessioni di briefing in assenza di Store Manager o Assistant Manager. • Fiducioso di comunicare a tutti i livelli, all'interno dello Store e con i più ampi team del Gruppo Swatch • Presentare e condurre in modo professionale sia i clienti che i colleghi, assicurando che tutta la comunicazione sia chiara. • Conoscere le abitudini e la cultura dei clienti internazionali. Conoscenza del prodotto • Partecipare a programmi di formazione regolari. • Fornire confidenza la conoscenza del prodotto e formare i colleghi sulle prossime collezioni • Assumere la responsabilità, essere automotivati e proattivi, per comprendere tutti i nuovi prodotti e applicare la formazione e le istruzioni. • Essere in grado di fornire una buona conoscenza del prodotto ai nostri clienti. Altri Svolgere compiti e responsabilità che possono rientrare nell'impegno di un tale posto sotto la direzione del vostro direttore di linea. descriptionByLocale.de: Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 Stunden pro Woche - Swatch Group Part-Time Retail Sales Advisor Swatch White City 20 Stunden pro Woche Das Unternehmen Wir rekrutieren einen 20-stündigen Vertriebsberater für unseren White City Store! Die Swatch Group ist eine internationale Gruppe, die bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von fertigen Uhren, Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv ist. Swatch Group liefert fast alle Komponenten, die für die von seinen 17 Uhren- und Schmuckmarken verkauften Uhren benötigt werden, sowie die beiden Handelsmarken Tourbillon und Hour Passion. Die Produktionsunternehmen der Gruppe liefern auch Bewegungen und Komponenten an Dritte. Die Swatch Group ist auch ein wichtiger Akteur bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von elektronischen Systemen, die in Uhren und anderen Branchen eingesetzt werden. Mit seinen Uhrenmarken ist es auch ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Sport-Event Timing als offizieller Zeitwächter und Data-Handler der meisten Olympischen Spiele der letzten Jahrzehnte und große internationale Sportveranstaltungen. Die Swatch Group hat eine einzigartige emotionale Kultur. Schönheit, Sinnlichkeit, Emotionen in Uhren sind so viel wie High-Tech, Qualität und Mehrwert am Handgelenk des Kunden. Sowohl emotionale Poesie als auch Innovation spielen einen aktiven Teil des Engagements für seine Kunden. Die Swatch Group wurde 1983 von Nicolas G. Hayek gegründet. Es wuchs aus der Fusion von zwei großen Schweizer Uhrengruppen, ASUAG und SSIH. Der Konzern hat seither ein stetiges Wachstum in wichtigen Finanzen gezeigt, was zu Aufzeichnungen führt. Heute beschäftigt die Swatch Group mehr als 33.500 Mitarbeiter in über 50 Ländern. descriptionByLocale.fr: Conseiller en ventes au détail à temps partiel Swatch White City 20 heures par semaine - Swatch Group Conseiller en ventes au détail à temps partiel Swatch White City 20 heures par semaine La société Nous recrutons pour un conseiller commercial à temps partiel de 20 heures pour notre magasin White City! Le Swatch Group est un groupe international actif dans la fabrication et la vente de montres, bijoux, mouvements et composants finis. Swatch Group fournit presque tous les composants nécessaires pour les montres vendues par ses 17 marques de montres et bijoux ainsi que par ses deux marques de détail, Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Les sociétés de production du Groupe fournissent également des mouvements et des composants à des horlogers tiers. Le groupe Swatch est également un acteur clé dans la fabrication et la vente de systèmes électroniques utilisés dans l'horlogerie et d'autres industries. Avec ses marques horlogères, il est également un leader dans le domaine de la chronologie des événements sportifs en tant que chronométreur officiel et gestionnaire de données de la plupart des Jeux Olympiques des dernières décennies et des grands événements sportifs internationaux. Le groupe Swatch a une culture émotionnelle unique. Beauté, sensualité, émotions dans les montres en font autant partie que la haute technologie, la qualité et la valeur ajoutée sur le poignet du client. La poésie émotionnelle et l'innovation jouent un rôle actif dans l'engagement envers ses clients. Le Groupe Swatch a été fondé en 1983 par Nicolas G. Hayek. Elle est née de la fusion de deux grands groupes de montres suisses, ASUAG et SSIH. Depuis, le Groupe a enregistré une croissance régulière des principales finances, ce qui a permis d'enregistrer des records. Aujourd'hui, Swatch Group emploie plus de 33 500 personnes dans plus de 50 pays. Description du travail Ventes • Saluez et servez tous les clients offrant un service rapide et convivial. • Assurez-vous de vous familiariser avec la gamme de produits, passés et présents, afin que les clients puissent obtenir autant de détails que nécessaire. • Assurer une bonne connaissance de toutes les fonctions des montres et autres produits Swatch. • Fournir aux clients des informations fiables sur toutes les questions relatives au service garanti et au service après-vente. • Aide à afficher la marchandise comme indiqué. • Contribuer au magasin à atteindre ses objectifs de vente mensuels. • Surveiller les collègues de l'atelier pour s'assurer que les meilleures pratiques sont respectées en tout temps, en fournissant sur place un retour d'information au besoin. • Maintenir/construire une sensibilisation générale aux produits et aux points chauds de sécurité. • Suivez la politique et les procédures de l'entreprise pour ouvrir/fermer le magasin. • Toutes les transactions doivent être traitées de manière responsable et sécurisée. • Collation des chiffres des ventes. • Énoncez/communiquez clairement les problèmes que le magasin a eus en l'absence du responsable du magasin et/ou du responsable adjoint du magasin • Assurez-vous que le magasin est toujours propre et présentable. • Déléguer les tâches aux collègues pour assurer la productivité pendant les périodes de pointe. • Assister à des séances d'information comme l'a indiqué votre gestionnaire hiérarchique. • Tenir des séances d'information en l'absence du responsable du magasin ou du gestionnaire adjoint. • Confiance à communiquer à tous les niveaux, au sein du Store et avec les équipes de Swatch Group plus larges • Présentez-vous et conduisez-vous de manière professionnelle à la fois aux clients et aux collègues, en veillant à ce que toute communication soit claire. • Soyez familier avec les coutumes et la culture du client international. Connaissance des produits • Participer à des programmes de formation réguliers. • Fournir des connaissances sur les produits et former des collègues sur les collections à venir • Prendre des responsabilités, être automotivé et proactif, pour comprendre tous les nouveaux produits et appliquer la formation et les instructions. • Être en mesure de fournir une bonne connaissance des produits à nos clients. Autres • Entreprendre des tâches et des responsabilités qui peuvent relever de la compétence d'un tel poste sous la direction de votre gestionnaire hiérarchique. • En tant que membre de l'équipe de gestion du magasin, être prêt à agir à un niveau plus élevé lorsque le directeur du magasin et/ou le gestionnaire adjoint sont hors de l'entreprise • Aider l'équipe de gestion du magasin à diriger et inspirer vos collègues. • S'assurer que les normes de service et les comportements sont conformes à la formation et aux lignes directrices Swatch en tout temps Profil essentiel • Passionné de diriger, de motiver et de mobiliser une équipe • Convainqué d'améliorer la conversion et de veiller à ce que le magasin et l'équipe rencontrent les KPI • Apprécie les membres en développement de l'équipe, avec la capacité de fournir des commentaires constructifs et positifs • Passionné de fournir le plus haut niveau d'expérience client, menant par l'exemple pour les autres membres de l'équipe • Initiative d'utilisation pour soutenir le Store Manager et Assistant Manager dans la gestion du magasin et fournir des idées d'améliorations • Expérience antérieure dans le commerce de détail et/ou les accessoires de mode • Avoir de l'expérience avec des clients internationaux • Capacité de communiquer en plusieurs langues Expérience de surveillance précédente Contacter Kevin Charles Emplacement du poste Ariel Way Unité K2004A W12 7GF London (Angleterre) Royaume-Uni Adresse de la société The Swatch Group (UK) Limited 77 Marsh Wall 12th Floor London E14 9SH Postuler à cette offre Partager cette offre d'emploi

jobs.title: Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Antwerpen
jobs.description:
Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Antwerpen - Swatch Group

Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Antwerpen
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
Your mission
You will support the Store Manager in several tasks such as coaching, inspiring and motivating your team to achieve sales targets. As the brand's first ambassador, you will embody the Swatch/Flik-Flak values and guarantee the highest standards of welcome and customer experience.
Your responsibilities:
• Sales :
• Advice on and sale of products presented in the shop
• Interest in different brands and products
• Quality of welcome, service and merchandise presentation
• Customer acquisition and loyalty
• Appearance of shop and products displayed (windows, counters and furniture)
• Assisting other sales staff during sales (service, gift-wrapping, etc.)
• Contribute to the achievement of shop objectives
• Achievement of personal objectives (defined by Store Manager) and contribution to shop objectives
• Replacing the Store Manager :
• Administrative tasks, in the Store Manager's absence or at his request:
• Customer orders
• Control of deliveries
• Make sure there is enough material (bags, gift boxes, batteries, etc.)
• Communication with head office (parameter, E-Mail, telephone if there are special customer requests after agreement or if requested by the Store Manager)
• Manage the team in the Store Manager's absence or at his request:
• Integrate and train each new employee in the field
• Transmit to the team a passion for brand development, customer service and respect for Swatch values.
• Support staff in acquiring skills and reflexes in the field (selling skills, products, visual merchandising)
• Organize all shop tasks to optimize customer service
• Assist the manager in his or her mission to develop sales, supervise the team and run the shop.
• Lead individual time
• Listen to each member of staff (their confirmed successes and difficulties encountered) to develop individual and mutual confidence.
• Collaboration with the Store Manager:
• Transfer important information to Store Manager regarding daily business
• Keep Store Manager informed about employees
• Manage the store according to Store Manager directives
• Open communication with the Store Manager
• Carry out any other tasks requested by the Store Managerr, such as: inventory, restocking, new product information, monitoring attendance schedules, various administrative tasks, etc.
• Other tasks:
• Participation in events and training sessions
• Active participation in team meetings
• Cleaning and tidying the Store
• Compliance with rules and regulations (Dresscode, etc.)
• Reporting process:
• N + 1: Store Manager
• N + 2: Brand Manager
• Job type : Full time, permanent contract
• Salary: An attractive salary package including extra-legal benefits
• Hospital insurance
• Meal vouchers
• Ecocheques
• Mobility or bike travel reimbursements
• Working hours :
• Available on weekends
• Daytime work
• Evening work
• Work on public holidays
• Additional compensation :
• 13th month
• Commissions
• Profile
• Positive, enthusiastic and empathetic personality, with a strong team spirit;
• A natural leader with the ability to manage, motivate, coach and develop the skills of a team;
• Rigorous and organized, you are both interpersonal and business-oriented, and comfortable with numbers;
• Self-motivated and able to achieve sales targets in a dynamic environment;
• High attention to detail, flexibility and ability to handle multiple issues simultaneously.
• Continuous learning:
• Maintain and improve own knowledge of products and techniques,
• Participation in training sessions,
• Sharing knowledge and experience with colleagues.
• Professional requirements
• Generic skills applicable to all Swatch Group Benelux staff:
• Flexibility
• Customer-oriented
• Results-oriented
• Willingness to learn and develop
• Ability to manage and cope with emotions
• Thinking and reasoning skills
• Structured
• Skills required
• Sales background or equivalent, with several years of experience in a Store
• Excellent computer skills (advanced Excel level)
• Strong analytical skills
• Languages
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both spoken and written; any other language is an asset.
• Job location
• 2000 Antwerpen (Antwerp)
• Belgium
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Belgium) SA
• The Bridge
• Chaussée de Mons 1424
• BE-1070 Brussels

descriptionByLocale.fr: Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Anvers - Swatch Group Assistant Store Manager Swatch - Anvers La société Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, mouvements de montres et composants. Swatch Group réunit, entre autres, les marques horlogères suivantes sous son toit : Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch et Flik Flak. Le Groupe dispose d'un réseau de distribution et de vente au détail multimarques avec deux boutiques sophistiquées sous le nom de Tourbillon et Hour Passion. Swatch Group est également un acteur important des technologies nanomécaniques, nanoélectroniques et Bluetooth de pointe indispensables à l'horlogerie et à d'autres industries. Description du travail Votre mission Vous accompagnerez le Store Manager dans plusieurs tâches telles que le coaching, l'inspiration et la motivation de votre équipe pour atteindre les objectifs de vente. En tant que premier ambassadeur de la marque, vous incarnerez les valeurs Swatch/Flik-Flak et garantirez les plus hauts standards d'accueil et d'expérience client. Vos responsabilités : • Ventes : • Conseils et vente de produits présentés dans le magasin • Intérêt pour différentes marques et produits • Qualité de l'accueil, du service et de la présentation des marchandises • Acquisition et fidélité du client • Apparence du magasin et des produits affichés (fenêtres, comptoirs et meubles) • Assistance à d'autres employés de vente pendant les ventes (service, emballage cadeau, etc.) • Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs du magasin • Réalisation des objectifs personnels (définis par le responsable du magasin) et contribution aux objectifs du magasin • Remplacement du responsable du magasin : • Tâches administratives, en absence du responsable du magasin ou à sa demande : • Commandes du client • Contrôle des livraisons • S'assurer qu'il y a suffisamment de matériel (sacs, boîtes cadeaux, batteries, etc.) • Communication avec le siège social (paramètre, e-mail, téléphone s'il y a des demandes spéciales du client après accord ou sur demande du responsable du magasin) • Gérer l'équipe en l'absence du responsable du magasin ou à sa demande : • Intégrer et former chaque nouvel employé sur le terrain • Transmettre à l'équipe une passion pour le développement de la marque, le service à la clientèle et le respect des valeurs de Swatch. • Aider le personnel à acquérir des compétences et des réflexes sur le terrain (compétences de vente, produits, merchandising visuel) • Organiser toutes les tâches de magasin pour optimiser le service à la clientèle • Aider le gestionnaire dans sa mission à développer les ventes, superviser l'équipe et gérer le magasin. • Diriger le temps individuel • Écoutez chaque membre du personnel (leur succès confirmé et leurs difficultés rencontrées) pour développer la confiance individuelle et mutuelle. • Collaboration avec le responsable du magasin: • Transférer des informations importantes au responsable du magasin concernant les affaires quotidiennes • Tenez le responsable du magasin informé des employés • Gérez le magasin selon les directives du responsable du magasin • Ouvrez la communication avec le responsable du magasin • Effectuez toute autre tâche demandée par le responsable du magasin, comme l'inventaire, le restockage, les nouvelles informations sur les produits, le suivi des horaires de présence, diverses tâches administratives, etc. • Autres tâches: • Sales Coordinator - Swatch Group

Sales Coordinator
The company
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries
Job description
We’re seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to join our team. As a Sales Coordinator, you’ll provide support to Brand Manager to ensure that all parts of the sales process run smoothly.
Sales Coordinator supports Brand Manager by preparing reports to help achieve sales targets, managing administrative tasks, analysing sales data, generating reports and maintaining accurate client records.
Key 
• Responsibilities and Duties
BM/Sales Team Support: Tracking Sales data, monitoring order status, handling inquiries, and ensuring timely delivery.
Reporting & Data Management: Sales data analysis, weekly/monthly reports, and maintaining accurate client records.
Interdepartmental Coordination: Liaising with marketing, finance, and logistics to streamline sales operations.
Profile
Experience: 2+ years in sales support / administration
Strong organization skills and excellent customer service skills.
Multitasking abilities with high attention to detail.
Professional requirements
Bachelor degree.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Languages
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for client interaction in Spanish and English
Other languages as a plus

jobs.title: OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Dallas
jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Dallas - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Sales Associate - Dallas
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
Omega Brookfield Place Boutique looking for an ideal candidate that has relevant luxury retail sales experience and possess exceptional customer service skills. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. Candidate should also have the ability to meet or exceed sales objectives and possess a strong desire to learn about our prestigious timepieces and looking to become an essential member of our team.
Profile
• Establish a welcoming and approachable luxury environment
• Demonstrate a deep knowledge of all of our unique and impeccable range of products and their distinctive characteristics
• Cultivate enduring relationships with clients by providing memorable experiences which
• enlighten and provide insights into the ancestry of OMEGA
• Utilize our expansive training techniques to engage, inform and retain a gratified and loyal client base
• Provide a unique and special experience to all clients
• Meet and exceed sales goals
• Provide the highest level of client service through personalized contact in product
• maintenance
• Develop potential clients through both clientelling and networking efforts
• Maintain and grow existing clients; keep records of milestones and client’s tastes and goals for future purchases
• Assist team members in sales process as per established boutique protocols
• Develop existing client base and reach new prospects through networking and outreach
• Professional requirements
• For details on the prerequisites for this exciting opportunity, please see skillsets required
• MUST possess 2-5 years of luxury retail experience, preferably in the timepiece or fine jewelry field
• impressive selling capabilities and notable customer service skills
• Elevated ability to communicate effectively both written and orally
• Robust adaptability to learn the technical aspects of our company collection of timepieces
• Talented negotiation prowess
• Passion for the art of selling
• Must be able to work flexible schedule throughout the week
• MS Office experience is highly desirable
• Local applicants only.
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.

• Assistant Boutique Manager – Blancpain
• Job description
• · Lead, motivate, and support the boutique team to deliver exceptional customer service and sales performance.
• · Supervise daily boutique operations including POS transactions, cash handling, and sales administration.

jobs.description:
Sales Representative - Omega (Based in Phuket) - Swatch Group

Sales Representative - Omega (Based in Phuket)
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 17 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Léon Hatot, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail network with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job description
General Role
Responsible for assisting customers throughout the buying process. The duties include greeting customers when they enter the store, helping customers find specific products or showing them how to use them, delivering post-sale services and support the back office relevant tasks.
Main 
• Responsibilities
Sales /Operations
Achieve a monthly sales budget.
Ensure that a boutique is operation under a clean and luxurious atmosphere.
Prepare all necessary Sales Reports (daily and monthly) and Stock Report (monthly), expense reimbursement, credit card slips submission, etc. to the head office, in the absence of Boutique Manager.
Efficiently operate the POS system (Retail Management System) and make sure that all sales transactions (credit card, cash, deposits) correspond to the sales turnover generated on a daily basis.
Inventory
Monitor and review stock level taken into consideration customer needs and trends, and advise Boutique Manager of any suggestions necessary to increase sales.
Conduct daily audit of stock management including merchandise receipt, transfers and sales.
Ensure that the watches and fine jewelry are kept safely in the vaults after the store has closed.
Manage customers’ reservations and waiting lists of unavailable products.
Aftersales Service
Provide excellent service to clients
Check and update spare part stock
Answer enquiries to clients
Customer complaint handling
Keep inform clients for updated information and new product arrival
Profile
Bachelor’s degree or higher in any fields
At least 3 years of working experience in selling luxury products
Excellent command of English and proficient in Mandarin is preferred
Must be a good team player, pleasant, service oriented with good communication skills
Good computer operation
Professional requirements
Expertise in selling skills
Languages

jobs.title: Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst - Swatch Group

Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with internal SAP teams, IT departments, business stakeholders and external partners, you will contribute to major transformation initiatives and ensure the continuous improvement of SAP processes.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Gather, analyze and challenge business requirements to ensure alignment with global processes.
• Propose robust and scalable SAP solutions and perform system configuration.
• Prepare detailed functional specifications and collaborate closely with SAP developers.
• Train key users and support change management activities.
• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Non‑Regression Testing (NRT).
• Act as module lead on projects and contribute to cross‑functional initiatives.
• Maintain up‑to‑date documentation on processes, configurations and system design.
• Analyze and resolve complex incidents and provide expert-level operational support.
• Manage enhancements and continuous improvement activities within your SAP domain.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• A strong track record as a Senior SAP expert, delivering high‑impact solutions in global environments.
• Deep understanding of business processes and SAP integration, especially across FI/CO and EWM.
• The ability to translate complex business needs into scalable, future‑proof SAP configurations.
• Confidence acting as a functional lead, driving workshops and influencing key decisions.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business teams, IT, developers, and external partners.
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with autonomy in handling complex issues.
• A proactive, customer‑focused mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
• The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 7+ years of SAP customizing experience in major implementation or transformation projects.
• Strong understanding of ABAP concepts and integration technologies (EDI, API, RFC).
• Solid knowledge of business processes and SAP integration, especially FI/CO and EWM.
• Hands‑on experience with SAP S/4HANA and awareness of recent SAP innovations.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.
• Strong organizational abilities and capacity to manage multiple priorities.
• Customer‑focused mindset with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Informatics, or equivalent; SAP FI/CO certification is an asset.
• Languages
• Fluency in English

jobs.description:
Senior SAP Developer - Swatch Group

Senior SAP Developer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing, developing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with SAP Business Analysts, functional teams and technical stakeholders, you will analyze requirements, build robust SAP developments, contribute to project activities and ensure the long‑term reliability and performance of SAP applications.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Analyzing business requirements together with SAP Business Analysts and translating them into technical SAP solutions.
• Designing, developing, documenting and maintaining SAP programs and enhancements.
• Evaluating change requests, proposing technical designs and implementing scalable solutions.
• Supporting Fit/Gap analysis, data migration activities and go‑live phases within SAP projects.
• Creating and maintaining functional and technical specifications, including test cases.
• Collaborating closely with Business Analysts and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment between functional needs and technical delivery.
• Ensuring adherence to SAP development best practices, performance standards and code quality guidelines.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Extensive experience as an SAP Developer with strong expertise in ABAP and modern SAP development frameworks.
• Deep understanding of SAP modules such as FI, CO, MM, SD, QM and experience with SAP Solution Manager.
• Strong ability to translate functional requirements into robust, scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
• Hands‑on experience with S/4HANA development, CDS views, OData services and RESTful programming.
• Experience building Fiori applications end‑to‑end and applying best practices for modern SAP UX.
• Solid knowledge of integration technologies including IDocs, ALE, RFC and API‑based communication.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities.
• The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within technical and functional teams.
• A passion for development, continuous learning and delivering high‑quality solutions in an international environment.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development across multiple modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, QM).
• Strong experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
• In‑depth knowledge of ABAP, Adobe Forms, SmartForms, SAPScripts and performance‑optimized coding.
• Expertise in IDocs, ALE, SQL and JavaScript.
• Strong experience with CDS views, OData services and SAP RESTful ABAP programming.
• Ability to build Fiori applications from end to end.
• Experience with backend service creation and exposure to external applications.
• Familiarity with ATC, code quality standards and Fiori‑based modernization of legacy developments.
• Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is an advantage (APIs, Cloud Events, BAS, Fiori Elements, Build).
• Knowledge of extensibility best practices in S/4HANA Cloud and use of Custom Business Objects.
• Experience with low‑code platforms (Neptune, Mendix) and basic Java knowledge.
• Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving abilities and a customer‑oriented mindset.
• University degree in Information Technology, Information Management or equivalent.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
IT Project Manager - Swatch Group

IT Project Manager
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group.
Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, enterprise architects and external partners, you will ensure the successful delivery of approved projects, from initial demand through handover to operations, while contributing to program management and supporting change initiatives.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Managing approved IT projects according to agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
• Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology.
• Preparing and maintaining project documentation, investment requests and decision materials.
• Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases.
• Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables.
• Communicating regularly with stakeholders, including business teams, management, PMO and related project teams.
• Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management.
• Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment.
• The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy.
• Solid understanding of business processes, logistics flows and project governance.
• The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication.
• A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment.
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, architects and external partners.
• Strong analytical abilities and the capacity to evaluate business demands and scope potential projects.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in IT project management.
• Experience working in a large multinational corporation with international exposure.
• Expertise in IT project management, including planning, execution and stakeholder coordination.
• Strong understanding of business management and logistics processes.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including cloud, networking and data center environments.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA or modules such as SD/MM or FI/CO is an asset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to model information flows and support change management activities.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Project management certifications (PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are considered an asset.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Data Integration Engineer - Swatch Group

Data Integration Engineer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets.
Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries.
• Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components.
• Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs.
• Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes.
• Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware.
• Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows.
• Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• The ability to design and implement integration solutions across multiple systems and markets.
• Hands‑on experience with MS SQL, stored procedures, SSIS/ETL tools and related plugins.
• Familiarity with EAI/ESB technologies, ideally Software AG WebMethods or similar stacks.
• Experience with APIs, XML, SOAP and REST‑based integrations.
• Exposure to SAP integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs or ABAP debugging.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• +10 years of IT experience, including at least 2 years in designing and developing data integration or MDM solutions.
• At least 5 years of experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• Expertise with MS SQL, stored procedures and relational database design.
• Strong experience with SSIS/ETL tools and plugins such as Theobald for SAP‑related integrations.
• Experience with WebMethods or other EAI/ESB platforms.
• Experience in Java/JEE development and object‑oriented programming.
• Experience developing web applications (AngularJS, WebMethods CAF UI or similar).
• Strong knowledge of XML, SOAP, REST and API‑based integrations.
• Experience with SAP integration technologies (IDoc, ALE, RFC, ABAP debugging) is an advantage.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Starting base salary range between 110k-140k/year (plus a yearly bonus potential)

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Central Region
jobs.description:
Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Central Region - Swatch Group

Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Central Region
The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
Job Description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Tissot, U.S., the position will be responsible to support the watch sales within our retail and wholesale account through visual merchandising and training. This role will oversee the visual representation of our Tissot brand and products in all boutiques (retail and wholesale) within assigned Central Region. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer will also be responsible for maintaining training initiatives that will increase Tissot brand and product knowledge. Tasks include the planning, organization, coordination, training and implementation of all Visual Merchandising measures that have been developed by the brand.
This position is a field position.
Profile
Visual Merchandising 
• Responsibilities
Implement and maintain visual merchandising standards across retail and wholesale store locations, ensuring compliance with Company guidelines and brand standards.
Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual execution, providing on-the-spot adjustments and recommendations.
Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
Prepare and distribute communication materials related to visual displays in accordance with brand guidelines.
Manage vendor relationships by placing and following up on visual orders to ensure timely implementation and centralized mailing of visual materials to trade location.
Coordinate internal distribution of visual materials to stores, ensuring compliance and visibility.
Collaborate with retail locations, regional teams, and brand leadership to plan and execute floor sets, window displays, seasonal transitions, and promotional setups.
Identify visual merchandising opportunities within and outside stores, developing innovative window decoration ideas.
Create and maintain a photo library documenting boutique conditions before and after visits.
Provide recap reports summarizing store visit findings and improvement recommendations.
Assist Visual Manager and SIS Project Manager with identifying SIS opportunities and maintenance/renovation needs.
Lead first-class setup and decoration of brand-sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related, to maximize visual impact.
Partner with management in planning and executing functional training, leadership development, product and sales training and other agreed training strategies.
Training & Development 
• Responsibilities
Facilitate training sessions for store managers and associates focused on current visual merchandising standards, product placement, and customer experience best practices.
Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
Partner with management on planning and executing functional, leadership, product, and sales training programs.
Provide ongoing coaching to store teams, identifying skill gaps and recommending development initiatives.
Foster strong relationships with store teams to support adoption of visual and training standards.
Additional 
• Responsibilities
Monitor regional business trends, competitor trends by reading and understanding business reports and identify potential opportunities to support sales growth.
Perform other duties as assigned by management.
Requirements
Education and Experience 
• Requirements
High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred.
2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience, preferably in specialty goods, jewelry, or watches.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Valid driver’s license required.
Proven ability to coach and train diverse teams in a fast-paced retail environment.
Strong eye for design, layout, and brand storytelling through product presentation.
Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
The work schedule will vary from Monday through Friday and may include an occasional weekend.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 80-85% of the time (minimum 4 days per workweek).
Physical 
• Requirements:
This is primarily active position which requires the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer to move about the various locations while continuously climbing ladders, bending, stooping, lifting, reaching, moving and carrying up to 40 lbs. There is frequent travel to multiple retail locations within assigned territory. The position requires the ability to operate motor vehicles, computers and tablets, communicate clearly, and engage physically with visual merchandising setups. Finger dexterity is necessary. Occasional evening or weekend work to support store openings, seasonal transitions, or special events.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time with or without notice.
Compensation & Benefits
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount
For more information please see https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/

descriptionByLocale.it: Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Regione Centrale - Swatch Group Visual Merchandiser Trainer - Regione Centrale L'azienda Swatch Group è il produttore numero uno del mondo di orologi finiti. Con i suoi 16 marchi di orologi, il Gruppo è presente in tutti i segmenti di prezzo, ed è anche attivo nella produzione e vendita di gioielli, movimenti di orologi e componenti. Swatch Group unisce, tra le altre aziende, i seguenti marchi di orologi sotto il suo tetto: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch e Flik Flak. Il Gruppo ha una forte distribuzione e una rete di vendita al dettaglio multi-brand con due raffinate boutique sotto il nome di Tourbillon e Hour Passion. Swatch Group è anche un giocatore importante nelle tecnologie nanomeccaniche, nanoelettroniche e Bluetooth avanzate essenziali per l'orologeria e altre industrie. Descrizione del lavoro Come Visual Merchandiser & Trainer con Tissot, U.S., la posizione sarà responsabile di supportare le vendite di orologi all'interno del nostro conto retail e all'ingrosso attraverso merchandising visivo e formazione. Questo ruolo sovrintenderà alla rappresentazione visiva del nostro marchio Tissot e dei nostri prodotti in tutte le boutique (retail e grossista) all'interno della Regione Centrale assegnata. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer sarà anche responsabile del mantenimento di iniziative di formazione che aumenteranno il marchio Tissot e la conoscenza del prodotto. Compiti includono la pianificazione, l'organizzazione, il coordinamento, la formazione e l'attuazione di tutte le misure di Visual Merchandising che sono state sviluppate dal marchio. Questa posizione è una posizione sul campo. Implementa e mantieni gli standard di merchandising visivo nei punti vendita al dettaglio e all'ingrosso, garantendo il rispetto delle linee guida aziendali e degli standard di marca. Condurre visite di negozio regolari per valutare l'esecuzione visiva, fornendo regolazioni e raccomandazioni on-the-spot. Contribuisci al raggiungimento degli obiettivi del volume di vendita assicurando presentazioni e manutenzione efficaci di tutte le categorie di prodotti, assicurando che tutti i negozi siano impostati correttamente durante le promozioni e gli affari regolari. Preparare e distribuire materiali di comunicazione relativi a display visivi in conformità con le linee guida del marchio. Gestire le relazioni dei fornitori mettendo e seguendo gli ordini visivi per garantire l'implementazione tempestiva e la postazione centralizzata dei materiali visivi per la posizione di commercio. Coordinare la distribuzione interna dei materiali visivi ai negozi, garantendo la conformità e la visibilità. Collabora con le sedi di vendita al dettaglio, le squadre regionali e la leadership del marchio per pianificare ed eseguire i set di pavimenti, i display delle finestre, le transizioni stagionali e le impostazioni promozionali. Identificare opportunità di merchandising visivo all'interno e all'esterno dei negozi, sviluppando idee innovative di decorazione delle finestre. Creare e mantenere una libreria fotografica che documenta le condizioni di boutique prima e dopo le visite. Fornire rapporti di ricapitolazione riassumendo i risultati della visita del negozio e raccomandazioni di miglioramento. Assist Visual Manager e SIS Project Manager con l'individuazione delle opportunità SIS e delle esigenze di manutenzione/ristrutturazione. Configurazione di prima classe e decorazione di eventi sponsorizzati di marca, mono e multi-brand correlati, per massimizzare l'impatto visivo. Partner con la gestione nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di formazione funzionale, sviluppo di leadership, formazione di prodotti e vendite e altre strategie di formazione concordate. Formazione e sviluppo • Responsabilità Facilitare sessioni di formazione per i manager dei negozi e gli associati focalizzati sugli attuali standard di merchandising visivo, sul posizionamento dei prodotti e sulle migliori pratiche di customer experience. Fornire programmi di comunicazione e formazione completi per negozi Partner con la gestione di pianificazione e esecuzione di programmi di formazione funzionale, leadership, prodotto e vendite. Fornire coaching in corso per memorizzare le squadre, identificare le lacune di abilità e consigliare iniziative di sviluppo. Promuovere relazioni forti con i team di store per sostenere l'adozione di standard visivi e di formazione. Ulteriori • Responsabilità Monitorare le tendenze regionali del business, le tendenze dei concorrenti attraverso la lettura e la comprensione dei rapporti aziendali e identificare le potenziali opportunità per sostenere la crescita delle vendite. Eseguire altri compiti assegnati dalla direzione. Requisiti Istruzione e esperienza • Requisiti High School Diploma o GED richiesto; Grado universitario preferito. 2-3 anni di esperienza di merchandising visivo al dettaglio, preferibilmente in merci speciali, gioielli, o orologi. Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta. Proficiente in Microsoft Word, Excel e PowerPoint. Valida patente di guida richiesta. Prove capacità di allenare e formare diverse squadre in un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio veloce. Occhio forte per design, layout e storytelling del marchio attraverso la presentazione del prodotto. Capacità di priorità molteplici responsabilità e prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. Il programma di lavoro varia da lunedì a venerdì e può includere un fine settimana occasionale. Capacità di viaggiare a livello nazionale e internazionale fino a 80-85% del tempo (minimo 4 giorni per settimana lavorativa). Physical • Requisiti: Questa posizione è principalmente attiva che richiede al Visual Merchandiser & Trainer di muoversi sulle varie posizioni, mentre scalate continuamente, piegando, stooping, sollevando, raggiungendo, muovendosi e portando fino a 40 lbs. Ci sono frequenti viaggi in più punti vendita all'interno del territorio assegnato. La posizione richiede la capacità di operare veicoli a motore, computer e tablet, comunicare con chiarezza e interagire fisicamente con le configurazioni di merchandising visivo.
