Sviluppare e mantenere un alto livello di tecnica di vendita e la conoscenza savoir-faire dell'orologeria
Seguire con le riparazioni dei clienti in liaising con assistenza clienti a Southampton e sede svizzera.

Partecipa attivamente alla corretta manutenzione della boutique: display del prodotto, set-up di oggetti, ecc.
Comprendere e rispettare tutte le linee guida operative e di sicurezza

Vertriebsberater Blancpain
Das Unternehmen
Blancpain, gegründet 1735 von Jehan-Jacques Blancpain im Schweizer Jura, ist Blancpain als die weltweit älteste Uhrenmarke bekannt.
Im Laufe der Jahrhunderte seit seiner Gründung hat das Maison sein Engagement für Innovation beibehalten und ständig die Grenzen der Uhrmacherei verschoben. Bei Blancpain ist der Ausdruck "Innovation is our tradition" ein grundlegendes Leitprinzip.
Die fünfzig Fathoms-Kollektion verkörpert Blancpains Leidenschaft für die Unterwasserwelt, die ursprünglich 1953 mit der Präsentation der ersten modernen Taucheruhr Fifty Fathoms zum Ausdruck gebracht wurde.
Mit der Gründung der Blancpain Ocean Commitment würdigt die Marke ihre bedeutenden historischen Verbindungen mit dem Ozean, durch die Unterstützung der Ozeanexploration und zahlreiche kollaborative Initiativen zur Erhaltung der biologischen Vielfalt mit lokalen Gemeinschaften, die seit den vergangenen sieben Jahrzehnten anhalten.
Im Rahmen der Art of Living-Plattform pflegt Blancpain auch besondere Verbindungen zu den größten preisgekrönten Köchen, dem Michelin Guide, Relais & Chateaux und Bocuse d’Or.

Propose Clients für lokale Aktivierungsereignisse im Einklang mit dem Brand Universe
Unterstützung von Kollegen in ihren Verkäufen, indem sie helfen, Rechnungen, Geschenke, Verpackungen vorzubereiten
Stellen Sie sicher, dass Anfragen und Anfragen (Online, E-Mail, Telefon) rechtzeitig nachgegangen werden
Entwickeln und pflegen ein hohes Maß an Verkaufstechnik und beobachten savoir-faire Wissen
Kundenreparaturen mit Kundenbetreuung in Southampton und Schweizer Hauptsitz.
Liefern Sie zuverlässige Informationen für Kunden in allen Fragen rund um den Vertrieb und den Kundenservice.
Bestellungen für Blancpain-Zubehör, die Sicherstellung der Aktie ist aktuell und verfügbar
Sachleistungen
Nehmen Sie aktiv an der richtigen Wartung der Boutique teil: Produktdisplays, Props Set-up, etc.
Alle Betriebs- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verstehen und beachten
Folgen Sie der Sicherheit und ordnungsgemäßen Wartung von Lageruhren

jobs.title: Sales & Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Sales & Marketing Manager - Swatch Group

Sales & Marketing Manager
The company
About Mido
Mido — a brand where timeless Swiss craftsmanship meets innovation and precision. Since 1918, Mido has been creating watches that combine performance, reliability, and elegant design, inspired by a rich heritage of watchmaking excellence.
Join us to be part of a journey that values quality, passion, and continuous innovation!
Job description
Key 
• Responsibilities
Account Management/Retail Partner Relations
Serve as the primary point of contact and brand representative for
authorised retail partners across Malaysia.
Develop and maintain a structured account management cadence, including regular store visits, business reviews, and seasonal range presentations.
Negotiate and manage sell-in volumes, seasonal buys, and trading terms in collaboration with the Country Manager/Mido HQ, ensuring commercial targets are met while preserving healthy partner margins.
Proactively identify and address challenges within accounts.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date account records.
Inventory, Replenishment & Other Management
Monitor auto-replenishment systems across all points of sale, reviewing stock positions on a regular basis and taking corrective action when replenishment triggers are not performing as expected.
Execute all ordering and replenishment activities through Arkieva.
Manage the full stock and collection cycle.
Oversee the payment collection process for stock and collections.
Liaise with logistics teams to resolve any issues that could impact partner operations.
Sales Reporting & Performance Analysis
Prepare and submit weekly & monthly sales performance report, highlighting notable trends, risks, and opportunities for the attention of management.
Conduct monthly store visits across the wholesale network and consolidate detailed visit reports.
Track and analyse key performance indicators across all points of sale, identify underperforming accounts and working collaboratively with partners to develop improvement plans.
Ensure all reporting is accurate, consistently formatted, and aligned with the Brand/Group’s reporting standards.
Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards
Work closely with retail partners to implement and maintain VM setups according to brand guidelines.
Ensuring all partner locations receive updated materials in a timely manner.
Maintain a photographic record of VM standards across all points of sale.
Retail Staff Training & Brand Education
Design and deliver training programmes for retail partner staff.
Develop training materials and conduct regular training sessions.
Build a culture of brand advocacy among retail partner staff.
In-Store Activations & Retail Partner Collaboration
Collaborate with retail partners to identify joint market opportunities
Conceptualize, plan, and execute in-store activations, product launch events, and seasonal promotions that attract consumers, increase dwell time, and drive purchase conversion.
Digital Marketing & Press Relations
Develop and manage digital marketing campaigns tailored to the Malaysia market, working across owned channels (social media, CRM, website) and paid media to reach and engage target consumers at relevant touchpoints in the purchase journey.
Manage relationships with local press contacts, watch and lifestyle media editors, and digital content creators, proactively pitching stories, collections, and brand moments to generate earned media coverage.
Profile
Preferred 
• Profile
Minimum 7 years’ experience in wholesale sales, account management, or brand management, ideally within watches, jewellery, luxury goods, or lifestyle.
Demonstrated track record of managing retail partner relationships and driving sell-through in a wholesale distribution model.
Hands-on experience with inventory or retail planning systems; familiarity
with Arkieva is an advantage.
Exposure to digital marketing, social media management, and PR or media
coordination.
Experience planning and executing in-store activations or trade marketing
events.
Job location
Jalan Raja Chulan 67
50200 Kuala Lumpur (Kuala Lumpur)

Level 22 Wisma Goldhill
67, Jalan Raja Chulan
MY-50200 Kuala Lumpur

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sales & Marketing Manager - Swatch Group

Vendite e Marketing Manager
L'azienda
A proposito di Mido
Mido — un marchio in cui l'artigianato svizzero senza tempo incontra innovazione e precisione. Dal 1918, Mido crea orologi che combinano performance, affidabilità e design elegante, ispirati a un ricco patrimonio di eccellenza orologiera.
Unisciti a noi per far parte di un viaggio che valorizza qualità, passione e innovazione continua!
Descrizione del lavoro
chiave
• Responsabilità
Gestione account/Retail Partner Relations
Servire come punto primario di contatto e rappresentante del marchio per
partner commerciali autorizzati in Malesia.
Sviluppare e mantenere una cadenza di gestione del conto strutturato, tra cui visite di negozio regolari, recensioni aziendali e presentazioni della gamma stagionale.
Negoziare e gestire volumi di vendita, acquisti stagionali e termini di trading in collaborazione con il Country Manager/Mido HQ, assicurando che gli obiettivi commerciali vengano soddisfatti mantenendo margini di partner sani.
Identificare e affrontare attivamente le sfide all'interno dei conti.
Mantenere i record di account accurati e aggiornati.
Inventario, Replenishment & Other Management
Monitorare i sistemi di auto-rifornimento in tutti i punti di vendita, rivedere le posizioni di magazzino su base regolare e prendere l'azione correttiva quando i trigger di rifornimento non sono in esecuzione come previsto.
Esegui tutte le attività di ordinazione e ricostituzione attraverso Arkieva.
Gestisci il ciclo completo di stock e raccolta.
Superare il processo di raccolta dei pagamenti per stock e collezioni.
Liaise con i team logistici per risolvere eventuali problemi che potrebbero influenzare le operazioni dei partner.
Analisi delle prestazioni
Preparare e presentare il rapporto delle prestazioni settimanali e mensili delle vendite, evidenziando tendenze, rischi e opportunità notevoli per l'attenzione della gestione.
Condurre le visite di negozio mensili in tutta la rete all'ingrosso e consolidare i rapporti di visita dettagliati.
Tracciare e analizzare gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni in tutti i punti di vendita, identificare i conti sottoperformati e lavorare in collaborazione con i partner per sviluppare piani di miglioramento.
Assicurarsi che tutte le segnalazioni siano accurate, formattate e allineate con gli standard di report di Brand/Group.
Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards
Lavorare a stretto contatto con i partner di vendita al dettaglio per implementare e mantenere le impostazioni della VM secondo le linee guida del marchio.
Assicurarsi che tutte le sedi partner ricevano materiali aggiornati in modo tempestivo.
Mantenere un record fotografico di standard VM in tutti i punti di vendita.
Formazione e formazione del personale al dettaglio
Progettare e fornire programmi di formazione per il personale del partner al dettaglio.
Sviluppare materiali di formazione e condurre sessioni di formazione regolari.
Costruire una cultura di advocacy del marchio tra il personale partner al dettaglio.
In-Store Activations & Retail Partner Collaborazione
Collaborare con i partner retail per identificare le opportunità di mercato comuni
Concettualizzare, pianificare ed eseguire attivazioni in-store, eventi di lancio del prodotto e promozioni stagionali che attirano i consumatori, aumentare il tempo di permanenza e guidare la conversione di acquisto.
Marketing digitale e relazioni stampa
Sviluppare e gestire campagne di marketing digitale su misura per il mercato della Malesia, lavorando attraverso canali di proprietà (social media, CRM, sito web) e supporti pagati per raggiungere e coinvolgere i consumatori target a punti di contatto rilevanti nel viaggio di acquisto.
Gestisci le relazioni con i contatti della stampa locale, gli editor di media di orologi e lifestyle e i creatori di contenuti digitali, lanciando proattivamente storie, collezioni e momenti di marca per generare una copertura media guadagnata.
Profilo
Preferito
• Profilo
Esperienza minima di 7 anni nelle vendite all'ingrosso, nella gestione del conto o nella gestione del marchio, idealmente all'interno di orologi, gioielli, beni di lusso o stile di vita.
Demonstrated track record di gestione delle relazioni di partner al dettaglio e di guida sell-through in un modello di distribuzione all'ingrosso.
Esperienza pratica con inventario o sistemi di pianificazione al dettaglio; familiarità
con Arkieva è un vantaggio.
Esposizione al marketing digitale, alla gestione dei social media, alla PR o ai media
coordinamento.
Pianificazione dell'esperienza e esecuzione in-store attivazioni o marketing commerciale
eventi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Vertrieb & Marketing Manager - Swatch Group

Vertrieb und Marketing Manager
Das Unternehmen
Über Mido
Mido — eine Marke, in der zeitlose Schweizer Handwerkskunst Innovation und Präzision trifft. Seit 1918 schafft Mido Uhren, die Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und elegantes Design kombinieren, inspiriert von einem reichen Erbe der Uhrenherstellung Exzellenz.
Begleiten Sie uns, um Teil einer Reise zu sein, die Qualität, Leidenschaft und kontinuierliche Innovation wertet!
Jobbeschreibung
Schlüssel
• Aufgaben
Account Management/Retail-Partnerbeziehungen
Als primärer Ansprechpartner und Markenvertreter für
autorisierte Handelspartner in ganz Malaysia.
Entwickeln und pflegen Sie einen strukturierten Kontomanagement-Cadence, einschließlich regelmäßiger Shop-Besuche, Business-Reviews und saisonale Präsentationen.
Verhandeln und verwalten Sie Einverkaufsvolumina, saisonale Einkäufe und Handelsbedingungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Country Manager/Mido HQ, um sicherzustellen, dass kommerzielle Ziele erfüllt werden, während gesunde Partnermargen erhalten.
Proaktiv identifizieren und ansprechen Herausforderungen innerhalb von Konten.
Behalten Sie genaue und aktuelle Kontoaufzeichnungen.
Inventar, Wiederholung und andere Management
Überwachen Sie Auto-Replenishment-Systeme über alle Verkaufspunkte hinweg, überprüfen Sie regelmäßig Bestandspositionen und ergreifen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen, wenn Nachfüllauslöser nicht wie erwartet funktionieren.
Führen Sie alle Bestellungs- und Nachbearbeitungsaktivitäten durch Arkieva aus.
Verwalten Sie den gesamten Lager- und Sammelzyklus.
Beaufsichtigen Sie den Zahlungsabwicklungsprozess für Bestand und Sammlungen.
Liaise mit Logistikteams, um Probleme zu lösen, die den Partnerbetrieb beeinflussen könnten.
Sales Reporting & Performance Analysis
Bereiten und übermitteln Sie einen wöchentlichen und monatlichen Verkaufsleistungsbericht, in dem bemerkenswerte Trends, Risiken und Chancen für die Aufmerksamkeit des Managements hervorgehoben werden.
Führen Sie monatliche Speicherbesuche im gesamten Großhandelsnetz durch und konsolidieren Sie detaillierte Besuchsberichte.
Verfolgen und analysieren Sie wichtige Leistungsindikatoren in allen Bereichen des Verkaufs, identifizieren Sie unterdurchschnittliche Konten und arbeiten gemeinsam mit Partnern, um Verbesserungspläne zu entwickeln.
Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Berichterstattung korrekt, konsistent formatiert und mit den Berichtsstandards der Marke/Gruppe abgestimmt ist.
Visual Merchandising & Markenstandards
Arbeiten Sie eng mit Handelspartnern zusammen, um VM-Setups nach Markenrichtlinien umzusetzen und zu pflegen.
Damit alle Partnerstandorte zeitnah aktualisierte Materialien erhalten.
Bewahren Sie eine fotografische Aufzeichnung von VM-Standards über alle Verkaufspunkte.
Schulung und Brandbildung
Gestaltung und Bereitstellung von Schulungsprogrammen für die Mitarbeiter des Einzelhandelspartners.
Entwickeln Sie Trainingsmaterialien und führen Sie regelmäßige Schulungen durch.
Erstellen Sie eine Kultur der Markenvertretung unter den Mitarbeitern des Einzelhandelspartners.
In-Store Activations & Retail Partner Zusammenarbeit
Zusammenarbeit mit Handelspartnern zur Identifizierung gemeinsamer Marktchancen
Konzeptualisieren, planen und ausführen in-store Aktivierungen, Produkt-Start-Ereignisse und saisonale Werbeaktionen, die Verbraucher anziehen, erhöhen Wohnzeit und Laufwerk Kauf Umwandlung.
Digital Marketing und Presse
Entwickeln und verwalten Sie digitale Marketing-Kampagnen, die auf den Malaysia-Markt zugeschnitten sind, über eigene Kanäle (Sozialmedien, CRM, Website) und bezahlte Medien, um gezielte Verbraucher an relevanten Touchpoints in der Kaufreise zu erreichen und zu engagieren.
Verwalten Sie Beziehungen zu lokalen Pressekontakten, Watch- und Lifestyle-Medien-Editoren und digitalen Content-Erstellern, proaktiv anregenden Geschichten, Sammlungen und Markenmomenten, um verdiente Medienabdeckung zu erzeugen.
Profil
Bevorzugt
• Profil
Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung im Großhandel Vertrieb, Kontomanagement oder Markenmanagement, ideal innerhalb von Uhren, Schmuck, Luxusartikel oder Lebensstil.
Demonstrierte Track-Recording des Managements von Handelspartner-Beziehungen und des Fahrens durch Verkauf in einem Großhandels-Vertriebsmodell.
Erfahrungen mit Inventar- oder Einzelhandelsplanungssystemen; Vertrautheit
mit Arkieva ist ein Vorteil.
Exposition gegenüber digitalem Marketing, Social Media Management und PR oder Medien
Koordinierung.
Erfahrungsplanung und Durchführung von In-store-Aktivierungen oder Handelsmarketing
Veranstaltungen.

Sales & Marketing Manager - Swatch Group

Directeur des ventes et du marketing
La société
A propos de Myo
Mido — une marque où l'artisanat suisse intemporel rencontre innovation et précision. Depuis 1918, Mido crée des montres qui allient performance, fiabilité et design élégant, inspirées par un riche héritage d'excellence horlogère.
Rejoignez-nous pour participer à un voyage qui valorise la qualité, la passion et l'innovation continue !
Description du poste
Clé
• Responsabilités
Gestion de compte/Relations avec les partenaires de détail
Servir comme principal point de contact et représentant de la marque pour
partenaires de détail agréés dans toute la Malaisie.
Élaborer et maintenir une cadence de gestion des comptes structurée, y compris des visites régulières des magasins, des revues d'affaires et des présentations saisonnières.
Négocier et gérer les volumes de vente, les achats saisonniers et les modalités de négociation en collaboration avec le gestionnaire de pays et l'AC de Mido, en veillant à ce que les objectifs commerciaux soient atteints tout en préservant les marges saines des partenaires.
Identifier et relever les défis dans les comptes.
Tenir des registres exacts et à jour.
Inventaire, reconstitution et autre gestion
Surveiller les systèmes de renouvellement automatique de tous les points de vente, examiner régulièrement les stocks et prendre des mesures correctives lorsque les déclencheurs de reconstitution ne fonctionnent pas comme prévu.
Exécutez toutes les activités de commande et de réapprovisionnement via Arkieva.
Gérer le cycle complet du stock et de la collecte.
Superviser le processus de perception des paiements pour les stocks et les collections.
Assurer la liaison avec les équipes logistiques pour résoudre les problèmes qui pourraient avoir des répercussions sur les opérations des partenaires.
Rapport sur les ventes et analyse des performances
Préparer et présenter un rapport hebdomadaire et mensuel sur le rendement des ventes, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques et les possibilités notables pour la direction.
Effectuer des visites mensuelles de magasin dans tout le réseau de gros et regrouper les rapports de visite détaillés.
Suivre et analyser les indicateurs de rendement clés pour tous les points de vente, identifier les comptes sous-performants et travailler en collaboration avec les partenaires pour élaborer des plans d'amélioration.
S'assurer que tous les rapports sont exacts, systématiquement formatés et alignés sur les normes de déclaration des marques/groupes.
Marchandise visuelle et normes de marque
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires de détail pour mettre en œuvre et maintenir les configurations VM conformément aux lignes directrices de la marque.
Veiller à ce que tous les partenaires reçoivent des documents mis à jour en temps opportun.
Tenir un registre photographique des normes VM pour tous les points de vente.
Formation du personnel du commerce de détail et éducation à la marque
Concevoir et exécuter des programmes de formation à l'intention du personnel des partenaires du commerce de détail.
Élaborer du matériel de formation et organiser des séances de formation régulières.
Bâtir une culture de promotion de la marque auprès du personnel des partenaires de détail.
Activations sur place et collaboration des partenaires de détail
Collaborer avec les partenaires du commerce de détail pour identifier des débouchés communs
Conceptualisez, planifiez et exécutez des activations en magasin, des événements de lancement de produits et des promotions saisonnières qui attirent les consommateurs, augmentent le temps de séjour et conduisent à la conversion des achats.
Marketing numérique et relations presse
Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de marketing numérique adaptées au marché malaisien, en travaillant sur les différents canaux (médias sociaux, CRM, site Web) et les médias payants pour atteindre et mobiliser les consommateurs cibles aux points de contact pertinents dans le parcours d'achat.
Gérer les relations avec les contacts locaux de la presse, les éditeurs de médias d'horlogerie et de style de vie, les créateurs de contenu numérique, lancer proactivement des histoires, des collections et des moments de marque pour générer une couverture médiatique méritée.
Profil
Préféré
• Profil
Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans les ventes en gros, la gestion de compte, ou la gestion de marque, idéalement dans les montres, les bijoux, les produits de luxe, ou le style de vie.
Expérience démontrée de la gestion des relations avec les partenaires de détail et de la mise en marché dans un modèle de distribution de gros.
Expérience pratique des systèmes de planification des stocks ou du commerce de détail; familiarité
avec Arkieva est un avantage.
Exposition au marketing numérique, à la gestion des médias sociaux et aux relations publiques ou aux médias
coordination.
Expérience de planification et d'exécution d'activations en magasin ou de marketing commercial
les événements.

jobs.title: Sales Associate - Tissot
jobs.description:
Sales Associate - Tissot - Swatch Group

Sales Associate - Tissot
The company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.
The cross of the Swiss flag, proudly featured in the logo, symbolises the quality and reliability that Tissot has demonstrated since 1853. Remaining true to its motto, “Innovators by Tradition”, Tissot makes excellence accessible in more than 160 countries, relying on special materials, advanced features, and refined design.
Role Overview
As part of the expansion of our retail network, Tissot is looking for a passionate, dynamic, and customer-focused Sales Associate to join our boutique in Brussels. This temporary opportunity offers strong potential for long-term growth into a permanent position.
Your Mission
As a true brand ambassador, you will deliver an exceptional customer experience while contributing to the boutique’s visibility, commercial success, and premium image.
Your Key 
• Responsibilities
Welcome every customer with professionalism and provide a premium in-store experience aligned with brand standards
Advise and guide clients in selecting watches and related products
Actively contribute to achieving and exceeding sales targets
Perform watch bracelet adjustments and sizing
Handle cash register operations, including opening, closing, and payments
Ensure the boutique is always impeccably presented and maintained
Support stock replenishment and inventory management
Follow all procedures and guidelines related to brand image, security, and store operations
Growth & Continuous Learning
At Tissot, we believe in curiosity, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.
You will:
Continuously develop your product expertise and sales skills
Participate in regular training sessions
Grow within a collaborative environment that encourages teamwork and best-practice sharing
Profile
Who You Are
You are passionate about people, premium products, and delivering outstanding service. You thrive in a fast-paced retail environment and enjoy commercial challenges.
You are likely the ideal candidate if you:
Have a strong customer-service mindset
Are passionate about watches, retail, or premium products
Bring positive energy, enthusiasm, and excellent interpersonal skills
Have strong communication and sales abilities
Enjoy teamwork and dynamic environments
Can multitask efficiently with attention to detail
Are flexible and available to work weekends
Are reliable, organized, and motivated
Why Join Us?
Become part of an iconic Swiss watchmaking brand
Join a passionate and supportive team
Be part of an exciting retail journey in the heart of Brussels
Benefit from a genuine opportunity to grow into a permanent role
Enjoy a competitive salary package and comprehensive additional benefits, including: hospitalization insurance, meal vouchers, eco vouchers, 13th-month salary, and reimbursement of public transportation expenses
Professional requirements
Experience
At least 1 year of sales experience is required, ideally in watches, luxury, or premium retail
What We Value
Customer focus
Results-driven mindset
Flexibility and adaptability
Organization and attention to detail
Curiosity and willingness to learn
Emotional intelligence and analytical thinking
Languages
Bilingual French–English or Dutch-English (fluent in both spoken and written communication), with additional languages considered a strong asset.
Job location
Galerie de la Reine 2
1000 Bruxelles (Brussels)
Belgium
Company address
The Swatch Group (Belgium) SA
The Bridge
Chaussée de Mons 1424
BE-1070 Brussels

jobs.description:
Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre) - Swatch Group

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’emploi :
Temps plein : En moyenne 35 heures par semaine. Vous devez maintenir une disponibilité ouverte afin de répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et pourriez être amené(e) à travailler plus de 35 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et durant les périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Professional requirements
• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).
• Job location
• Saint Catherine Street West 705
• H3B 4G5 Montreal Quebec HB G (Quebec)
• Canada
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
• 555, Richmond Street West
• Suite 1105
• CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario

• Share this job offer

jobs.description:
Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules - Swatch Group

Business Development Manager - Electronic Modules
The company
We are looking for an entrepreneurial and technically minded Senior Business Development Manager to accelerate our growth across the DACH region. You will drive market expansion for innovative electronic modules focused on Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power applications.
Our solutions enable next-generation Asset Tracking, Localization, Identification, and IoT connectivity for industries such as Logistics, Warehousing, Avionics, Healthcare, Hospitality, and Large Enterprise environments.
This role is designed for a high-energy sales professional who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution, who enjoys building customer relationships in the field, identifying market opportunities, and turning technical innovation into commercial success.
Why to Join Us
Be part of a growing, innovation-driven business
Work with cutting-edge ultra-low-power technologies
Direct impact on strategic growth and market expansion
High visibility within the organization and close collaboration with leadership
Dynamic international environment with entrepreneurial spirit
Opportunity to shape future connected-device ecosystems
Job description
Your Mission
Develop and execute the business development strategy for the DACH region
Drive sustainable revenue growth aligned with Business Unit targets
Identify and win new business opportunities within target verticals
Build strong relationships with OEMs, system integrators, distributors, and strategic partners
Support the on-boarding and mentoring of future sales talents as the organization grows
Your 
• Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales
Identify opportunities and close deals as a result of the full sales cycle support
Achieve and measure Biz Dev KPIs and ensure alignment with the Business Unit revenue targets
Develop strategic account plans and regional growth strategies
Identify new customers and market opportunities
Conduct customer visits and maintain strong field presence across the region
Represent the company at trade fairs
Drive C-level interaction between EM and customers / eco-system partners
Lead the commercial negotiations and drive the execution of development contracts with the different internal and external stakeholders (R&D, legal, quality and logistics)
Strategic Collaboration
Work closely with BUs Product Management, and Development to refine go-to-market strategies
Provide market feedback to influence product roadmap and innovation priorities
Collaborate with Marketing Communication teams to support campaigns, and market positioning
Interface effectively with Account Managers
Market & Technical Engagement
Understand customer application requirements and translate them into solution opportunities
Promote Bluetooth® Low Energy and ultra-low-power technologies in customer ecosystems
Support customers during evaluation and early project phases
Profile
Personality & Mindset
Strong business acumen with ability to handle strategic and action level aspects
Hands-on and action-oriented personality
“Hunter” attitude, strong commercial instinct and negotiation capability
Self-driven, autonomous, able to prioritize and highly customer-focused
Strong networking and relationship-building skills
Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for technology and innovation
Ideal Candidate 
• Profile

jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Bellagio
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.

The Ideal candidate must be experienced in luxury retail sales and operations management with a strong focus on driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills. Das Unternehmen
OMEGA ist ein Unternehmen der Swatch Group, dem weltweit führenden Uhrenhersteller. Seit 1848 steht die Marke für Exzellenz, Innovation, Design und Präzision. Dank seines Pioniergeistes war OMEGA die erste Uhr, die auf dem Mond getragen wurde, und es hat viele andere Errungenschaften und Erkundungen im Ozean und im Raum genossen. Seine Damenuhren gehören zu den bewunderten und genialsten in der Industrie und, zuletzt, OMEGA’s Ruf wurde durch seine Leistungen in anti-magnetischen Uhren und seine Master Chronometer zertifizierten Uhren, der höchste Standard für Präzision und Leistung der Industrie verbessert. OMEGA ist seit 1932 offizieller Timekeeper von 30 Olympischen Spielen und ist auch ein führender Name in Golf, Schwimmen, Leichtathletik, Schlitten und Segeln. Zu den Partnerschaften mit sozialen Ursachen gehören Orbis International und sein Flying Eye Hospital sowie die GoodPlanet Foundation. jobs.description:
Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall) - Swatch Group

Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Lead, you will report to the Store Manager and will assist in all day-to-day operations. Although your focus will be on sales initiatives, you also will coach sales associates to achieve their performance goals while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
Starting base pay of $19.85 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Lead by example to deliver outstanding customer service, coaching the team to meet and exceed sales targets. Ensure comprehensive product knowledge across the team to enhance customer experience and decision-making.
Operations: Support store management in daily operational tasks with a focus on accuracy and efficiency in all transactions. Maintain adherence to inventory control processes, minimizing loss and ensuring accuracy in stock handling and reporting.
Visual Merchandising: Execute and maintain visual merchandising standards in alignment with company directives. Ensure the store presentation is consistently maintained to a high standard, reflecting the brand’s image.
Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards and act as a model for company policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all operational guidelines and safety regulations.
Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Employment Status:
Full-Time: 35 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 35 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 2 years retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• Experience working with POS systems.

descriptionByLocale.en:
# Sales Lead (Conestoga Mall) - Swatch Group

## Descrizione

### La società
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e vi aggiunge la propria scintilla di creatività. Pertanto, Swatch viene considerato una tela sulla quale sono state applicate molte espressioni. Stile all'avanguardia, look di tendenza e accenti friendly con la tecnologia hanno tutti contribuito all'ammirazione di possedere un Swatch.

### Mansioni
Come Sales Lead di Swatch, riferirai al Responsabile del Negozio e aiuterai in tutte le operazioni quotidiane. Anche se la tua attenzione sarà sulle iniziative di vendita, dovrai anche formare gli associati alle vendite per raggiungere i loro obiettivi di prestazione mentre incarnano le competenze fondamentali di Swatch: Focus sul cliente, ambizione per i risultati, creatività, problem-solving, umiltà, integrità, costruzione di squadre e relazioni efficaci.
Stipendio base orario di $19.85 più bonus mensile di prestazione.

#### Servizio Clienti e Generazione delle Vendite
Fai da esempio per fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale, formando la squadra per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di vendita. Garantisci una conoscenza completa del prodotto in tutta la squadra per migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e le decisioni di acquisto.

#### Operazioni
Sostieni la direzione del negozio nelle attività operative quotidiane con un focus sull'accuratezza e l'efficienza in tutte le transazioni. Mantenere l'aderenza ai processi di controllo dell'inventario, minimizzando le perdite e garantendo l'accuratezza nella gestione e nella segnalazione delle scorte.

#### Visual Merchandising
Esegui e mantieni gli standard di visual merchandising in linea con le direttive dell'azienda. Garantisci che la presentazione del negozio sia costantemente mantenuta ad un alto livello, riflettendo l'immagine del marchio.

#### Conformità
Rispetta gli standard di sicurezza sul lavoro e fai da modello per le politiche e le procedure dell'azienda. Garantisci il rispetto di tutte le linee guida operative e le regolamentazioni sulla sicurezza.

## Condizioni di lavoro
Il lavoro richiede uno sforzo fisico moderato e una significativa camminata e permanenza in piedi per la maggior parte di ogni turno. Anche se questa posizione ha un basso rischio di infortunio, la posizione richiede il sollevamento, la spinta, la trazione e il sostegno (fino a 35 libbre e oltre con il supporto appropriato) di scatole e elementi di arredo del negozio, nonché una significativa attenzione quando si completano i documenti, la gestione del contante o l'uso del POS.

## Profilo
- Disponibilità a lavorare turni di apertura e chiusura; orari flessibili, compresi i fine settimana e i giorni festivi.
- Ottime capacità comunicative (verbali e scritte), comprese le capacità di costruzione delle relazioni.
- Deve essere unself-starter che lavora bene sia in modo indipendente che in ambienti di squadra.
- Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro, conciso e comprensibile.
- Orientato ai risultati con un alto livello di energia e entusiasmo.
- Passione per le vendite e il lavoro in un ambiente veloce.
- Requisiti professionali
- Almeno 2 anni di esperienza nelle vendite al dettaglio, preferibilmente nella moda e/o negli accessori.
- Capacità informatiche intermedie con conoscenza del lavoro di MS Office.
- Esperienza nel lavoro con i sistemi POS.

## Job location
550 King St N
N2L 5W6 Toronto MV B (Ontario)
Canada

## Indirizzo della società
The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
555, Richmond Street West
Suite 1105
CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario

## Candidatura
Condividi questa offerta di lavoro

jobs.description:
Assistant Store Manager (Yorkdale Shopping Centre) - Swatch Group

Assistant Store Manager (Yorkdale Shopping Centre)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
The Assistant Store Manager, reporting to the Store Manager, plays a key role in managing all aspects of the store's operations. This role involves driving sales through motivation and support of the staff, guiding the sales team to provide exceptional customer service for sales growth, and meeting operational objectives and ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures. Assistant Store Manager has to possess the following Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
• Starting base pay of $45,000.00 plus monthly performance bonus.
• Benefits:
• Paid Vacations
• Paid sick days
• Health benefits, including dental and vision coverage.
• Life insurance
• RRSP contributions with company match
• Company Discount
• Responsibilities include:
• Customer Service & Sales Generation: Coaching the sales team to enhance customer experiences and achieve sales targets, ensuring product knowledge, and monitoring performance.
• Operations: Assisting in managing store efficiency, adhering to procedures, inventory control, and addressing inventory discrepancies.
• Personnel Management: Supporting recruitment, development, and disciplinary processes, contributing to staff evaluations and development plans.
• Visual Merchandising: Helping maintain store presentation standards.
• Other: Upholding workplace safety, serving as a role model for company policies and procedures.
• Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Employment Status:
Full-Time: 40 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 40 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Effective leadership skills to mentor and motivate retail team.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Professional requirements
• At least 3 years retail leadership experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• Experience working with POS systems.
• Job location
• Dufferin Street 3401
• M6A 2T9 North York ON MA T (Ontario)
• Canada
• Company address
• The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd.
• 555, Richmond Street West
• Suite 1105
• CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario
• Apply for this job

jobs.description:
Full-Time Sales Lead (Robson Street) - Swatch Group

Full-Time Sales Lead (Robson Street)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Lead, you will report to the Store Manager and will assist in all day-to-day operations. Although your focus will be on sales initiatives, you also will coach sales associates to achieve their performance goals while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.
• Starting base pay of $19.85 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
• Benefits:
• Health benefits, including dental and vision coverage.
• Life insurance
• RRSP contributions with company match
• Company Discount
• Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Lead by example to deliver outstanding customer service, coaching the team to meet and exceed sales targets. Ensure comprehensive product knowledge across the team to enhance customer experience and decision-making.
Operations: Support store management in daily operational tasks with a focus on accuracy and efficiency in all transactions. Maintain adherence to inventory control processes, minimizing loss and ensuring accuracy in stock handling and reporting.
Visual Merchandising: Execute and maintain visual merchandising standards in alignment with company directives. Ensure the store presentation is consistently maintained to a high standard, reflecting the brand’s image.
Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards and act as a model for company policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with all operational guidelines and safety regulations.
Employment Status
Full-Time, Minimum 35 hours per week on average. Full -Time employees must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 35 hours a week, certain holidays and blackout dates.
Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Available for full-time work, minimum 35 hours per week.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 2 years retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• Experience working with POS systems.
• Job location

• Canada

Lead vendite a tempo pieno (Robson Street) - Swatch Group

Piombo di vendita a tempo pieno (Robson Street)
L'azienda
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e conferisce loro la propria scintilla di creatività. Così, Swatch è considerato una tela su cui sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile taglio bordo, impostazione tendenza look e accenti tecnologia amichevole hanno tutti aggiunto allo stupore di possedere un Swatch.
Descrizione del lavoro
Come Swatch Sales Lead, verrà segnalato al Manager Store e sarà di aiuto in tutte le operazioni quotidiane. Anche se il vostro focus sarà sulle iniziative di vendita, sarà anche allestire i partner di vendita per raggiungere i loro obiettivi di performance, incarnando Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.
• Paga di base di partenza di $ 19,85 all'ora più bonus di prestazione mensile.
• Vantaggi:
• Prestazioni sanitarie, compresa la copertura dentale e della visione.
• Assicurazione sulla vita
• Contributi RRSP con match aziendale
• Sconto aziendale
• Le responsabilità includono:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Guida per esempio per fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale, allenando il team per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi di vendita. Assicurare una conoscenza completa del prodotto in tutto il team per migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e il processo decisionale.
Operazioni: Support store management nelle attività operative quotidiane con un focus sull'accuratezza e l'efficienza in tutte le transazioni. Mantenere l'adesione ai processi di controllo dell'inventario, minimizzare la perdita e garantire l'accuratezza nella gestione delle scorte e reportistica.
Visual Merchandising: Eseguire e mantenere standard di merchandising visivo in allineamento con le direttive aziendali. Assicurarsi che la presentazione del negozio è costantemente mantenuta ad un alto standard, riflettendo l'immagine del marchio.
Compliance: rispettare gli standard di sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e agire come modello per le politiche e le procedure aziendali. Assicurare il rispetto di tutte le linee guida operative e le normative di sicurezza.
Stato di occupazione
Tempo pieno, minimo 35 ore alla settimana in media. I dipendenti a tempo pieno devono mantenere la disponibilità aperta per soddisfare le esigenze del business e possono essere tenuti a lavorare più di 35 ore alla settimana, determinate vacanze e date di blackout.
Condizioni di lavoro:
Il lavoro è eseguito con sforzo fisico moderato è richiesto e significativo camminare e in piedi è richiesto per la maggior parte di ogni turno. Mentre questa posizione ha un basso rischio di lesioni, la posizione richiede sollevamento, spingendo, tirando e tenendo (fino a 35 libbre e sopra con il supporto appropriato) di scatole e dispositivi di negozio, così come, fuoco significativo quando si completano documenti, cash management o utilizzando il POS.
Profilo
• Disponibilità ai turni di apertura e chiusura del lavoro; ore flessibili tra fine settimana e festivi.
• Disponibile per il lavoro a tempo pieno, minimo 35 ore a settimana.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione (verbale e scritto), tra cui forti capacità di costruzione di relazioni.
• Deve essere un auto-starter che funziona bene indipendentemente e in ambienti di squadra.
• Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro e comprensibile.
• Risultati orientati ad un alto livello di energia ed entusiasmo.
• Passione per le vendite e lavorare in un ambiente veloce.
• Requisiti professionali
• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza di vendita al dettaglio, preferibilmente in moda e/o accessori.
• Competenze informatiche intermedie con conoscenze lavorative di MS Office.
• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi POS.

So gilt Swatch als eine Leinwand, auf der ein Myriad von Ausdrücken angewendet wurde. Cutting Edge-Stil, Trend-Setting-Looks und technologiefreundliche Akzente haben alle zum Erstaunen einer Swatch hinzugefügt.
Jobbeschreibung
Als Swatch Sales Lead melden Sie sich an den Store Manager und unterstützen Sie bei allen täglichen Operationen. Obwohl Ihr Fokus auf Vertriebsinitiativen liegen wird, werden Sie auch Vertriebsmitarbeiter trainieren, um ihre Leistungsziele zu erreichen und Swatch Core Kompetenzen zu verkörpern: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams und Relationships, Kreativität und Problem-Solving und Humilität und Integrität.
• Start Basis zahlen von $19.85 pro Stunde plus monatliche Leistung Bonus.
• Vorteile:
• Gesundheitsleistungen, einschließlich Zahn- und Sehbedeckung.
• Lebensversicherung
• RRSP-Beiträge mit Unternehmensübereinstimmung
• Firmenrabatt
• Zu den Aufgaben gehören:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Führen Sie zum Beispiel aus, um herausragenden Kundenservice zu liefern, das Team zu trainieren, um die Vertriebsziele zu erreichen und zu übertreffen. Stellen Sie umfassende Produktkenntnisse im gesamten Team sicher, um Kundenerfahrung und Entscheidungsfindung zu verbessern.
Operationen: Support Store Management in täglichen operativen Aufgaben mit Fokus auf Genauigkeit und Effizienz in allen Transaktionen. Bewahren Sie die Einhaltung von Inventarkontrollverfahren, minimieren Sie den Verlust und gewährleisten Sie die Genauigkeit bei der Lagerhaltung und Berichterstattung.
Visual Merchandising: Execute und Aufrechterhaltung visueller Merchandising-Standards in Abstimmung mit Unternehmensrichtlinien. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Store-Präsentation konsequent auf einen hohen Standard gehalten wird, was das Image der Marke widerspiegelt.
Compliance: Einhaltung der Sicherheitsstandards am Arbeitsplatz und als Modell für die Unternehmenspolitik und -verfahren. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller operativen Richtlinien und Sicherheitsvorschriften.
Beschäftigungsstatus
Vollzeit, Mindestens 35 Stunden pro Woche im Durchschnitt. Vollzeitbeschäftigte müssen die offene Verfügbarkeit aufrecht erhalten, um den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens gerecht zu werden und möglicherweise mehr als 35 Stunden pro Woche, bestimmte Feiertage und Verdunkelungstermine zu arbeiten.
Arbeitsbedingungen:
Die Arbeiten werden mit moderatem körperlichen Aufwand durchgeführt und für die Mehrheit jeder Schicht ist ein bedeutendes Gehen und Stehen erforderlich. Während diese Position ein geringes Verletzungsrisiko hat, erfordert die Position das Heben, Schieben, Ziehen und Halten (bis zu 35 lbs und oben mit entsprechender Unterstützung) von Boxen und Lagervorrichtungen sowie, erhebliche Fokus bei der Fertigstellung von Papier, Cash Management oder der Verwendung des POS.
Profil
• Verfügbarkeit zum Öffnen und Schließen von Schichten; flexible Stunden einschließlich Wochenenden und Feiertagen.
• Verfügbar für Vollzeitarbeit, mindestens 35 Stunden pro Woche.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (verbal & schriftlich), einschließlich starker Beziehungsaufbaufähigkeiten.
• Muss ein Selbststarter sein, der gut unabhängig und in Teamumgebungen arbeitet.
• Fähigkeit, klar und verständlich zu kommunizieren.
• Ergebnisse mit hohem Energie- und Enthusiasmus.
• Leidenschaft für den Vertrieb und die Arbeit in schneller Tempo-Umgebung.
• Professionelle Anforderungen
• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Einzelhandel, vorzugsweise in Mode und/oder Accessoires.
• Intermediate Computerkenntnisse mit Kenntnissen über MS Office.
• Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit POS Systemen.

jobs.description:
OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Boutique Manager - Nashville
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Job description
We are seeking an experienced, luxury retail Boutique Manager to provide leadership in our prestigious boutique. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Luxury Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and exceeding goals, whist delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills.
Profile
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering, and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Experience in selling time pieces is a big plus.
• Professional requirements
• Must possess a minimum 3 years management experience.
• Excellent selling and customer service skills.
• Superior communications skills: spoken and written.
• Inventory management expertise.
• Luxury retail experience preferred.
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount
• Transitchek Program – Save money on commuting to work and/or parking with up to $270 pre-tax dollars per month
• Internal transfer and growth potential
• $500 Employee Referral Bonuses
• Free parking (if applicable)

Service à la clientèle et génération des ventes: Montrer l’exemple en offrant un service à la clientèle de qualité, établir des objectifs de vente, coacher l’équipe pour les atteindre et veiller à ce que la connaissance des produits soit au niveau requis.

Gestion du personnel: Superviser les processus de recrutement, de formation et de mesures disciplinaires afin de maintenir une équipe performante, favoriser un milieu de travail positif, et gérer les évaluations de rendement ainsi que les plans de développement.

Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il requiert de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir des boîtes et des présentoirs (jusqu’à environ 16 kg et davantage avec un soutien approprié), en plus d’une concentration soutenue lors du traitement des documents, de la gestion de la caisse ou de l’utilisation du système de point de vente (POS).
Statut d’emploi :
Temps plein: 40 heures par semaine en moyenne. Le ou la titulaire doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et pourrait être appelé(e) à travailler plus de 40 heures par semaine, incluant certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler les quarts d’ouverture et de fermeture, avec des horaires flexibles incluant les fins de semaine et les jours fériés.
• Excellentes aptitudes en communication (orale et écrite), incluant de fortes habiletés à établir des relations interpersonnelles.
• Doit faire preuve d’autonomie et être capable de travailler aussi bien de façon indépendante qu’en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et accessible.
• Solides compétences en leadership pour encadrer et mobiliser l’équipe de vente au détail.
• Orienté(e) vers les résultats, avec un niveau élevé d’énergie et d’enthousiasme.
• Professional requirements
• Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en gestion dans le commerce de détail, de préférence dans le secteur de la mode et/ou des accessoires.
• Compétences informatiques intermédiaires avec une bonne connaissance de la suite MS Office.
• Minimum de 5 ans d’expérience en service à la clientèle.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (PDV).

Assistant(e) Gérant(e) de Magasin / Assistant Store Manager (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Swatch incarne les valeurs qui coexistent dans les univers de l’art, du design, de la mode et de la technologie, en y apportant sa propre touche de créativité. Ainsi, Swatch est considéré comme une toile sur laquelle s’expriment une multitude de styles. Des looks avant-gardistes, des tendances innovantes et des accents technologiques ont contribué à rendre unique l’expérience de posséder une Swatch.
Job description
L’Assistant(e) Gérant(e) de Magasin, relevant du Gérant de Magasin, joue un rôle clé dans la gestion de tous les aspects des opérations du magasin. Ce poste consiste à stimuler les ventes par la motivation et le soutien de l’équipe, à guider le personnel de vente pour offrir un service client exceptionnel favorisant la croissance des ventes, à atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et à garantir le respect des politiques et procédures de l’entreprise. L’Assistant(e) Gérant(e) doit démontrer les compétences fondamentales de Swatch : Orientation Client, Recherche de Résultats, Créativité, Résolution de Problèmes, Humilité, Intégrité, Création d’Équipes et Relations Efficaces.
• Salaire de base à partir de 45,000.00$ plus prime mensuelle liée à la performance.
• Avantages :
• Vacances payées
• Congés maladie payés
• Assurance santé, incluant soins dentaires et vision
• Assurance vie
• Cotisations REER avec contribution de l’entreprise
• Rabais employés
• Responsabilités :
Service à la clientèle & Génération des ventes : Encadrer l’équipe de vente pour améliorer l’expérience client et atteindre les objectifs de ventes, assurer la connaissance des produits et suivre la performance.
• Opérations : Contribuer à la gestion efficace du magasin, respecter les procédures, contrôler les stocks et résoudre les écarts d’inventaire.
• Gestion du personnel : Soutenir le recrutement, le développement et les processus disciplinaires, participer aux évaluations et plans de développement.

• Excellentes compétences en communication (orale et écrite), incluant la capacité à établir des relations solides.

Store Manager Assistant / Assistant Store Manager (Montreal Eaton Centre) - Swatch Group

Store Manager Assistant / Assistant Store Manager (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Swatch embodies the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology, bringing its own touch of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas on which a multitude of styles are expressed. Avant-garde looks, innovative trends and technological accents have helped make the experience of owning a Swatch unique.
Job description
The Store Manager Assistant, under the Store Manager, plays a key role in managing all aspects of store operations. This position consists of stimulating sales through the motivation and support of the team, guiding sales personnel to provide exceptional customer service for sales growth, achieving operational objectives and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. The Assistant Manager must demonstrate Swatch's core competencies: Customer Orientation, Results Search, Creativity, Problem Resolution, Humility, Integrity, Team Creation and Effective Relationships.
• Basic salary starting at $45,000.00 plus performance-related monthly premium.
• Benefits:
• Holidays paid
• Paid sick leave
• Health insurance, including dental care and vision
• Life insurance
• RRSP contributions with company contribution
• Discounts employed
• Responsibilities:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Support the sales team to improve customer experience and achieve sales goals, ensure product knowledge and track performance.
• Operations: contribute to effective store management, follow procedures, control inventory and resolve inventory gaps.
• Personnel management: Support recruitment, development and disciplinary processes, participate in evaluations and development plans.
• Visual Merchandising: Maintain the store presentation standards.
• Others: Ensure safety at work and serve as a model for policies and procedures.
• Working conditions:
The work requires a moderate physical effort, with a prolonged walking and standing position during the majority of shifts. Although the risk of injury is low, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 16 kg or more with appropriate support) boxes and fit-up elements, as well as significant concentration when performing administrative tasks, managing the caisse or using the POS system.
Employment status:
Full time: on average 40 hours per week. Must maintain a flexible availability to meet the needs of the company and may be required to work more than 40 hours per week, including certain holidays and periods of high activity.
Profile
• Excellent communication skills (oral and written), including ability to build strong relationships.
• Availability to work on openings and closures; flexible hours including weekends and public holidays.
• Leadership skills to mentor and motivate a sales team.
• Oriented results with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Ability to communicate in a clear, concise and understandable manner.
• Autonomy and ability to work as a team.
• Professional requirements
• Minimum 3 years of experience in retail management, ideally in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with MS Office mastery.
• Experience with POS systems.

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Miami Design District - Swatch Group

OMEGA Luxury Timepieces - Assistant Store Manager - Miami Design District
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance. OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.

The Ideal candidate must be experienced in luxury retail sales and operations management with a strong focus on driving sales, delivering refined customer service and demonstrating strong clientele skills. The applicant of choice should have a proven track record of longevity with prior luxury employers. The Luxury Assistant Manager leads retail operations, helps manage selling and supervises staff. jobs.description:
Sales Associate (Metropolis at Metrotown) - Swatch Group

Sales Associate (Metropolis at Metrotown)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
As a Swatch Sales Associate, you will report to the Store Manager and be responsible for achieving sales targets. You will act as a Swatch Brand Ambassador while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.
Starting base pay of $18.30 per hour plus monthly performance bonus.
Responsibilities include:
Customer Service & Sales Generation: Deliver exceptional customer service by assisting customers and resolving issues with a positive attitude. Achieve and exceed sales targets though outstanding product knowledge.
• Operations: Support daily operations, including processing sales and returns, inventory management, and adhering to operation policies and procedures.
• Visual Merchandising: Assist in maintaining store’s visual standards by following visual merchandising guidelines. Assists in maintaining the cleanliness and organization of the store.
• Compliance: Uphold workplace safety standards.
• Working Conditions:
Part-Time, 10 or more hours per week on average. Part-Time employees must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 10 hours a week, certain holidays and blackout dates.
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Profile
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Passion for sales and working in fast paced environment.
• Professional requirements
• At least 1 year of retail sales experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Experience working with POS systems.

jobs.description:
Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Edinburgh - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor - OMEGA Edinburgh
The company
OMEGA is a company of the Swatch Group, the world’s leading watch manufacturer. Since 1848, the brand has been synonymous with excellence, innovation, design and precision. Thanks to its pioneering spirit, OMEGA was the first watch worn on the moon, and it has enjoyed many other accomplishments and explorations in the ocean and in space. Its women’s watches have been amongst the most admired and ingenious in the industry and, most recently, OMEGA’s reputation has been enhanced by its achievements in anti-magnetic watchmaking and its Master Chronometer certified watches, the industry’s highest standard for precision and performance.
OMEGA has been the Official Timekeeper of 30 Olympic Games since 1932 and is also a leading name in golf, swimming, athletics, bobsleigh and sailing. Partnerships with social causes include Orbis International and its Flying Eye Hospital, as well as the GoodPlanet Foundation. Today, OMEGA's family of brand ambassadors includes James Bond, George Clooney, Nicole Kidman, Eddie Redmayne, Daniel Craig, Cindy Crawford, Michael Phelps, Rory McIlroy, Sergio Garcia, Buzz Aldrin and many more.
Main Function
To provide exceptional levels of customer service to all clients. Merchandise, promote and sale of all OMEGA products. Meeting all sales targets and Boutique objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Sales
• Greet and serve all clients providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that clients can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other OMEGA products.
• Provide reliable information to clients in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every client, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credit cards.
Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present and conduct themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international clients and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.
Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and proactive, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
Other
• To undertake all duties and responsibilities which may fall within the remit of such a post under the direction of your line manager.
Professional requirements
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Previous experience from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail back ground.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for OMEGA, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
Job location
4 Multrees Walk
EH1 3DQ Edinburgh (Scotland)
United Kingdom
Company address
The Swatch Group (UK) Limited
77 Marsh Wall
12th Floor
London E14 9SH

The Company
Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.
Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.

As a Sales Associate with Tissot U.S., and the position will responsible for demonstrating outstanding customer service as per Brand standards, generate sales, merchandise and safeguard company assets. You will be expected to help client outreach initiatives, build brand awareness, assist in daily operations of the store. All positions support and assists management team in achieving all customer service and sales goals initiatives. You will be the brand, inside and outside the boutique.

Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills
Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations

Clientele building skills

Physical 
• Requirements:
This is primarily an active position, which requires the Sales Associate to have the ability to stand approximately 5 – 8 hours per day usually 5 - 7 days per week. During peak sale periods (e.g. Holiday, Back-to-School), will work for long periods throughout a work day. Requires to climb ladder or ascend/descend stairs in order to stock and/or acquire merchandise for sale. Required to lift items weighing 5 – 25 lbs regularly without assistance. Communicate in a clear, concise, understandable manner, and listen attentively to others, understand material, and provide instructions to all employees
Strong interpersonal, communication, organization and follow-through skills
Accept constructive feedback
Understand and follow posted work rules and procedures
Must possess strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills with multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced environment;
Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;
